jobs.title: Vi søker dedikerte og fleksible deltider i 11% til vår butikk på Madla
jobs.description:
Kid/Hemtex er i dag en av Nordens ledende interiør- og tekstilkjeder, med mer enn 280 fysiske butikker og nettbutikk, representert i Norge, Sverige, Finland og Estland. Vi tilbyr et bredt og inspirerende utvalg av kvalitetsprodukter til gode priser. Hos oss blir du en del av et fremoverlent selskap som ønsker å fortsette å vokse og utvikle seg. Vi verdsetter fellesskap og en prestisjefri kultur, der du som medarbeider får muligheten til å påvirke og bidra i vår utvikling. Våre verdier Kremmerånd, Inspirasjon og Dedikasjon - veileder oss og gjennomsyrer alt vi gjør.

Til vår butikk på Thon Senter Madla søker vi nå  butikkmedarbeidere i 11 % stilling. Kanskje er det deg?

Hos Kid hjelper vi kundene med å skape hjem de trives i. Nå ser vi etter en ny kollega som vil være med på å skape inspirerende handleopplevelser, gode resultater og et hyggelig miljø for både kunder og kollegaer.

Som butikkselger hos oss blir du en viktig del av teamet. Du møter mennesker med et smil, liker å ta initiativ og trives i en aktiv hverdag hvor ingen dager er helt like.

Hva vil være ansvaret ditt?

  • Gi kundene gode opplevelser gjennom service og salg
  • Inspirere og veilede kunder i valg av produkter
  • Bidra til at butikken alltid fremstår ryddig, innbydende og inspirerende
  • Varepåfylling, vareplassering og kampanjegjennomføring
  • Jobbe mot butikkens mål og bidra til gode resultater
  • Samarbeide med kollegaer for å skape en velfungerende butikkhverdag

 

Vi ser for oss at du:

  • Er positiv, utadvendt og glad i å møte mennesker
  • Motiveres av salg og gode kundeopplevelser
  • Tar initiativ, ser hva som må gjøres og får ting gjort
  • Er ansvarsfull, løsningsorientert og fleksibel når det gjelder arbeidstid
  • Trives i et høyt tempo og liker varierte arbeidsoppgaver
  • Har interesse for interiør, tekstiler og trender
  • Snakker og skriver norsk godt

 

Derfor trives medarbeiderne våre i KidDa vi spurte noen av våre kollegaer hva de liker best med å jobbe hos oss, svarte de:«Kid har gode verdier og ser den enkelte medarbeider.»«Det er lett å lære seg jobben, og man får raskt en god mestringsfølelse.»«Kid er en trygg arbeidsgiver med gode utviklingsmuligheter.»

«Kid er folkelig og nedpå, og det liker jeg godt!»


Vi tilbyr:

  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kollegaer
  • Mulighet til å utvikle deg innen salg, kundeservice og retail
  • Flotte kvalitetsprodukter og inspirerende butikkmiljøer
  • Varierte arbeidsdager hvor din innsats gjør en forskjell
  • Et stort butikknettverk med muligheter på tvers av landet
  • Bonusordning for alle faste medarbeidere som er ansatt i mer enn 20 % stilling

 

Med en veldrevet organisasjon og et godt støtteapparat i ryggen ligger alt til rette for at du skal lykkes i rollen. Din nærmeste leder vil være butikkleder. Du blir en del av et sammensveiset team med dyktige kolleger, både i egen butikk, i regionen og som en del av et stort nordisk konsern.

Interessert? Søk via vår karriereside på karriere.kid.no. Vi behandler kun søknader som registreres i vår rekrutteringsportal.

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kid Interiør er Nordens største tekstil- og interiørkonsern. Konsernet består av kjedene Kid Interiør med en butikkportefølje av ca 150 butikker i Norge, og Hemtex med ca 140 butikker i Sverige, Finland og Estland. Begge kjedene driver i tillegg sine egne nettbutikker som er i sterk vekst. ...

jobs.title: Recoveries Agent (Autolend)
jobs.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

Reporting to the Recoveries and Litigation Manager, the Recoveries Agent will be responsible for completing a wide range of administrative activities within strict timescales to meet the needs of our customers, our third party suppliers including debt collection agencies, recovery agents and vehicle auction houses, as well as internally within the wider business.

The Recoveries Team plays a crucial role in asset management by ensuring the timely retrieval of our vehicles. This involves close coordination and communication with external recovery agents and auction houses to schedule and facilitate the collection process. The team is also responsible for managing the complexities involved in recovering impounded or seized vehicles, which may require interaction with legal authorities and adherence to specific procedures. Additionally, the Recoveries Team handles incoming communications from recovery agents and auction houses, responding to inquiries, providing necessary information, and addressing any issues that may arise during the recovery process.

What you’ll be doing

  • Effectively respond to inbound customer and third party supplier communications through multiple channels including debt collection agencies, recovery agents and auction houses.

  • Initiate outbound communications (calls and emails) to recovery agents and other third party suppliers when necessary.

  • Evaluate customers’ financial circumstances to determine their ability to repay their arrears and recommend appropriate solutions.

  • Follow company policies and legal regulations regarding financial support practices, including documenting all communication with customers and update account information accurately in the company's systems.

  • Review potential accounts for placement with third party suppliers and instruct appropriate suppliers accordingly.

  • Issue Statutory Notices to customers including Notices of Default and Termination, as well as regulatory notices on post-terminated accounts.

  • Deal with accounts where the vehicle has been seized and impounded.

  • Complete administrative tasks as required for the efficient operation of internal processes and external supplier processes. This may also include training material preparation and any other administrative requirement identified by management.

  • Ensure that our customers are treated fairly at all times in line with Consumer Duty.

  • Support the wider team and take the lead in the Recoveries and Litigation Managers absence.

  • Stay up to date on industry trends, regulations and best practices in financial support and recoveries.

What we’re looking for

  • Previous recoveries experience in motor finance is preferred but not essential.

  • Experience taking ownership for managing processes and speaking to external parties.

  • Good understanding of procedures, systems and processes within the department.

  • Logical and common sense approach to evaluate situations and select appropriate solutions based on experience and an understanding of procedures.

  • Strong prioritisation skills, ability to organise and work independently.

  • Resilient and calm approach when faced with difficult situations.

  • Takes responsibility and demonstrates accountability to ensure high-quality output.

  • Able to adapt written and verbal communication to an individual's needs.

Who you are:

  • Be a team player, flexible and able to work on your own initiative.

  • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to establish effective working relationships at all levels.

  • Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail for maintaining accurate records and documentation.

  • Demonstrates a sense of urgency and good work ethic.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Rapport building with colleagues, customers and suppliers.

  • Ability to work to deadlines.

  • Problem solving skills.

  • Ability to operate comfortably in a fast paced and changing environment.

Interview process

  • 30 minute call with a member of the Talent team

  • A Take Home Task

  • Interviews with the Recoveries & Litigation Manager as well as other key stakeholders

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog!

jobs.title: Communications Lead
jobs.description:
Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company, with frontier AI embedded at every step in the production of critical physical products - from creating advanced materials to engineering and manufacturing.

Every Orbital Industries product is developed using CurieOS, our AI operating system, uniting AI-automated hardware engineering with AI-designed material science to achieve breakthrough real-world performance. We also offer CurieOS to our customers and partners, extending the same platform and workflows that power Orbital Industries to their own teams and products.

We have an ambitious mission and need excellent people in all our teams - AI research, operations, advanced materials, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering and manufacturing.

Working at Orbital Industries means working in vertically integrated teams across the full stack, from molecules to manufacturing. We're looking for people who have a love of physical technology, curiosity in AI and a desire to learn.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Communications Lead to define how Orbital Industries is understood in the market - and to build the communications motion that makes that understanding stick.

This is a category-creation brief. You'll articulate what the AI Industrial is, why CurieOS matters, and how Orbital Industries' full-lifecycle approach (materials, engineering, hardware) represents something genuinely new. You'll translate deep technical work - across AI, materials science, and hardware engineering - into clear, distinctive, high-quality communication that builds authority with investors, technical buyers, talent, and the broader market.

Your job is to set the strategic direction: brand voice, messaging frameworks, content strategy, and open doors for media.

Key Responsibilities

Communications Strategy and Brand Voice

  • Define and own Orbital Industries' external communications strategy — how we are positioned, perceived, and understood in the market

  • Build and enforce consistency in brand voice across all external channels: website, social, events, collateral, press

  • Set the messaging framework for CurieOS and its three pillars (Materials, Deployment, Hardware), ensuring our full-lifecycle positioning is sharp and differentiated

  • Write strong creative and messaging briefs for design, video, and campaign work — giving the GTM team clear strategic direction to execute against

  • Ensure a clean separation between Orbital Industries (brand authority, category definition) and Orbital IT (commercial, customer-facing) in how we communicate externally

Stakeholder messaging

  • Work closely with the CFO and founders to ensure investor messaging reflects Orbital Industries' positioning as the AI Industrial category leader, not just a product company

  • Translate technical milestones (CurieOS releases, customer deployments, materials breakthroughs) into compelling narratives

Content and copy

  • Own long-form writing, thought leadership, website messaging, investor content, and campaign assets - from strategy through to production

  • Produce content that makes Orbital Industries' work in AI, materials science and hardware engineering accessible without losing credibility or nuance — you know the difference between simplifying and dumbing down

  • Develop and maintain CurieOS content across its three pillars: materials discovery, deployment engineering, and hardware product development

  • Use LLMs and modern tools to work efficiently while maintaining high editorial standards

Social Media Strategy

  • Own organic social strategy: voice, editorial calendar, content direction and output quality

  • Build Orbital Industries' social presence into a distinctive point of view, not just a broadcast channel — the GTM team handles day-to-day posting and scheduling

  • Track developments across AI infrastructure and adjacent industries to keep content timely and credible

  • Partner with the GTM Lead to align organic and paid social messaging

Website messaging

  • Own website copy and landing-page messaging, ensuring it is sharp, current and aligned to business priorities

  • Work closely with the GTM team on copy for campaign landing pages — you own the message, they own the conversion optimisation and testing cycle

Press and Media

  • Develop Orbital Industries' press function - strengthening media relationships, identifying opportunities, and positioning the company for coverage that reinforces our authority in the AI Industrial category

  • Amplify founder positioning for external audiences, interviews, speaking engagements and media appearances

  • Manage freelance press support and scale the function as the company grows

What We're Looking For

  • Significant leadership experience in communications, content, editorial or brand storytelling — ideally in a technical, deep-tech or science-adjacent environment. Experience with investor communications or fundraising narratives is a strong plus

  • An excellent writer with strong editorial taste and clear judgement; your portfolio should demonstrate range across long-form, short-form and messaging work

  • Deep curiosity about AI, science, engineering or technical products — you follow these spaces because you're genuinely interested, not because it's your job

  • The ability to make technical ideas accessible without losing credibility or nuance

  • Comfortable owning both strategy and execution — you can set the direction, produce the work, and build the systems that maintain quality without you touching every piece

  • Experience building or significantly expanding a communications function — you should find creating something from scratch exciting, not uncomfortable

  • High standards for writing, messaging, and brand consistency — you notice when things drift and you fix them before they compound

  • Strong collaborative instincts — you'll work closely with technical founders, engineers, a GTM Lead, a design function. You need to influence without owning every channel

  • Experience briefing and managing creative work: design, video, freelance writers, press agencies

  • Science degree or background is preferred

Why Join Orbital Industries?

  • Competitive salary and equity package - the ability to own part of Orbital Industries as we grow

  • Flexible and generous paid time off

  • Excellent health, dental and vision insurance plan

  • Regular company offsites to the USA and beyond

  • The chance to define the narrative for a new category — the AI Industrial — at a company where communications is a strategic function, not a support one

Orbital is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.

The Role

We're hiring a IT Systems Engineer to own the reliability and evolution of the tools every team at OLIX depends on day to day: identity and SSO, device management across Mac and Windows, Google Workspace, and the wider collaboration and business-systems stack including Slack, Notion and Atlassian. As headcount grows, so does the load on these systems, and we need someone to own their architecture and roadmap rather than just keep them running.

You'll be the final escalation point for complex, cross-system problems, and you'll lead company-wide systems projects from scoping through delivery. A significant identity provider and device management migration is on the near-term roadmap, so there's substantial architectural work from day one.

Beyond the core stack, you'll act as OLIX's AI enabler: finding the manual tools and processes worth removing, evaluating tools, and building agents and automations that act as a force multiplier across the business, all while holding a high bar on security and IP protection. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role with the freedom to define how IT and internal systems work here from the ground up.

Responsibilities

  • Strengthen the core stack: own the architecture and roadmap for our business-systems stack, including IDP/IAM, Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Atlassian and adjacent HRIS, ATS and finance platforms, and make sure they scale ahead of OLIX's growth.

  • Lead IT and systems projects end to end: take medium-to-large, company-wide projects from scoping through delivery, automating recurring work, streamlining tooling, and improving the day-one and day-to-day experience for every OLIX employee.

  • Be the escalation point: act as the final escalation point for complex, cross-system issues, providing expert-level root cause analysis and implementing architectural changes that stop problems recurring.

  • Build agents and automations: champion AI adoption across the business, partnering with functional teams to design scalable, automated processes and building the tools, scripts and workflows (Google Workspace and Apps Script, IDP APIs) that eliminate manual toil.

  • Own secure onboarding of new tools: partner with InfoSec on SaaS vendor reviews and rollout, so new tools arrive with SSO, SCIM and least-privilege access in place.

  • Raise the bar as you go: find and fix friction or quality gaps in how IT and systems operate without being asked, mentor others, and be a visible example of ownership in the team.

Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years in IT systems engineering, with a track record of owning systems end to end rather than working tickets within someone else's design.

  • Expert-level knowledge of Windows and Mac device management, Google Workspace administration, and Google Cloud Identity across users, devices and applications.

  • Deep, hands-on experience with SSO and identity platforms, ideally Okta, OneLogin, JumpCloud. Experience rebuilding or migrating between identity providers is a strong plus given our roadmap.

  • Experience administering SaaS and collaboration tools at company scale, Slack, Notion and Atlassian (Jira/Confluence) in particular.

  • An AI-first mindset: a practical focus on using AI and LLM-powered tools to streamline IT operations, improve user self-service and automate repetitive work, and a habit of building agents that act as force multipliers for the business.

  • Coding and scripting experience in one or more general-purpose languages, plus familiarity with Google Workspace developer tools (Apps Script, Workspace APIs).

  • Solid grasp of IT security fundamentals: role-based access control, least-privilege access, MDM, data security and identity best practice.

  • Proven ownership: a track record of taking ambiguous, medium-to-large problems and driving them to durable resolution without heavy oversight.

Nice to have: exposure to a fast-moving hardware or deep-tech startup, and comfort with infrastructure-as-code-style change management culture.

Compensation & Equity

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience, skills, and location

  • Equity & Ownership: Meaningful stock options. You're not just joining the mission; you're owning a piece of it

  • Proximity Bonus: We value your time. To minimise your commute and maximise your life, we offer an annual Living-Local Bonus if your residence is within 20 minutes of the office

  • Retirement Benefits: Employer-contributed retirement plans to help you build long-term financial security.

Due to U.S. export control regulations, candidates' eligibility to work at OLIX depends on their most recent citizenship or permanent residency status. We are generally unable to consider applicants whose most recent citizenship or permanent residence is in certain restricted countries (currently including Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus, China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Venezuela). Applicants who have subsequently obtained citizenship or permanent residency in another country not subject to these restrictions may still be eligible.

jobs.title: Operations Lead
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is that we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region, including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

The Operations Lead – UK owns the operational backbone of BJAK's UK business. You'll make sure daily operations, internal systems, and customer-facing execution run smoothly, efficiently, and at a standard that supports scale.

This is not a P&L role, and it's not a "manage from a distance" role either. You'll partner closely with the CEO to turn business objectives into strong execution on the ground, building systems, leading teams, and stepping in directly when execution breaks.

 

What You'll Own

  • Define and execute operational strategies that support growth and align with BJAK's objectives in the UK market.

  • Run day-to-day operations across customer service, administrative operations, and internal workflows so execution stays frictionless.

  • Hire, lead, and develop a high-performing operations and admin team with a strong culture of ownership and accountability.

  • Own process improvement, finding bottlenecks, automating where possible, and implementing systems that cut cost and increase speed.

  • Lead the customer support function and step in hands-on during high-stakes or escalated cases.

  • Oversee company administration and internal operations, including office management, documentation, vendor coordination, and adherence to internal policies.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong background in operations, execution, or internal business operations in tech, fintech, or fast-scaling environments.

  • Proven experience leading operations and admin teams in high-expectation environments.

  • Hands-on mindset with the ability to solve problems directly, not just delegate them.

  • Strong organisational, execution, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing structure to fast-moving situations.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally and drive execution without formal authority.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who want to direct operations from a distance instead of stepping in when things break.

  • Candidates who need fully-built systems and processes handed to them.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid escalations, messy cases, or hard conversations with vendors and staff.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

  • This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1-2 weeks from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Senior Risk Manager
jobs.description:
Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth.

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love. Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success.

Over the past few years, our client base has grown 20 times to over 4 million, and client assets have grown over 50 times to over €5 billion.

Role Overview

The Senior Risk Manager will play a crucial role in supporting the business to embed the Risk Management Framework and manage and mitigate risks across the organisation. You will be responsible for liaising with the first line of defence to support them in identifying and understanding their risk profile, assessing the design and effectiveness of controls and procedures, ensuring these align with internal policies. This role requires a deep understanding of financial markets, trading practices, and global best practices for risk management frameworks.

What you’ll do

  • Ensure the organisation’s approach to the management of risk is aligned with its risk appetite and strategy.

  • Facilitate delivery and maintenance of Risk and Control Risk Assessments (RCSAs), ensuring appropriate oversight of risk identification, assessment and treatment are performed in line with risk appetite.

  • Perform periodic independent second line of defence assurance through the delivery of individual controls testing and thematic assurance reviews.

  • Identify gaps in the control environment and work with the first line of defence to determine remediation plans, ensuring progress is tracked and reported on through governance.

  • Deliver Top-Down Risk Assessments through engaging with senior management and subject matter experts to identify material risks the Firm are exposed to.

  • Maintenance of the legal entity Risk Register and overseeing the maintenance of thematic Risk Registers, including the Fraud Risk Register, Market Abuse Risk Register and Business Wide Financial Crime Risk Assessment.

  • Participating in the ICARA process, ensuring all relevant risks are captured, quantified and adequately stressed.

  • Providing oversight of risk events by working with first line colleagues to understand the root cause of events, their impact on the Firm and what corrective and preventive actions are required to remediate.

  • Demonstrating a solid understanding of liquidity risk management.

  • Delivering coherent, transparent and rigorous risk governance reporting.

  • Delivery of Risk projects to develop, evolve and enhance both the design and embeddedness of the Firm’s Risk Management Framework and supporting processes.

  • Provide an overview and challenge of the trading risk to which the firm is exposed.

  • Ensure appropriate horizon scanning processes are implemented to identify and manage emerging risks.

  • Providing second line risk reviews for new product and feature launches, and strategic and regulatory change initiatives, ensuring risk is identified from the offset, with downstream impacts managed and aligned to risk appetite.

  • Support the identification and enhancement of both qualitative and quantitative risk appetite measures, ensuring these are tracked with any breach escalated and remediated in line with risk appetite.

  • Preparing and presenting thematic risk reports and assessments to senior management and governance bodies.

  • Fostering a healthy Risk Culture by promoting the view that risk management is a universal responsibility by encouraging open and transparent discussions without fear of retaliation.

What you need to have

  • Extensive knowledge of risk management principles and practices.

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking abilities.

  • High attention to detail and risk assessment skills.

  • Effective communication and leadership capabilities.

  • Understanding of the FCA’s MiFIDPRU framework, wind-down planning, and operational resilience

  • Financial management, particularly capital and liquidity management.

  • Management and understanding of market risk in a retail client base.

  • Ability to develop and implement risk mitigation strategies.

  • Proficiency in risk management software and tools.

  • Outsourcing/TPRM experience is good to have.

What we offer

  • Unique challenges that will help you grow and realise your potential really fast

  • Opportunity to make a big impact - you will create products used by millions of investors to build wealth

  • Work with smart, high-performing colleagues with a common goal in a flat, cross-functional team structure

  • An environment where nothing is set in stone, no bureaucracy

  • Appreciation for your talent and ideas

  • Generous remuneration package including annual bonuses

Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker!

Maten är en viktig del av helhetsupplevelsen på Bosjökloster. Trädgårdscaféet är öppet under påskveckan, dagligen under september, samt under julmarknaden, med vällagad mat och goda bakverk.

Utöver caféverksamheten arrangerar vi bröllop, konferenser, privata fester, traditionella gåsamiddagar, julbord och vår stora midsommarbuffé som lockar flera hundra gäster.

Vi arbetar i en historisk miljö med höga ambitioner. För oss är råvarornas kvalitet viktig, liksom hantverket bakom maten. Ambitionen är att matupplevelsen ska hålla samma nivå som slottsområdet i övrigt.

Om rollen

Vi söker dig som:

    är utbildad kock eller har motsvarande erfarenhet
    brinner för matlagning och bakning med fina råvaror
    har god förmåga att planera, organisera och skapa struktur
    förstår vikten av ekonomi, hållbarhet och minskat matsvinn
    trivs med att arbeta både operativt och strategiskt
    tycker om att samarbeta och bidra till en positiv arbetsmiljö
    gärna delar med dig av kunskap och hjälper andra att utvecklas

Hos oss får du stort utrymme att påverka menyer, arbetssätt och verksamhetens fortsatta utveckling.

Om Bosjökloster

Bosjökloster är öppen för besök med park, trädgårdar, utställningar, butik, café och evenemangsverksamhet. Vi som driver verksamheten bor på platsen sedan flera generationer tillbaka.

Vi är ett litet och engagerat team som arbetar nära varandra för att skapa mat-, kultur- och naturupplevelser för våra besökare. Samarbetsvilja, nyfikenhet, engagemang, ansvarstagande och gott kamratskap är värderingar vi sätter högt.

Bra att veta

Bosjökloster är en säsongsbetonad verksamhet. Under sommarmånaderna är tempot högt och arbetsdagarna fler. Vinterhalvåret är lugnare och används bland annat till planering, menyutveckling, provmiddagar för brudpar och förberedelser inför kommande säsong.

Det innebär att huvudsemestern i huvudsak är förlagd till vinterhalvåret och att arbetstiderna varierar över året.

För rätt person är det en fördel. För andra passar det mindre bra. Vi vill därför vara tydliga med förutsättningarna redan från början.

Information

Bosjökloster ligger cirka 7 km söder om Höör. Körkort och tillgång till bil, moped eller annan fungerande transportlösning är nödvändigt eftersom arbetstiderna inte kan anpassas efter kollektivtrafiken.

Vi har kollektivavtal och tillämpar individuell lönesättning.

Intervjuer sker löpande.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Mechatronics Engineering - 50 Prozent studentische Stelle (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
XRbit is a research insitute developing innovative at the intersection of technology, science and digital learning.

Our interdisciplinary team combines software development, artificial intelligence, Extended Reality (XR), 3D technologies and interactive systems. We work together with universities, research institutions, educational organizations, museums and other partners to develop new ways of making complex topics accessible and tangible.

As our research and development activities increasingly combine software with physical systems, we are looking for someone who enjoys turning ideas into working hardware prototypes.

Aufgaben

You will develop and prototype hardware systems at the intersection of camera technology, embedded computing, sensor technology, mechanics and robotics.

A key part of your work will be the development of camera-based systems for computer vision and AI applications.

These systems may range from laboratory prototypes to robust systems intended for continuous operation in industrial or outdoor environments.

You will work closely with our software, AI and 3D development teams and help bridge the gap between software and the physical world.

Your tasks may include:

  • Designing, building and testing camera-based hardware systems
  • Integrating embedded computing platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi or comparable systems
  • Programming and connecting sensors, cameras, microcontrollers and other electronic components
  • Developing suitable concepts for thermal management, ventilation and condensation prevention
  • Producing prototype components using 3D printing and rapid prototyping
  • Documenting hardware architectures, components and technical decisions

Qualifikation

Your Profile

You should have a background in one or more of the following areas:

  • Mechatronics
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Embedded Systems
  • Automation Engineering
  • or a comparable technical field

Technical Skills

You should have practical experience with several of the following areas:

  • Programming C and/or C++ as well as Python
  • Embedded systems/ Microcontrollers
  • Linux-based systems
  • Cameras and image acquisition
  • 3D printing or other rapid-prototyping technologies

Most importantly, you should be comfortable combining software, electronics and mechanics into a working physical system.

Additional Experience That Would Be Valuable

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage, but is not required:

  • Machine Vision
  • Robotics/ Servo motors and stepper motors
  • PCB design
  • Electronics prototyping
  • Ruggedized electronics
  • Thermal management of embedded systems

Benefits

You will become part of an interdisciplinary environment where hardware development is closely connected to artificial intelligence, software development, 3D technologies and applied research.

We offer:

  • A technically diverse student position combining software and hardware development
  • Practical work on real-world prototypes rather than purely theoretical concepts
  • Direct involvement in research and development activities
  • Work with modern technologies in embedded systems, computer vision, AI and robotics
  • Access to prototyping and development infrastructure
  • Close collaboration with an interdisciplinary development team
  • A combination of on-site development work and remote work
  • Opportunities to develop your own technical ideas and contribute to prototype design

We are particularly interested in people who enjoy building things.

You should be comfortable moving from an initial idea to a first experimental setup, testing it, identifying problems and improving the system step by step.

For example, you might spend one day programming an embedded computer, another day testing a camera and lens combination, and the next day designing and 3D-printing a new enclosure or mounting system.

You do not need to be an expert in every technology listed above.

We value curiosity, technical creativity, structured problem-solving and the willingness to experiment with different approaches.

Personal or university projects involving robotics, electronics, embedded systems, drones, cameras, 3D printers, automation or similar technologies are very welcome and can be just as relevant as professional experience.

Interested?

Please send your application, CV and – if available – examples or short descriptions of technical projects you have worked on (GitHub repositories, project documentation, CAD models etc.)

Please only include information in your application that you consider relevant to your professional qualifications and experience.

XRbit welcomes applications from all qualified candidates. Selection is based on professional qualifications, relevant experience, skills and suitability for the position.

jobs.description:

  • Identifizierung von Kandidaten: Wir nutzen unser Netzwerk, unsere Datenbanken und gegebenenfalls auch unsere Werbekanäle, um potenzielle Kandidaten für die offene Stelle zu identifizieren.

  • Vorstellung der Kandidaten: Wir präsentieren die besten Kandidaten unseren Kunden und unterstützen sie dabei, die endgültige Auswahl zu treffen.
  • Beziehungsmanagement: Wir pflegen Beziehungen zu unseren Kunden und Kandidaten, um sicherzustellen, dass wir ihre Bedürfnisse und Anforderungen auch in Zukunft verstehen und erfüllen können.

Du kommst beispielsweise aus dem Bau, Baustoffhandel, Handwerk, SHK, Elektrotechnik, TGA oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich und verfügst über ein gutes Branchenverständnis und idealerweise ein bestehendes Netzwerk.

Du bist bereits als Personalberater, Recruiter oder Headhunter tätig und möchtest dich stärker auf die Bau- und Handwerksbranche spezialisieren.

Auch ohne Erfahrung in der Personalberatung bist du willkommen. Ob Senior Personalberater, Recruiter mit Erfahrung, Vertriebsprofi oder Branchenkenner aus Bau und Handwerk – entscheidend ist für uns nicht dein bisheriger Jobtitel, sondern deine Persönlichkeit und dein Antrieb.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer - UI Focus (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you’re stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.

We build high-performing consumer products across multiple brands in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming. You will be part of a company on a path of hyper-growth, spearheading one of the largest innovations in the mobile gaming industry, rewarded user acquisition.

As a Senior Product Designer - UI Focus (f/m/x) at exmox, you'll join our product design team to shape the user interface and experience of our mobile-first B2C product, impacting millions of users. You'll own features from concept to handoff and create polished, engaging, habit-forming interfaces. This role is about designing experiences that perform. You’ll work at the intersection of user behavior, data, and business goals, shaping flows that drive engagement and revenue. Your work reaches over 25 million users and feeds directly into experimentation and iteration, letting you see the real impact of your decisions. At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.

Our product design team is growing in maturity, and you’ll play a key role in shaping how design works at exmox. If you want high impact, real ownership, and a product at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Own:

  • Feature ownership: Own and design new features from concept through final handoff.
  • UI design: Design visually engaging and highly polished interfaces for our B2C mobile app.
  • Visual assets: Create illustrations, icons, and other graphical assets to support your designs.
  • Developer handoff: Deliver production-ready assets, specifications, prototypes, and documentation to engineering teams.
  • Design system: Build, maintain, and contribute to our evolving design system.
  • Design quality: Conduct design reviews to ensure implementations match the intended designs.
  • Research collaboration: Work closely with UX research and data teams to evaluate and improve your designs.
  • Iteration & feedback: Gather feedback and continuously refine and improve your work.

What’s in it for you as a designer?

  • Impact: Your work directly influences a product used by millions. You’ll see the effect of your design decisions on business KPIs and learn how to create value through design.
  • Data-driven culture: Data sits at the core of every decision we make. You’ll design, test, and iterate based on real user insights and performance metrics.
  • Large global user base: You’ll design for a product with over 25 million users worldwide, operating at true scale.
  • Growing design maturity: Our product design team is on a journey to elevate design maturity at exmox, and you’ll actively shape and contribute to that evolution.
  • Cross-functional design team: You’ll collaborate within a dedicated design team including Product designers, UI Designers, and UX Researcher.

What You Bring

  • Portfolio: A portfolio showcasing outstanding mobile UI craft and visual design.
  • Professional experience: 5+ years of experience working in product teams as a UI, UI/UX, or Product Designer.
  • Consumer product design: Experience designing habit-forming, engaging, consumer-facing interfaces.
  • Industry background: Experience in marketing, gaming, or other B2C-heavy industries is a plus.

Hard Skills:

  • Design tools: Strong proficiency in Figma.
  • Motion & interaction design: Expertise in motion design, animation, and transitions to craft dynamic interfaces.
  • Visual asset creation: Expertise in creating illustrations, iconography, and other visual assets.
  • Design systems: Expertise in designing, shipping, and maintaining design systems.
  • Multi-brand products: Experience with multi-brand, white-label products and theming systems.
  • Brand identity: Experience in defining, designing, and documenting brand identities.
  • Copywriting: Experience in copywriting, including defining tone, voice, and messaging.
  • Accessibility & usability: Strong knowledge of accessibility and usability principles.
  • Frontend awareness: Understanding of front-end technologies and implementation constraints.
  • Language skills: Fluency in English; German is a plus.

Soft Skills:

  • Ownership: You take full responsibility for your work, drive initiatives forward, align stakeholders, and ensure meaningful value delivery.
  • Proactiveness: You anticipate challenges, identify opportunities, and take initiative without waiting for direction.
  • Prioritisation: You focus on what matters most, balance speed and quality, and manage your workload effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Feedback mindset: You give constructive feedback thoughtfully and embrace feedback as an essential part of iteration and growth, comfortably navigating multiple refinement cycles.
  • Creative thinking: You explore a wide range of ideas and solutions from safe bets to bold, out-of-the-box concepts to achieve the most impactful outcome.

How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

Product at exmox means understanding the bigger business picture, considering cross-functional impact across Engineering, Data, Marketing, and Operations, and turning strategy into product decisions that create real value, knowing every change you ship affects millions of users. At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.

If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Own:

  • Own one of exmox's highest-impact product domains end-to-end, shaping the reward economy through payout thresholds, tiering, bonuses, promotions, and other key levers that drive profitability.
  • Drive activation, retention, and long-term engagement through onboarding experiences, streaks, quests, progression systems, reactivation flows, and other lifecycle initiatives.
  • Take new growth opportunities from first hypothesis to go/no-go decision, across product, market expansion, partnerships, and distribution.
  • Lead a high-quality experimentation process by defining hypotheses, designing statistically sound A/B tests, interpreting results, and making data-driven product decisions.
  • Partner closely with your dedicated Data Analyst to uncover opportunities, validate assumptions, and continuously improve product performance.
  • Work with Engineering, Design, Commercial, User Acquisition, Customer Support, Fraud, and Leadership to align priorities and deliver impactful product improvements.
  • Represent your product domain directly to leadership, using data, customer insights, and business context to influence strategic decisions.

What Success Looks Like:

  • You take ownership quickly: Within your first months, you've become the trusted owner of a critical product domain, confidently driving priorities, making decisions, and reducing dependency on leadership.
  • Growth metrics measurably improve: Your product strategy and experimentation drive meaningful improvements in activation, retention, and long-term user profitability.
  • Product decisions are driven by data: Experiments, user insights, and product analytics provide clear evidence to prioritize opportunities, validate ideas, and confidently decide what to scale - or stop.
  • Cross-functional teams are aligned around outcomes: You partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and User Acquisition to deliver product improvements that balance user value with business impact.
  • You turn ambitious ideas into scalable growth: Through structured experimentation, clear prioritization, and continuous optimization, you build product experiences that become repeatable growth levers for the business.
  • You outgrow the role: We are hiring for the ceiling, not just the opening. This role is scoped to grow - mentoring other product managers first, and leading a product team as we scale, if that is the direction you want to take.

What You Bring

  • Experienced: You bring 5+ years of Product Management experience in consumer-facing digital products, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, marketplaces, subscriptions, ad-tech, fintech, or other high-growth B2C businesses. You have owned consumer product at scale - hundreds of thousands of monthly active users or more.
  • Business-Oriented: You understand that product decisions are business decisions. You're comfortable balancing user needs, commercial objectives, and technical constraints to maximize long-term value.
  • Fluent in Incentives: You have a real feel for why people come back and what makes a reward feel worth the effort. You have designed incentive, reward or progression mechanics and calibrated them so they motivate without eroding margin.
  • Experimentation-Driven: You have extensive experience running A/B tests, defining hypotheses, interpreting data, and making evidence-based product decisions. Statistical thinking comes naturally to you.
  • Data-Literate: You're comfortable working with product metrics and collaborating closely with analysts to uncover insights, measure success, and prioritize opportunities.
  • Strategic & Hands-on: You enjoy defining product strategy while remaining deeply involved in execution - from writing specifications and refining solutions to reviewing experiment results and driving delivery.
  • Collaborative: You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Commercial, and Leadership, bringing people together around clear product goals.
  • Intellectually Honest: You're comfortable working in ambiguity, take ownership without waiting for direction, and thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve quickly. You also kill your own ideas when the data says so - being wrong early is cheaper than being right late.

How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

Nav hjelpemiddelsentral Vestland, Førde er lokalisert i Førde og er organisert i to avdelingar med 37 tilsette. Hjelpemiddelsentralen har eit overordna og koordinerande ansvar for formidling og forvaltning av tekniske hjelpemiddel i Sogn og Fjordane.

Om Nav hjelpemiddel og tilrettelegging
Nav hjelpemiddelsentral Vestland, Førde er organisert under  Nav hjelpemidler og tilrettelegging, som består av om lag 1 400 tilsette fordelt på 14 hjelpemiddelsentralar over heile landet.

Vi er eit ressurs- og kompetansesenter med brei kunnskap om ulike funksjonsnedsetjingar og korleis tilrettelegging, hjelpemiddel og teknologi kan fremje funksjon, aktivitet og samfunnsdeltaking. Gjennom tett tverrfagleg samarbeid bistår vi brukarar, kommunar, arbeidsgivarar og andre samarbeidspartnarar med rådgiving, opplæring og tilrettelegging som gjer kvardagen enklare for mange menneske.

  • Utarbeide rapportar og grunnlag for leiaravgjerd

  • Drive utviklings- og forbetringsarbeid for å sikre gode arbeidsprosessar og effektiv ressursutnytting
  • Vere ein fagleg ressurs og rådgjevar for leiargruppa innan økonomi, HR, drift og verksemdsutvikling
  • Utføre administrative og driftsrelaterte oppgåver etter behov


Nav hjelpemiddel og tilrettelegging er i utvikling, og vi arbeider aktivt for å styrkje samarbeid og ressursutnytting på tvers av hjelpemiddelsentralane. Dette kan føre til at arbeidsoppgåver og ansvarsområde blir justerte i tråd med framtidige behov.

Personlige eigenskapar

  • har ein proaktiv arbeidsstil og evne til raskt å setje deg inn i nye arbeidsoppgåver
  • er løysingsorientert

Personleg eignaheit vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

Förväntningar och krav på dig som min personliga assistent

Som min personliga assistent behöver du vara min högra hand i att hjälpa mig att hitta rätt, förstå och tolka vad jag vill och önskar. Du kommer utgöra en viktig del i min vardag.

Jag behöver dig i att för att klara min vardag. Du skall vara lugn, stresstålig, stabil och ha båda fötterna på jorden med ett stort genuint intresse för ge mig den omsorg jag behöver för att ha ett meningsfullt liv. Du behöver ha förmåga att både vara motiverande, ha tålamodet och samtidigt vara mycket lösningsfokuserad.  

Det är ett grundläggande krav att du som person är närvarande, engagerad och har en hög intuitivförmåga att läsa av mig och förstå mig och mina behov, samt har förmågan att ligga steget före i olika situationer. Du är glad, positiv inkluderande och ödmjuk i din roll som personlig assistent. Er ålder är från 35 och uppåt så är det bra.  

Viktiga framgångsfaktorer för att möta mig och mina behov är att du är lyhörd, inkännande och har stor kunskap inom vård och omsorg, då det är ett stort behov i min vardag. Det är av största vikt att du tillsammans med mig planerar dagens innehåll som passar mig och utgår ifrån min dagsform.  

Personlig lämplighet, hög, bred kunskap och erfarenhet inom vård och omsorg.

Personkemi mellan dig och mig är en viktig urvalskriterier. Dessa kriterier väger tyngst vid erbjudandet utav tjänst.

jobs.title: Operator nacht
jobs.description:
Technisch operator voor nachtploeg in internationale productie van hoogspanningscomponenten.

Je werkt in een groeiend bedrijf dat onderdelen maakt voor hoogspanningskabels, gebruikt in ondergrondse energieverbindingen en offshore windparken. Tijdens de nacht bedien je machines en bewaak je de productkwaliteit.

- Machines bevoorraden met materialen zoals epoxy, rubber en siliconen
- Matrijzen vullen en afgewerkte producten verwijderen
- Visuele kwaliteitscontroles uitvoeren en producten afwerken
- Kleine technische storingen analyseren en technieker inschakelen indien nodig

Je werkt in een vaste nachtploeg van maandag tot vrijdag, van 22.00 tot 06.00 uur, met een betaalde pauze van 20 minuten. Er is ook een optie om in een 2-ploegensysteem te werken. Je komt terecht in een stabiele omgeving met een helder takenpakket en directe startmogelijkheden.

Ben je klaar om te starten in deze vaste nachtdienst? Solliciteer vandaag nog, we kijken uit naar je reactie.

jobs.title: Directeur-generaal Leefmilieu
jobs.employer: Federale Overheidsdienst Beleid en Ondersteuning FOD
jobs.description:
In deze strategische topmanagementfunctie binnen de federale overheid geef je leiding aan 300 medewerkers en beheer je een budget van 14 miljoen euro.

Als Directeur-generaal Leefmilieu

  • sta je in voor het beheer van het Directoraat Generaal Leefmilieu
  • draag je bij aan de ontwikkeling van een strategische visie voor DG Leefmilieu en voor de FOD Volksgezondheid, Veiligheid van de Voedselketen en Leefmilieu
  • coördineer je de uitvoering van de strategische en operationele doelstellingen van DG Leefmilieu, om de federale milieubeleidslijnen van de regering concreet vorm te geven.
Jouw rol
  • Je bent lid van het Directiecomité van de FOD VVVL en draagt zo bij aan de uitvoering van het strategisch plan en aan de samenwerking tussen de verschillende departementen
  • Je staat in voor het dagelijks beheer van DG Leefmilieu en geeft leiding aan de verantwoordelijken van de verschillende diensten binnen DGEM
  • Je zit het Coördinatiecomité voor het Internationaal Milieubeleid (CCIM) voor;
  • Je ontwikkelt nauwe en regelmatige relaties met de politieke overheden, in het bijzonder de strategische cellen van de ministers van Leefmilieu, Noordzee en Volksgezondheid; je adviseert hen en verstrekt alle nuttige informatie voor de ontwikkeling en uitvoering van beleid met betrekking tot de opdrachten van DGEM
  • Je werkt samen met verantwoordelijken van andere federale instellingen in het kader van beleidsontwikkeling en projecten die verband houden met de activiteiten van DGEM
  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de vertegenwoordiging van DGEM of de FOD VVVL bij relevante federale beslissings-, advies- en coördinatieorganen voor dossiers die aansluiten bij de doelstellingen van DGEM
  • Je vertegenwoordigt de FOD VVVL/DGEM in organen, instellingen, buitenlandse partners en internationale organisaties binnen de relevante domeinen die gelinkt zijn aan de bevoegdheidsdomeinen van DGEM.
Over de organisatie

De FOD Volksgezondheid, Veiligheid van de Voedselketen en Leefmilieu (VVVL) wil de Belgische promotor zijn van het principe “One World, One Health” door de gezondheid in al haar facetten centraal te stellen in zijn bekommernissen en missies, waarbij het zowel gaat over de menselijke gezondheid als over de gezondheid van de planeet, van dieren en planten en van voeding.

De FOD VVVL is een referentiepunt op het vlak van gezondheid, een transversaal, strategisch en ondersteunend departement “Health and Environment in all policies” en een netwerkorganisatie die zorgt voor operationele excellentie in de uitvoering van taken met toegevoegde waarde.

Selectieprocedure
  1. Screening van de deelnemingsvoorwaarden
  2. Computergestuurde testen
  3. Mondelinge proef waarbij de specifieke technische en managementvaardigheden worden geëvalueerd
Solliciteren

Solliciteer via uw persoonlijke account op werkenvoor.be voor 17 september 2026.

Upload je diploma, vul de specifieke rubrieken in en valideer je kandidatuur.

Voor vragen over de inhoud van de functie of procedure, neem contact op met de contactpersonen vermeld in de rubriek Contact opnemen van de vacature op werkenvoor.be.

Je bent houder van

  • ofwel een basisdiploma van de 2e cyclus (vb. licentiaat/master) van het universitair onderwijs of van het hoger onderwijs van academisch niveau
  • ofwel een functie van niveau A bij het federaal administratief openbaar ambt.

Je moet

  • ofwel minstens zes jaar managementervaring hebben
  • ofwel minstens zes jaar beroepservaring hebben, waarvan minstens twee jaar managementervaring en minstens twee jaar specifieke ervaring.

Onder managementervaring wordt verstaan ervaring inzake beheer in een overheidsdienst of in een organisatie uit de privésector. De term ‘beheer’ omvat minstens

  • het beheer van de middelen,
  • de organisatie van de dienst,
  • de externe relaties,
  • en het aansturen van een team van ten minste vijf medewerkers.

Onder specifieke ervaring wordt verstaan een ervaring in de ontwikkeling van strategieën of nationaal of internationaal beleid in één of meerdere van de volgende domeinen: coördinatie en integratie van milieubeleid, beleid inzake duurzame ontwikkeling, productbeleid, klimaatbeleid, preventie van schade aan gezondheid en milieu, biodiversiteit, chemische stoffen, toezicht op de naleving van wetgeving, bescherming van het mariene milieu.

jobs.title: Penitentiair bewakingsassistent gevangenissen Kempen - FOD Justitie

jobs.description:
Als penitentiair bewakingsassistent draag je bij aan een veilige en menselijke omgeving in de gevangenis. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor gedetineerden en speelt een belangrijke rol in hun terugkeer naar de samenleving.

Je begeleidt gedetineerden van hun aankomst tot hun vrijlating. Wanneer zij vragen hebben of een luisterend oor nodig hebben, kunnen ze bij jou terecht. Je zorgt ervoor dat ze bij de juiste persoon komen als je zelf niet kunt helpen.

  • Je observeert en begeleidt bezoek, wandelingen en andere activiteiten
  • Je houdt toezicht bij bijzondere activiteiten van bepaalde groepen gedetineerden

jobs.title: Boekhouder - FOD Sociale Zekerheid
jobs.employer: Federale Overheidsdienst Beleid en Ondersteuning FOD
jobs.description:
Ben jij een nauwkeurige professional die graag orde schept in cijfers en complexe financiële gegevens omzet in duidelijke informatie? Zoek je een uitdagende functie bij de federale overheid waar je bijdraagt aan een gezonde financiële werking? Dan is deze functie als boekhouder bij FOD Volksgezondheid perfect voor jou!

Jouw rol in ons team

Als boekhouder ben je een onmisbare schakel binnen onze organisatie. Je verwerkt boekhoudkundige verrichtingen, controleert financiële dossiers en ondersteunt de opmaak van rapporteringen en boekhoudkundige afsluitingen.

Je belangrijkste taken:

  • Registreren van boekhoudkundige verrichtingen correct en tijdig
  • Controleren van boekhoudkundige registraties en financiële dossiers
  • Opvolgen van wachtrekeningen en openstaande dossiers
  • Meewerken aan het opstellen van balansen, fiscale fiches en rapporteringen
  • Ondersteunen van de jaarlijkse boekhoudkundige afsluiting
  • Verstrekken van informatie en advies aan collega's en controleorganen
Over de organisatie

FOD Volksgezondheid, Veiligheid van de Voedselketen en Leefmilieu is de Belgische promotor van "One World, One Health". We stellen gezondheid centraal in al onze missies en zorgen voor operationele excellentie. Je komt terecht bij de Dienst Begroting, Ondersteuning en Boekhouding in Brussel.

Selectieprocedure

  • Minimum 1 jaar ervaring in boekhouden
  • Goede kennis van boekhoudkundige verrichtingen en regelgeving
  • Analytisch denkvermogen en nauwkeurigheid
  • Communicatieve vaardigheden
  • Bereidheid tot samenwerking en ontwikkeling

jobs.title: Arts-evaluator personen met een handicap - FOD Sociale Zekerheid
jobs.employer: Federale Overheidsdienst Beleid en Ondersteuning FOD
jobs.description:
Wil je werken in een zorgzaam team dat zich dagelijks inzet voor mensen met een handicap? Bij de FOD Sociale Zekerheid krijg je de kans om als arts-evaluator een directe impact te maken op het leven van personen met een handicap door de kwaliteit van hun evaluaties te waarborgen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als arts-evaluator ben je verantwoordelijk voor het evalueren van de impact van handicaps en het waarborgen van de kwaliteit van deze evaluaties. Je werkt in een multidisciplinair team en krijgt de mogelijkheid om dit team te organiseren en te faciliteren.

  • Je verzamelt en analyseert medische en administratieve gegevens voor evaluaties

De Directie-generaal Personen met een Handicap van de FOD Sociale Zekerheid zet zich in voor 250.000 personen met een handicap in België. We bieden financiële ondersteuning, parkeerkaarten en erkenningen die toegang geven tot sociale, fiscale en tarifaire voordelen. Je werkt in het medisch centrum van Antwerpen

Selectieprocedure

De procedure bestaat uit:

  1. Een screening van je diploma
  2. Een interview met gevalstudie bij de FOD Sociale Zekerheid in Brussel

Competenties

  • Je benadert problemen positief en stelt oplossingen voor
  • Je communiceert sterk en wisselt effectief informatie uit

jobs.title: Expert advies inclusie personen met handicap - FOD BOSA
jobs.employer: Federale Overheidsdienst Beleid en Ondersteuning FOD
jobs.description:
Wil je een betekenisvolle rol waarin je direct bijdraagt aan een inclusievere samenleving? Als expert-inclusieadviseur help je personeelsleden met een handicap en hun werkgevers bij het invoeren van redelijke aanpassingen op de werkvloer. Je werkt voor de federale overheid en maakt deel uit van een nieuw team dat in 2026 wordt opgericht.

Wat ga je doen?

Je voert analyses op maat uit voor individuele situaties van personeelsleden met een handicap. Je bestudeert de functie, de werkomgeving en de behoeften van de persoon. Vervolgens adviseer je zowel het personeelslid als de werkgever over mogelijke aanpassingen.

  • Je begeleidt mensen individueel of in groep, online of fysiek
  • Je stelt verschillende interventies voor om autonomie en welzijn op het werk te bevorderen
  • Je zorgt voor opvolging na tussenkomsten en faciliteert de implementatie
  • Je communiceert mondeling en schriftelijk over aanbevolen aanpassingen
  • Je werkt samen met andere teams en diensten binnen BOSA
  • Je werkt hoofdzakelijk in Brussel, met occasionele verplaatsingen naar andere diensten en gebouwen
Over de organisatie

Je komt terecht in een volledig nieuw team binnen DG Rekrutering & Ontwikkeling van FOD BOSA. Dit team heeft als missie de inclusie van personen met een handicap binnen de federale overheid te versterken. BOSA ondersteunt de regering en federale organisaties op het vlak van HR, digitalisering, overheidsopdrachten en strategische ondersteuning.

Selectieprocedure

jobs.title: Detentiebegeleider gevangenissen Antwerpen - FOD Justitie
jobs.employer: Federale Overheidsdienst Beleid en Ondersteuning FOD
jobs.description:
Werk je graag met mensen en wil je een zinvolle bijdrage leveren aan de maatschappij? Als detentiebegeleider begeleid je gedetineerden tijdens hun verblijf en help je hen bij hun re-integratie in de samenleving.

Je werkt binnen een leefeenheid van een gevangenis van Antwerpen (De Vest of De Kade) en bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor gedetineerden. Je zorgt voor een veilig en positief leefklimaat en motiveert hen om deel te nemen aan activiteiten.

  • Ondersteuning bieden door te luisteren, motiveren en doorverwijzen naar juiste diensten

jobs.title: Ingenieur elektriciteit in Antwerpen - Regie der Gebouwen
jobs.employer: Federale Overheidsdienst Beleid en Ondersteuning FOD
jobs.description:
Werk mee aan elektrische installaties in een unieke en gevarieerde gebouwenportefeuille van de Regie der Gebouwen. Je draagt bij aan veilige, performante en energie-efficiënte oplossingen die een directe impact hebben op essentiële publieke diensten.

Wat ga je doen?

Als ingenieur elektriciteit werk je aan diverse uitdagende projecten binnen onze vastgoedportefeuille:

  • Je stelt elektriciteitsstudies op voor nieuwbouwprojecten, renovaties en vernieuwing van installaties
  • Je bereidt technische en administratieve dossiers voor en maakt opdrachtdocumenten op
  • Je superviseert de uitvoering van werken en neemt deel aan werfvergaderingen
  • Je begeleidt externe studiebureaus bij grote projecten en bewaakt contractuele afspraken
  • Je behandelt klantenverzoeken, analyseert hun noden en stelt oplossingen voor
  • Je lanceert aanbestedingen volgens de wetgeving rond overheidsopdrachten
  • Je detecteert opportuniteiten voor energie-efficiënte oplossingen en werkt deze uit

Over de Regie der Gebouwen

De Regie der Gebouwen beheert de vastgoedportefeuille van de federale overheid en zet sterk in op modernisering, nieuwe technologieën en een inspirerende werkomgeving. We hechten veel belang aan teamwerk en een goede werk-privébalans.

Selectieprocedure

  2. Een interview met gevalstudie (je krijgt voldoende tijd om de gevalstudie voor te bereiden)

  • Brede kennis van elektrische installaties in gebouwen
  • Sterke competenties in kritisch denken, samenwerken en oplossingsgericht werken

jobs.title: Metaalproductieoperator
jobs.description:
Ben jij niet bang voor fysiek werk en wil je graag aan de slag in een technisch uitdagende omgeving?
Werk je graag met moderne machines en vind je afwisseling belangrijk?
Dan is deze functie misschien wel jouw volgende stap!



Als operator in onze gieterij ben je verantwoordelijk voor een cruciale fase in het productieproces. Jouw taken omvatten:

  • Laden van de smeltoven met behulp van een heftruck.
  • Controleren van grondstoffen en voorbereiden van het gietproces.
  • Nemen en analyseren van staalmonsters in samenwerking met het automatische labo.
  • Nauwkeurig opvolgen van het gietproces en ingrijpen bij afwijkingen.
  • Controleren van samenstelling en kwaliteit van het gesmolten metaal.
  • Registreren van procesgegevens en rapporteren aan de teamleider.
  • Reinigen en onderhouden van gietinstallaties en smeltovens.
  • Verwijderen van restanten uit gietbakken na elk proces.
  • Strikte naleving van veiligheidsvoorschriften en minimaliseren van contact met vloeibaar aluminium.

We zoeken iemand die:

  • Fysiek werk aankan en bereid is om dit dagelijks uit te voeren.
  • Je kan goed functioneren in een omgeving met hoge temperaturen en veel omgevingsgeluid.
  • Bereid is om te werken in 3 ploegen of een volcontinu systeem.
  • Gemotiveerd is en op zoek naar een stabiele functie op lange termijn.
  • Ervaring heeft met metaalbewerking of gelijkaardige fysiek zware jobs.
  • Vlot Nederlands spreekt, leest en schrijft.
  • Zelfstandig tot Duffel kan komen met eigen vervoer.

jobs.title: Onthaalbediende Casino Flexi
jobs.description:
Je steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen en je zoekt een flexijob met veel klantencontact?
Klanten help je steeds verder met een grote glimlach en veel enthousiasme.
Klinkt dit als iets voor jou? Lees dan zeker verder!

Voor een aantal casino's in de regio Limburg zijn wij op zoek naar een enthousiaste onthaalmedewerker.
Plaats van tewerkstelling is hoofdzakelijk Genk, maar je bent ook flexibel om in te springen in het filiaal in Hasselt.

Als onthaalbediende ben jij hét visitekaartje van de onderneming. Je zorgt ervoor dat iedere klant zich welkom voelt.
Vervolgens doorloop je de voorgeschreven onthaalprocedure (controle ID-kaart, input gegevens, upload van speelkrediet, enz).
Eens in de speelhal, ben je het aanspreekpunt voor vragen, serveer je de klanten een (non-alcoholisch) drankje en hou je toezicht op de naleving van het huisreglement.
Je kan je mannetje staan en zorg je ervoor dat de zaal en het sanitair altijd piekfijn in orde zijn.

Naast een optimale dienstverlening aan de klanten, zorg je ook voor een correcte administratieve verwerking.
Je start en eindigt je werkdag met de opmaak van het kasboek. Je noteert de dagopbrengst bij opening en sluiting
en zorgt ervoor dat deze ten alle tijden klopt met de uitgevoerde verrichtingen.

  • Je hebt een verzorgd voorkomen, bent sociaal en klantvriendelijk;
  • Stilzitten is niets voor jou, je ziet altijd werk;
  • Je beschikt over een eigen wagen om ter plaatse te geraken (regio Genk-Hasselt);
  • Je bent flexibel m.b.t. werkuren (werken in het weekend en avonduren zijn voor jou geen probleem);
  • Je kan een blanco bewijs van goed gedrag en zegen voorleggen;
  • Je bent stipt, correct en nauwkeurig.

jobs.title: Commercieel administratief bediende
jobs.description:
Combineer je graag klantencontact met administratie en heb je interesse in techniek?
Dan is deze functie binnen de verhuur iets voor jou.

Je komt terecht bij een bedrijf actief in de verhuur van rollend materieel.
Je werkt in een omgeving waar samenwerking en een vlotte service centraal staan.
Je krijgt er bovendien ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Als Commercieel administratief bediende zorg je ervoor dat huuraanvragen van begin tot eind correct worden opgevolgd.
Je combineert commercieel klantencontact met een nauwkeurige administratie en bent een belangrijk aanspreekpunt binnen de verhuurafdeling.

Je taken:

- Je behandelt binnenkomende huuraanvragen en helpt klanten verder met hun vragen.
- Je stelt verhuurcontracten correct op en volgt deze administratief op.
- Je onderhoudt een vlot en professioneel contact met klanten.
- Je zorgt voor de volledige administratieve verwerking van het verhuurproces.
- Je bewaakt lopende dossiers en zorgt ervoor dat alle informatie correct verwerkt wordt.

Wij zoeken iemand met relevante ervaring in klantenservice, inside sales en/of commerciële binnendienst. Indien je dit niet kan voorleggen, kunnen we je niet weerhouden.

Klinkt deze combinatie van klantencontact, techniek en administratie als iets voor jou?
Solliciteer vandaag nog. We leren je graag kennen! - Vaardigheden:
Je kan reeds terugblikken op minstens 1 jaar relevante werkervaring in relevante functie.
Wij zoeken iemand met ervaring in klantencontact, inside sales, commerciële binnendienst.
Hiernaast ben je leergierig en kan je goed werken met de PC.
Communicatief, sociaal en klantgericht zijn typeren jou.
Je hebt interesse in techniek.

- Attesten:
Geen attesten noodzakelijk.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
Geen specifieke opleiding noodzakelijk.

- Vakkennis:
Ervaring in soortgelijke functie of interne sales is pluspunt.

- Talenkennis:
Je hebt een zeer goede kennis van Nederlands.
Een basis Frans en Engels is mooi meegenomen maar niet vereist.
De terminologie kan aangeleerd worden.

jobs.title: Préparateur de commandes
jobs.description:
Êtes-vous passionné(e) par le transport et la logistique ? Bleckmann vous recherche !

Nous recherchons des collaborateurs logistiques pour les entrepôts de Bleckmann à Rieme et Desteldonk (près de Gand). Vous travaillerez en équipe du matin (05h48 - 13h48) ou en équipe de l’après-midi (14h00 - 22h00).

Il s’agit d’une mission temporaire pendant une période de forte activité, dans un environnement dynamique. C’est une excellente opportunité d’acquérir de l’expérience dans le secteur de la logistique. Comme Bleckmann connaît plusieurs périodes de forte activité au cours de l’année (notamment le Black Friday en novembre), vous aurez également la possibilité de revenir pour de futures missions.

Cette opportunité vous intéresse ? N’hésitez pas à consulter cette offre d’emploi!



Tâches:

  • Vous préparez les commandes qui arrivent
  • Vous préparez les commandes en fonction de l'ordre d'arrivée à l'aide d'un système de balayage
  • Vous préparez les documents corrects lors de l'emballage des commandes

Nous organisons un service de bus depuis Gand afin de faciliter l’accès aux entrepôts de Bleckmann:

  • Aller-retour depuis la gare de Gent-Sint-Pieters pour l’entrepôt de Rieme
  • Aller-retour depuis la gare de Gent-Dampoort pour l’entrepôt de Desteldonk
  • Départ à 05h10 ou à 13h10
  • Attitude positive
  • Bonne connaissance des chiffres
  • Flexibilité
  • Communication courante en Néerlandais, Francais et/ou Anglais
