jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineering - Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS)
jobs.description:
At Koenigsegg, we bring together curious minds and skilled engineers who share a passion for pushing technology forward. As part of our R&D team, you will work in a collaborative environment where ideas grow into world-class innovations.

We are currently expanding our R&D team and are looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer with experience in standard components and materials.

The role offers the opportunity to contribute to the design and development of components and systems that define the performance, functionality, and quality of our cars. You will be surrounded by dedicated colleagues who value teamwork, precision, and creativity at every step of the process.

Responsibilities

You will be responsible for creating and maintaining our standard components and materials library within the R&D Engineering department. This will include all development phases, from conceptual design to end of production, and will require close collaboration with all parts of the organization, including but not limited to Prototype, Testing, Procurement, Production, Quality, CAE, and Homologation.

You will:

    Create and maintain 3D models, assemblies, and 2D drawings using CATIA V6 / 3DEXPERIENCE for the catalogue of standard parts (commercial off-the-shelf products).
    Maintain the internal table for fastener tightening torques and standards.
    Create and maintain the materials and surface treatments library using CATIA V6 / 3DEXPERIENCE.
    Support the Low Voltage Electronics department in releasing engineering data, such as PCB/FPC and Bootloader data, using CATIA V6 / 3DEXPERIENCE.
    Create Koenigsegg Technical Standard (KTS) documents, engineering instructions, specification drawings for families of parts, etc.
    Facilitate tests to verify component functionality and ensure that requirements are met when needed.
    Apply data-driven analysis to identify root causes, enhance product reliability, and optimize performance.
    Assist in selecting and interacting with suppliers and technology providers to ensure quality and performance targets are met.
    Provide technical support to ensure the successful introduction of off-the-shelf components and systems into and throughout production.

    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
    3+ years of experience in engineering design within the automotive, aerospace, or similar industries.
    Proven understanding of part and assembly design, DFM, and component durability.
    3+ years of CAD experience, preferably with CATIA V5/V6 or 3DEXPERIENCE.
    Experience with Microsoft Power BI Essentials and proficiency in Word and Excel.
    Professional-level English, both written and spoken.

Meritorious experience:

    Work experience in the top-tier automotive or motorsport industry.
    Experience with standard parts (commercial off-the-shelf products), especially fasteners used in the automotive industry.
    Practical, hands-on experience working with cars, racing, or similar activities, either professionally or as a hobby.
    Knowledge of material science, including material selection, heat treatment, and surface treatments.
    Experience in composite design and manufacturing.
    Understanding of automotive regulations and homologation requirements.
    Experience with supplier management and technical partnerships.

Koenigsegg is most known for building some of the fastest cars in the world; with almost all of our megacar technologies that are patented and made in-house by our almost 750 world-class technicians, engineers, sourcing experts, production craftsmen, and communicators.

What we’ve created is a unique proving ground of engineering creativity that makes use of our breakthrough megacar development and legacy to push the boundaries of sustainable mobility technology.

So, what’s next?

We are on a universe-denting mission to develop the next generation of breakthrough tech and products. We are looking for outstanding, impactful, and authentic individuals to grow with us. Our ambitions are inspiring but will push the limits of what is possible – requiring one to work efficiently amid our cross-functional teams to execute at high-quality levels.

The goal is clear: innovate and transform.

jobs.title: Sähköhuoltopäällikkö
jobs.description:
Haemme Sähköhuoltopäällikköä Pirkanmaalle

Kasvatamme taloteknistä huolto- ja ylläpitotoimintaamme ja haemme sähköhuoltopäällikköä vahvistamaan taloteknistä toimialaamme Pirkanmaan alueella.

Sähköhuoltopäällikkönä vastaat Pirkanmaalla oman vastuualueesi organisaation, asiakkuuksien ja liiketoiminnan johtamisesta sekä kehittämisestä. Vastaat oman vastuualueesi kannattavasta kasvusta ja liiketoiminnan tuloksellisuudesta. Osallistut aktiivisesti uusasiakashankintaan sekä asiakassuhteiden ylläpitämiseen ja kehittämiseen.

Johdat henkilöstöäsi hyvän johtamisen periaatteiden mukaisesti hyödyntäen Constin johtamisjärjestelmää. Kehität tiimisi osaamista liiketoiminnan tarpeiden mukaisesti ja huolehdit turvallisen, motivoivan ja tehokkaan työympäristön ylläpitämisestä.

Tehtävä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen päivätyö, jossa työaika painottuu klo 7.00–15.30 välille. Työn aloitus sovitaan valitun henkilön kanssa.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa yksikönpäällikkö Jarkko Viikki, p. 050 592 2499.



Etsimältämme henkilöltä toivomme

- Tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta tai vahvaa kokemusta sähköhuollosta, huolto- ja korjaustöiden organisoinnista sekä kunnossapidosta

- Kokemusta tarjouslaskennasta ja liiketoiminnan tuloksellisesta johtamisesta

- Kokemusta sähköhuollon pien- ja palvelu-urakointiprojektien läpiviennistä sekä aikataulu- ja kustannushallinnasta

- Hyviä henkilöstöjohtamisen taitoja

- Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja asiakaspalvelutaitoja

- Huoltopäällikkönä sinulta vaaditaan itsenäistä työskentelyä ja vastuunkantamista

Hakemamme sähköhuoltopäällikkö on aikaansaava ja ratkaisukeskeinen henkilö, joka nauttii toiminnan suunnittelusta, organisoinnista ja kehittämisestä. Sinulla on kyky rakentaa ja ylläpitää pitkäjänteisiä yhteistyösuhteita asiakkaiden, yhteistyökumppaneiden ja alihankkijoiden kanssa.

Henkilöstö on toimintasi keskiössä ja johdat tiimiäsi esimerkillisesti luoden pohjan pitkäaikaisille työsuhteille, hyvälle työilmapiirille ja osaamisen kehittämiselle. Sinulla on hyvät neuvottelutaidot ja toimit toimintaperiaatteidemme mukaisesti. Haluat rakentaa turvallisen ja laadukkaan työympäristön kaikille osapuolille ja olet valmis tekemään töitä sen eteen.




Consti Talotekniikka Oy

Consti on yksi Suomen johtavista korjausrakentamiseen ja taloteknisiin palveluihin keskittyneistä yhtiöistä. Tarjoamme kattavasti korjausrakentamisen ja talotekniikan sekä valikoidusti uudisrakentamisen palveluita taloyhtiöille, yrityksille ja sijoittajille sekä julkiselle sektorille Suomen kasvukeskuksissa. Työllistämme noin 1000 korjausrakentamisen ja talotekniikan ammattilaista ympäri Suomea.

Uudistamme asunto-, teollisuus-, kauppa-, hotelli- ja toimistokiinteistöjä sekä julkisen sektorin kohteita. Consti tarjoaa myös palvelu-urakointia sekä sopimusasiakkaille toteutettavia huolto- ja ylläpitopalveluja.

Puhelin: 010 288 6000 Sijainti: Nuutisarankatu 35, 33900 Tampere

jobs.title: Vuoropäällikkö, St1 Oriketo Turku
jobs.description:
Oletko sinä etsimämme VUOROPÄÄLLIKKÖ St1 Orikedolle Turkuun

Haemme nyt asiakkaallemme St1 Orikedolle Turkuun vuoropäällikköä. Orikedon St1 asema sijaitsee vilkkaan ohikulkutien varrella ja palvelee asiakkaita vuorokauden ympäri. Asemalle pysähdytään nauttimaan herkullisesta ruoasta, pizzoista, kahvitauosta ja aidosti ystävällisestä palvelusta. Nyt joukkoon etsitään vuoropäällikköä vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen (112,5 h / 3 viikkoa).

Vuoropäällikkönä olet tärkeä osa aseman arkea ja toimit yksikönpäällikön oikeana kätenä. Johdat työvuoroja omalla esimerkilläsi, pidät huolen siitä, että päivä sujuu mutkattomasti ja autat tiimiä onnistumaan parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla. Sinulla on jo kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä tai vastuullisesta roolista sekä asiakaspalvelu-, liikenneasema- tai ravintola-alalta. Ennen kaikkea oikea asenne ratkaisee.

Työtehtäväsi tulevat olemaan:

- työvuorojen johtaminen aseman kaikissa vuoroissa ja tiimin tukeminen päivittäisessä työssä

- asiakaspalvelun ja tuotteiden laadun varmistaminen

- henkilöstön ohjaaminen, kannustaminen ja palautteen antaminen

- tilausten tekeminen ja varastonhallinta

- konseptin mukaisten toimintatapojen sekä yhteisten pelisääntöjen toteutumisesta huolehtimista yhdessä yksikönpäällikön kanssa

Työntekijälle tarjoamme:

- kattavan perehdytyksen ja jatkuvan tuen työhösi

- monipuolisen työn ja tehtäväkentän

- kannustavan työilmapiirin ja mukavat työkaverit

Työnhakijalta odotamme:

- kokemusta ihmisten johtamisesta positiivisella otteella

- rauhallista työskentelytapaa kiireenkin keskellä sekä priorisointikykyä

- toimeen tarttuvuutta

- joustavuutta ja mahdollisuutta työskennellä kolmessa vuorossa

- kykyä omaksua uusia asioita sekä hyviä IT taitoja

Hakuprosessi:

Mikäli ilmoitus herätti mielenkiintosi, älä aikaile jättää työhakemusta sekä CV:tä Bondatan nettisivujen kautta osoitteessa [https://bondata.fi/tyopaikat//](https://bondata.fi/tyopaikat/). jobs.title: Deltids regnskabsassistent til Nordens førende restaurantsite
jobs.description:
Er du struktureret og har en god forståelse for bogholderi? Nyder du at kunne gå på weekend og vide, at tallene stemmer? Så er du måske vores nye regnskabsassistent. 

DinnerBooking er en danskejet IT-baseret virksomhed, som leverer et markedsførende online bookingsystem til restauranter på tværes af Norden og flere lande i Europa.  

DinnerBooking fornemmeste opgave er at give gæster inspiration og nem adgang til restauranter gennem vores digitale platform, samtidig med at vi leverer det mest værdiskabende bookingsystem til restauratører.  

Din rolle 

Vi søger en kollega til vores bogholderi, som vil få berøring med en bred pallette af bogføringsopgaver og mulighed for at få masser af ansvar. Derfor er det også en styrke, at du kender dine begrænsninger og siger til, hvis du løber ind i en udfordring, du ikke selv kan løse. Her prioriterer vi at løfte som et team og hjælpe hinanden, så vi får løbet opgaverne i mål. 

Dine opgaver 

  • Debitorbogholderi og håndtering, herunder rykkerprocedurer, sikre opfølgning på kundebetaling og korrespondance vedrørende mellemværende 

  • Finansbogføring 

  • Fakturering og håndtering af ordrer 

  • Håndtering af moms samt varetage dialog til offentlige myndigheder 

  • Afstemning af diverse konti 

  • Lønkørsel (kun danske lønninger via Danløn) 

 

Vi forestiller os, at du: 

  • Har nogle års erfaring med forskellige opgaver inden for bogholderi  

  • Du mestre dansk og engelsk i både skrift og tale 

  • Er struktureret i din måde at løse opgaver på samt formår at overholde deadlines 

  • Navigerer hjemmevant i Excel 

  • Er nysgerrig og altid interesseret i at forbedre processer og kvalitet 

Hvordan du har opnået din erfaring, er ikke centralt for stillingen, men vi forventer, at du har en god grundforståelse for tal og bogholderi.  

 
Vi tilbyder  

En spændende rolle i en voksende virksomhed, hvor du får masser af ansvar og frihed. Du bliver desuden del af et kontor, som i dag består 35 dedikerede medarbejdere fra både Danmark, Estland, England, Ukraine, Polen, Norge, Finland og Rumænien.  

Vi er et socialt kontor med en uformel tone, og hvor to dage sjældent er ens. Vi nyder at tage en dialog omkring kaffemaskinen, og to gange om året spiser vi sammen til restaurantfestivalen DinnerDays, som vi selv arrangerer. 

Vi tilbyder en god frokostordning og et kontor placeret tæt ved Amagerbro Metro. 

Arbejdstid: 12-16 timer med mulighed for fleksibilitet. 

Løn: Løn forhandles efter kvalifikationer. 

Deadline 
Send os dit CV og ansøgning i én samlet PDF allerede i dag til job@dinnerbooking.com. Vi kigger på ansøgningerne løbende. 
 
Nysgerrig? 

Hvis du ønsker at høre mere ind til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Peter Thygesen på pt@dinnerbooking.com.

jobs.title: Embedded Data Engineer - ML
jobs.description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Embedded Data Engineering in ML Team 👋

At the heart of our Data and ML teams, embedded Data Engineers create the pipelines and tables that power business critical dashboards, enable self-service analytics, and fuel advanced machine learning models and real-time data products. Working with tools like DBT, Spark, and Airflow, you'll transform high volume raw event data into user-friendly, high impact datasets that support machine learning use cases across the business.

As an Embedded Data Engineer in ML, you'll sit within the Machine Learning team, working day to day with Machine Learning Engineers and Data Scientists to build reliable datasets for ML use cases. You'll also have access to Trainline's wider Data Engineering, Data Platform, and analytics community, working alongside other embedded Data Engineers in ML, including senior and principal engineers.

In this role as the Embedded Data Engineer (ML), you will...🚄

  • Design and build scalable data pipelines, data models, and feature stores that support analytics and machine learning workloads within the ML domain.

  • Deploy and maintain cloud-native data applications on AWS, using CI/CD pipelines to automate builds, testing, and releases.

  • Maintain the technical quality, performance, and reliability of production data pipelines through strong observability and engineering best practices.

  • Collaborate closely with Machine Learning Engineers and Data Scientists to build reliable, well-structured datasets that power ML use cases.

  • Work with the wider Data Engineering, Data Platform, and analytics community to share knowledge and align on best practices across teams.

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

  • Working knowledge of Python and SQL.

  • Experience building data pipelines for downstream machine learning workloads, including feature engineering and model training workflows.

  • Comfort with data modelling and building efficient data marts and warehouses in the cloud.

  • Experience building data pipelines using tools such as Spark and Airflow, or similar technologies, within a cloud environment such as AWS.

  • Familiarity with both real-time and batch data workloads, along with modern data transformation and orchestration patterns.

  • Ideally, you may also have experience with parallel or distributed training frameworks such as Ray, or with modern data formats such as Parquet and Iceberg.

  • It would also be helpful if you have some experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and containerisation (Docker) to support automated, standardised deployments.

  • You may also have contributed to or maintained CI/CD pipelines (such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions) as part of production grade data systems, and enjoy solving complex data problems collaboratively.

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

  • 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn, Instagram and Glassdoor!

With a clear roadmap in place and an enthusiastic Senior Tax Analyst already embedded in the team, this is a genuinely compelling moment to join and help shape the next chapter of what our tax function can be.

As Interim Group Tax Manager, you will report directly to the Group Head of Tax and take real ownership across the full breadth of our tax obligations - spanning corporation tax, VAT, employment taxes, and transfer pricing across our UK and European entities. jobs.title: Senior Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As Senior Partnerships Manager at bunch, you will be a senior individual contributor owning the partnership function across our core markets: the partners who send us clients, and the specialist providers who help us service those mandates end-to-end.

Fund administration is a partnership-driven business. The right referral and channel partners create qualified pipeline at scale. The right provider network ensures we can support fund managers across markets without capability gaps. This role brings both together.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role. You will personally build the channel that brings clients in, develop the provider network that lets us keep them, and establish the systems behind the function. It is a revenue-generating role with direct impact on ARR, and it is also serviceability-critical: making sure bunch can support fund mandates in our markets with confidence, quality, and speed.

The near-term mandate is to prove and scale the partnerships motion through direct execution. As the function matures and its impact becomes repeatable, there is potential to shape the future operating model and build a team.

You will:

  • Own the partnership program across bunch’s core markets—UK, Germany, and Luxembourg—keeping a consistent framework while adapting activation to local market dynamics and regulatory realities

  • Personally identify, sign, and activate referral and channel partners, including fund formation counsel, placement agents, banks, audit advisors, and tax advisors

  • Convert partner relationships into qualified pipeline and measurable partner-sourced ARR

  • Structure and maintain relationships with regulated and specialist providers, including depositaries, AML officers, ManCos, auditors, and onboarding, compliance, accounting, and tax specialists

  • Close capability gaps so bunch can service fund mandates end-to-end across our markets, with particular focus on Luxembourg’s regulated-provider network

  • Own commercial negotiation, pricing, and scope across partnerships, working closely with the relevant operations owners on delivery

  • Build the infrastructure behind the channel from day one: tracking partner introductions, conversion to clients, partner-sourced pipeline, revenue, and activation timelines

  • Partner with Commercial and Marketing on joint go-to-market initiatives, including co-hosted events, co-authored content, and partner-facilitated introductions

  • Represent bunch at key industry events and forums across our markets; regular travel is expected

  • Use data and market feedback to recommend when and how the function should expand, including the capabilities and roles a future team may need

The two pillars of the role

Grow the channel

You will personally identify, sign, and activate referral and channel partners that convert into qualified pipeline at scale. You will own the commercial relationship, including negotiation, pricing, activation, and scope expansion. Once a referred client is live, day-to-day delivery sits with the relevant operations owner; your focus stays on growing the relationship and driving more pipeline through it.

Close the capability map

You will identify, structure, and maintain relationships with specialist and regulated providers that allow bunch to service fund mandates end-to-end. These relationships are ongoing and operational by nature; you own them commercially while delivery runs alongside the relevant teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • Acting as the hands-on owner of partnerships rather than delegating execution

  • Setting strategy and priorities while also sourcing, negotiating, activating, and expanding partnerships directly

  • Influencing senior stakeholders across Commercial, Marketing, Operations, Product, and leadership

  • Creating a repeatable operating model, clear metrics, and evidence of commercial impact

What This Role Does Not Own

  • Immediate people management: this is not a team-lead role on day one, and there is no expectation to hire before the function’s needs are proven

  • Day-to-day service delivery: operational delivery sits with the relevant operations owners; you own the commercial partner relationship and help resolve structural issues

  • All strategic platform partnerships: marquee, leadership-level relationships remain shared with bunch’s leadership team. You may contribute to or increasingly own selected strategic relationships where your expertise and the business need align

About You

  • 5–10 years of relevant experience in partnerships, business development, or a senior client-facing role within fund administration, fund services, fintech, or professional services; depth of ownership matters more than exact tenure

  • Strong understanding of private markets and how fund managers actually operate

  • A track record of building something from scratch, such as a partner programme, new market, or commercial channel

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity, creating structure as you go, and owning a measurable commercial outcome

  • A senior operator who remains energised by direct execution: opening doors, running partner conversations, negotiating agreements, activating relationships, and building the underlying process

  • Commercially sharp: you understand how referral and delivery partnerships work, what makes each valuable, and how to structure agreements that work for both sides

  • Able to hold credible senior conversations with law firms, depositaries, regulated providers, and professional services firms

  • Strong cross-functional partner to Sales, Customer Success, Operations, Product, and leadership teams, influencing without relying on formal authority

  • Organised and systems-oriented, with the ability to build tracking, reporting, and process while moving fast

  • Fluent in the language of private markets, including fund structures, LP/GP dynamics, and the regulatory environment across the UK and Europe

  • Familiar with the role of depositaries, ManCos, AML officers, and other regulated or specialist providers in fund operations

  • Existing relationships in the UK and/or European VC/PE ecosystem—such as law firms, accountancy practices, placement agents, banks, or regulated providers—that give you a running start

  • Willing and able to travel regularly across bunch’s markets

  • Interested in the potential to build a team when the business is ready, without seeing immediate people management as a prerequisite for seniority

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Remote-flexible hybrid setup, depending on location and role requirements

  • Up to 4 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring Process

  1. People Team Interview (30 min) – Get to know us and learn more about the role

  2. Deep Dive with a Team Member (30 min) – Role deep dive, expectations, ownership, and commercial scope

  3. Partnerships Case with our Head of Sales & Co-Founder (60 min) – Partner strategy, prioritisation, and hands-on execution approach

  4. Cross-functional Panel (3 x 30 min) – Collaboration and influence across different teams

Questions? Reach out to

Curious to learn more?

Get a feel for who we are, how we work, and what we’re building:

  • About bunch – Our mission, product, and journey so far

  • Case Studies – About those who already build on bunch

  • Gathering insights – Our latest bunch of blog posts

  • Glossary – Explore commonly used private market terms

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

jobs.title: People Business Partner, EMEA & APAC (London)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Having surpassed $300M ARR and continuing to grow, Optro helps enterprises transform risk into opportunity through its AI-powered GRC Intelligence Platform. More than 50% of the Fortune 500, including 7 of the Fortune 10, leverage our award-winning technology to move their businesses forward with greater clarity and agility. And our customers love us: Optro is top-rated on G2.com and Gartner Peer Insights.

At Optro, we inspire each other to innovate and are proud of what we are producing. We spend each day thinking of new ways to help our customers and contribute to the greater good of our company and our surrounding communities. We are all about assisting each other and breaking through barriers to create the most loved audit, risk, ESG, and InfoSec platform by our customers. This is how we have become one of the 500 fastest-growing tech companies in North America for the seventh year in a row, as ranked by Deloitte!

Why This Role is Exciting

As the People Business Partner for EMEA and APAC at Optro, you will lead our regional people strategy and shape the employee experience across these locations. This role is a perfect fit for a proactive and resourceful individual who is excited to help drive the company's global expansion by building new processes from the ground up while also serving as a key partner and coach to leaders and employees across every department.

Please note: This is a hybrid position based in London and will require travel to the office two times per week. There will also be occasional business travel for meetings.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with and coach leaders at all levels on a wide range of people processes, including performance reviews, compensation planning, team development, and organisational design

  • Advise and coach leaders on managing complex employee relations issues, including performance management, investigations, and grievances

  • Provide expertise on local labor law and compliance across EMEA and APAC, ensuring the company operates in a compliant manner

  • Support global expansion within EMEA and APAC through entity creation and PEOs

  • In partnership with teams within the People organisation, support the development and implementation of foundational people policies, processes, and programs for the EMEA and APAC regions

  • Collaborate closely with US-based People Business Partners and leaders to ensure a cohesive and consistent global people strategy

  • Leverage data and analytics to influence business strategy and inform decision-making

Attributes for a Successful Candidate

  • A minimum of 5-7 years of progressive experience as a People Business Partner, preferably in the SaaS industry

  • Deep knowledge of labor law in EMEA and APAC and experience with global expansion, including entity creation

  • Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced environment and operating in a matrixed organisation serving multiple geographies, including the UK, Germany, Poland, and Singapore

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence senior leadership

  • Resourceful, comfortable with ambiguity, and skilled at balancing multiple competing priorities

  • Multi-lingual is a plus

Perks (United Kingdom)

  • Launch a career at one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in North America and EMEA!

  • Live your best life (LYBL)! $200/mo (USD) for anything that enhances your life

  • Comprehensive employee health coverage

  • Pension scheme with company contributions

  • Competitive compensation & bonus program

  • Generous annual leave of 25 days plus bank holidays

  • Time off for your birthday & volunteering

  • Employee resource groups

  • Opportunities for team and company-wide get-togethers!

*perks may vary based on eligibility/location

Our Company Values

  • Customer obsession: It starts and ends here. Consistently ask yourself how what you’re doing creates value for our customers. It’s a mindset.

  • Gritty resilience: Make it happen. Find a way. Move fast, stay positive, and do what it takes.

  • Drive innovation: Create the future. Continuously improve what exists and invent what’s next.

  • Win, together: One team. No silos, no egos. Drive to be the best and support each other’s success.

  • Growth mindset: 10x, not 10%. Think in orders of magnitude, not increments. Seek feedback, learn, and improve.


Please note that background checks are required. Qualified Applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for Employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. This role may have access to highly sensitive data, including employee data, customer data, company financials, and proprietary product information.

We love building strong partnerships, but please note that Optro cannot accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Any submissions without a signed agreement in place will not create a fee obligation.

jobs.title: Verkostosuunnittelija
jobs.description:
**Tule piirtämään sähköverkkojen seuraavia reittejä kanssamme!**

**Pidätkö siitä, että suunnitelmat eivät jää paperille, vaan muuttuvat oikeiksi sähköverkoiksi maastossa? Sitten tämä paikka voi olla juuri sinua varten!**

**Mitä pääset meillä tekemään**

Tarvetta olisi verkostosuunnittelijalle vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Turkuun sähkönjakeluverkon liiketoimintamme projektitiimiin. Tässä roolissa pääset suunnittelemaan sähköverkkoja ja olemaan mukana hankkeissa aina ensimmäisistä laskelmista valmiisiin verkkoratkaisuihin asti. Työpäiviisi kuuluu muun muassa sähköverkon laskentaa, verkosto- ja maastosuunnitelmien laatimista sekä kartoitus- ja dokumentointitehtäviä.

Käytännössä pääset tekemään esimerkiksi sähköisiä laskelmia, rakenne- ja reittisuunnittelua sekä hankkimaan maankäyttöön ja rakentamiseen liittyviä lupia. Lisäksi osallistut katselmointeihin, laadit sopimuksia ja hakemuksia sekä kartoitat valmistuneita verkkoja maastossa. Myös suunnitelmien merkitseminen maastoon ja työselostusten laatiminen kuuluvat tehtäväkenttääsi. Tehtävässä on myös halutessasi mahdollista osallistua varallaoloon ja viankorjaukseen.

Työssä et jää yksin suunnitelmien kanssa, vaan teet tiivistä yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, alihankkijoiden ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa. Jokainen päivä tuo mukanaan hieman erilaisia tilanteita ja ratkaistavia asioita.

Omexom on VINCI Energies konsernin energiainfrastruktuureihin keskittyvä brändi, joka toimii Suomessa energianjakelun koko ketjun parissa aina tuotannosta siirto- ja jakeluverkkoihin. Tarjoamme kokonaisvaltaisia palveluita avaimet käteen -projekteina tai esimerkiksi suunnitteluna ja kunnossapitona. Omexomilla on Suomessa 450 työntekijää.

**Mitä taskustasi olisi hyvä löytyä**

- Sähköalan koulutus

- Hyvät yhteistyötaidot

- Turvallisuuslähtöinen ajattelutapa

- Aktiivinen ote tehtävien hoitamiseen ja ongelmanratkaisuun

- Vähintään B-luokan ajokortti

- Hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen suomen kielen taitoa (muusta kielitaidosta lisäpisteitä)


Työturvallisuus on toimintamme perusta, ja odotamme sinulta myös verkostosuunnittelijana vahvaa turvallisuusajattelua sekä kykyä suunnitella projekteja ja työkohteita turvallisuus edellä, töihin liittyvät riskit huomioiden. Huolehdit osaltasi siitä, että turvalliset toimintatavat toteutuvat käytännössä ja että jokainen pääsee työpäivän päätteeksi turvallisesti kotiin.

**Millaiseen porukkaan tulet?**

Omexomilla osaamista jaetaan, onnistumisia juhlitaan yhdessä ja apua saa aina kysyä. Arvostamme korkealentoista huumoria, matalaa hierarkiaa ja sitä, että töihin on mukava tulla. Meillä et jää yksin pohtimaan haasteita. Ympärilläsi on joukko asiantuntijoita, jotka jakavat osaamistaan, sparraavat ja auttavat tarvittaessa. Työskentelemme tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden, alihankkijoiden ja ennen kaikkea toistemme kanssa.

Perehdytämme sinut tehtävään kunnolla, joten kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi. Riittää, että tuot mukanasi uteliaisuutta, tekemisen meininkiä ja halun kehittyä.

Tule mukaan porukkaan, jossa työkaverit tekevät työpäivistä parempia!

**Mitä lupaamme sinulle:**

- Osaavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön

- Mahdollisuuden kasvaa alan huippuosaajaksi

- Työn, jolla on oikeasti merkitystä energiamurroksen ja yhteiskunnan toimivuuden kannalta

- Tehtävän vaativuutta ja osaamista vastaavaa palkkaa, joka on tehtävässä 3200-3600€/kk

- Arkea tukemaan kattava työterveyshuolto, virike-etu ja osakesäästöohjelma


**Sinustako seuraava omexomilainen?**

Lähetä hakemuksesi viimeistään **23.9.2026,** sillä aloitamme keskustelut sopivien hakijoiden kanssa jo hakuaikana, joten älä jätä hakemista viime tippaan.

**Täältä saat vastaukset vaikeisiinkin kysymyksiin:**

jobs.title: Manager Sustainability Reporting & Non-Financial Disclosures
jobs.description:
We’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’ve transformed our business and are building our future on one clear purpose—to deliver a smoke-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and has been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years.

We are now looking for a Manager Sustainability Reporting & Non-financial disclosures to be based in Stockholm.

Impact You’ll Own

You will lead the development of key sustainability reports, including the Group Value Report and global non-financial disclosures. Working with reporting specialists and subject-matter experts, you will turn strategy, performance, and data into clear, accurate, and credible content.

What You’ll Do

    Lead the development of the Group Value Report and key global non-financial disclosures
    Manage the reporting process from initial drafting through review, approval, and publication
    Work with reporting specialists and subject-matter experts to gather and validate content
    Turn complex sustainability data and insights into clear, engaging, and credible narratives
    Ensure all reporting outputs are accurate, consistent, evidence-based, and traceable
    Coordinate timelines, inputs, review cycles, version control, and approvals
    Apply sustainability reporting requirements and disclosure expectations throughout the process
    Monitor reporting trends, regulatory developments, and peer practices to identify improvements
    Strengthening the structure, readability, and overall quality of sustainability communications
    Adapt sustainability content for reports, websites, presentations, and other external materials



Skills & Capabilities

    University degree in sustainability, business, finance, communications, public policy, or a related field
    5+ years of relevant professional experience, including substantial experience in sustainability, corporate, annual, or other non-financial reporting
    Excellent written and spoken English
    Strong knowledge of sustainability reporting requirements and sound judgment in drafting and review
    Ability to connect narrative claims to data source inputs, and approved documentation
    Ability to ask the right questions, interpret input, and turn technical expertise into clear insights
    Ability to communicate complex ideas clearly, compellingly, and accurately
    Disciplined management of timelines, inputs, reviews, versions, and approvals without compromising quality
    Ability to lead projects end to end, ensuring quality and escalating risks when needed



Please note that relocation support is not available for this role.



Rewards & Benefits

Our success depends on the people who come to work every single day with a sense of purpose and an appetite for progress. Join Swedish Match and you too can:

• Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment and explore.

• Be part of an inclusive, diverse culture, where everyone’s contribution is respected; collaborate with some of the world’s best people and feel like you belong.

• Enjoy flexibility of hybrid way of working - split your time between working from our office or the comfort of your home, where it works best for you in line with business needs.

• Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provide endless opportunities to progress.

• Take pride in delivering our promise to society: to deliver a smoke free future.

jobs.title: Helsefagarbeider VI på Eik arbeidsavdeling
jobs.description:
Vil du være med å skape arbeidsdager som betyr noe?

VI på Eik arbeidsavdeling gir et tilrettelagt arbeidstilbud til voksne med funksjonsvariasjoner. Hos oss handler en god arbeidsdag om å få bruke ressursene sine, oppleve mestring og utvikling – og være en del av et sosialt fellesskap.

Arbeidsdagene våre er varierte, og vi liker å se muligheter. På avdelingen har vi for tiden flere arbeidsstasjoner som makulering, kabelsortering, søm, vev, tennbriketter, snekkerverksted og lysstøp. Samtidig foregår stadig mer av arbeidet vårt ute i kommunen. Vi kjører ut og utfører ulike praktiske oppdrag, og er på utkikk etter nye oppgaver og arbeidsarenaer som kan gi tjenestemottakerne våre gode og meningsfulle arbeidserfaringer.

Nå har vi en ledig 100 % stilling som helsefagarbeider, og ser etter deg som er god på å bygge relasjoner, og ønsker å kombinere helse arbeid med praktiske oppgaver.

Som helsefagarbeider på VI på Eik blir du en viktig del av tjenestemottakernes arbeidsdag. Du skal støtte, veilede og tilrettelegge ut fra den enkeltes ressurser, interesser og bistandsbehov. Målet er å skape gode rammer for deltakelse, utvikling og størst mulig grad av selvstendighet.

Du vil blant annet planlegge og gjennomføre arbeidsoppgaver sammen med tjenestemottakerne og arbeide målrettet med miljøarbeid. Du vil også bidra i utarbeidelse, oppfølging og evaluering av tiltaksplaner og være med på å sikre tjenester med høy faglig kvalitet.

Tjenestemottakerne våre har ulike behov for tett oppfølging, veiledning og støtte. Noen har sammensatte og omfattende helseutfordringer, og arbeidshverdagen innebære også praktisk helsehjelp og personlig stell. Evnen til å bygge gode relasjoner, skape trygghet og møte mennesker ut fra deres individuelle forutsetninger er en viktig del av jobben.

En del av arbeidshverdagen vil foregå utenfor avdelingen, og du må like å være i aktivitet og ta del i praktisk og fysisk arbeid. Du kan den ene dagen være på vev og den neste være ute på et oppdrag et annet sted i kommunen. Vi ser derfor etter deg som trives med variasjon, er fleksibel og ikke er redd for å ta i et tak. Du må også være komfortabel med å kjøre større biler gjennom hele året.

Vi håper du er en trygg og stødig person som møter mennesker med varme, respekt og nysgjerrighet. Du tør å by på deg selv og forstår hvor viktig tålmodighet og gode relasjoner er i arbeid med mennesker.

Du er faglig engasjert og trives med målrettet miljøarbeid, samtidig som du liker praktiske oppgaver og en aktiv arbeidshverdag. Du kan arbeide selvstendig når det trengs, men vet også at de beste løsningene ofte skapes sammen med andre. Hos oss er et godt arbeidsmiljø et felles ansvar. Vi ser etter deg som bidrar aktivt til godt samarbeid, åpen kommunikasjon og en kultur der vi støtter hverandre og sammen finner gode løsninger.

Vi ønsker oss en kollega som ser muligheter, tar initiativ og har lyst til å være med på å videreutvikle både arbeidsavdelingen og tilbudet til tjenestemottakerne våre.

Arbeidssted er for tiden ved VI på Eik arbeidsavdeling, men kan endres innenfor virksomheten etter behov.

Hovedarbeidsoppgaver

  • Planlegger, tilrettelegger, veileder og gjennomfører arbeidsoppgaver for personer med ulik grad av bistandsbehov
  • Bidra aktivt med målrettet miljøarbeid: identifisere og jobbe med utviklingsmuligheter hos den enkelte tjenestemottaker
  • Gi helse bistand og pleie til tjenestemottakere med komplekse helse utfordringer
  • Gi oppfølging i tråd med tjenestemottakers vedtak, tiltaksplan og behov
  • Rapportere i vårt journalsystem
  • Gi opplæring til nyansatte og vikarer
  • Samarbeid internt og med samarbeidspartnere og pårørende
  • Praktiske gjøremål og delegerte oppgaver fra koordinator og leder

Kvalifikasjonskrav

  • Fagbrev som helsefagarbeider, aktivitør eller tilsvarende eldre helse- og omsorgsfaglig utdanning, som hjelpepleier eller omsorgsarbeider

  • Digitale ferdigheter 
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Språkkrav for helsepersonell; faglærte tilsvarende B2
  • Gyldig politiattest må fremvises ved ansettelse 

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner

  • God kunnskap om kapittel 9 og erfaring med utfordrende atferd
  • Kjennskap til og interesse for brukergruppen og erfaring fra tilrettelagt arbeidstilbud
  • Kunnskap om og erfaring med målrettet miljøarbeid
  • Praktisk anlagt og glad i fysiske arbeidsoppgaver
  • Erfaring med kompleks helsetilstand, stell og pleie
  • God på veiledning
  • Erfaring med brukermedvirkning 
  • Førstehjelpskurs, eller villig til å ta det
  • Oppdatert på lovverk, forskrifter, retningslinjer og avtaleverk innenfor fagområdet 

Personlige egenskaper

  • Strukturert, ansvarsfull og selvstendig

  • Kreativ, omsorgsfull og tydelig
  • Tålmodig
  • Være en rolig og trygg person som står stødig og kan sette grenser i krevende situasjoner
  • Utøve et godt medarbeiderskap
  • Gode samarbeidsevner og arbeidsmoral, du må kunne bygge relasjoner og samarbeide, og bidra til et positivt arbeidsmiljø.

Personlig egnethet vektlegges

Vi tilbyr:

  • Arbeid på dagtid
  • Lønn etter gjeldende tariffavtale
  • Gode forsikrings- og pensjonsordninger
  • Bedriftsidrettslag og avtale med treningssenter

Søkerlister med opplysninger om navn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bosted- eller arbeidskommune for hver søker er offentlig i hht Offentlighetsloven. Det kan gjøres unntak dersom søker anmoder om dette og grunngir dette i søknaden. Dersom anmodningen ikke tas til følge vil søkeren varsles om dette.

Kommunen ber aldri om kontaktinformasjon eller kontoopplysninger i rekrutteringsfasen, verken over SMS, e-post eller i brev via Digipost

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Velkommen til Tønsberg, byen som har holdt koken siden vikingtiden. Dette er byen som vet hvordan vi kombinerer historie, skjærgård og kulturliv, noe som er en uslåelig kombinasjon. Selv med vår sentrale plassering på Østlandet (en time fra Oslo og 20 minutter til Torp flyplass), kan du fortsatt kalle naturen for «nabo» og nyte en kaffepause med utsikt mot Oslofjorden. Tønsberg kommune er ikke bare en kommune som rommer 59 000 innbyggere. Det er også en arbeidsplass for over 4000 mennesker. Her skal arbeidsdagen innebære mer enn å telle timer. I Tønsberg kommune har du mulighet til å utvikle deg, le litt (eller kanskje mye) med kollegaer, og rom til å være deg selv. Er du klar for å jobbe i en kommune med ambisjoner for fremtiden, hvor du kan balansere jobb og fritid med skjærgård, skog, kultur eller byliv rett utenfor døren? Da venter Tønsberg kommune på deg. Er du videre nysgjerrig på Tønsberg kommune som arbeidsplass, eller et sted å flytte til? Mer informasjon finner du her: https://www.tonsberg.kommune.no https://tonsberglivet.no

jobs.title: Lærer
jobs.description:
Kort om stillingen:

Lærerstilling ved Tolga skole – 100% vikariat – fra 1.1.2027 – 8.10.2027, med mulighet for forlengelse

Om tjenesteområdet:

Tolga kommune satser på utdanning og utvikling av grunnskolene. Gjennom «Kultur for læring», «Kompetanseløftet» og Oppvekstreformen jobbes det med å utvikle det profesjonelle læringsfelleskapet. Tolga er en del av det skole- og barnehagefaglige samarbeidet i Nord- Østerdalsregionen. Innad i kommunen er det et svært godt tverrsektorielt samarbeid om barn og unge.

Skolene arbeider i team, og har i mange år hatt utvidet tilstedeværelse. Uteskole og naturen som lærings- og aktivitetsarena er viktig gjennom hele året. Skolene skal utvikle et inkluderende fellesskap som fremmer helse, trivsel og læring for alle. Et raust og støttende læringsmiljø er grunnlaget for en positiv kultur der elevene oppmuntres og stimuleres til faglig og sosial utvikling.

Tolga skole

Tolga skole ligger i Tolga sentrum med ca. 150 elever fra 1. til 10. trinn. Skolen og barnehagen ligger i samme bygningskompleks som et nytt kulturbygg og kulturskolen.

Tolga skole er en skole som preges av en fleksibel timeplan. Vi jobber med tverrfaglige opplegg som skapes sammen med lokalsamfunnet, og vi har en praktisk tilnærming til fagene, med entreprenørskap og samarbeid med lokalt næringsliv. Skolen har fokus på å bruke fysiske læremidler, med digitale verktøy som supplement.

 

Kvalifikasjoner:

Vi søker etter lærere med godkjent utdanning, og med en bred kompetanse. Vi ønsker tydelige og trygge klasseledere med god vurderings- og relasjonskompetanse. Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner er viktig. I tillegg til kompetanse og ansiennitet, vektlegges også personlig egnethet etter en samlet vurdering. Kontaktlæreransvar må regnes med.

Krav til stillingen:

  • Det ønskes lærer med kompetanse i matematikk og naturfag, gjerne også i kombinasjon med andre fag. Kroppsøving er et ønsket fag i fagkretsen, men ingen forutsetning.
  • Vi ønsker en tydelig og trygg klasseleder med god vurderings- og relasjonskompetanse.
  • Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner er viktig.
  • Til stillingen kan kontaktlæreransvar regnes med.
  • I tillegg til kompetanse og erfaring, vektlegges også personlig egnethet etter en samlet vurdering.

Særskilte krav til stillingen:

  • Ved tilsetting kreves politiattest, ikke datert eldre enn 3 måneder.

Vi tilbyr:

Et faglig stimulerende arbeidsmiljø med høye ambisjoner på egne og elevenes vegne. Spennende og givende arbeidsoppgaver. Tett kollegialt samarbeid i den enkelte barnehage, skole, i kommunen og i regionen. Lønn etter tariff. Gode pensjons- og forsikringsvilkår.

 

Vi ønsker ikke kontakt med annonseselgere/ rekrutteringsbyråer

Dersom søker ønsker å reservere seg fra offentlig søkerliste, må dette begrunnes. Opplysninger om søkeren kan bli offentliggjort, selv om søker har bedt om ikke å bli oppført på søkerlisten.

Søkeren varsles dersom ønsket om reservasjon ikke tas til følge.

Ved behov for hjelp, ta kontakt med personalavdelingen på tlf. 62496500.

 

Som IA-bedrift oppfordrer Tolga kommune kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uansett alder, kjønn, etnisitet og funksjonsnedsettelser.


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

I Tolga kommune finnes det to grunnskoler og to barnehager. Hver av dem er organisert som egne enheter. Begge enhetene har felles personalledelse. Barnehager og skoler i Tolga: Tolga barnehage og Vingelen barnehage utgjør én enhet. - Tolga barnehage ligger i Tolga sentrum og har fire avdelinger for barn 0–6 år: to for 0–3 år og to for 3–6 år. - Vingelen barnehage ligger i Vingelen sentrum og har to avdelinger for barn 0–6 år. Tolga skole og Vingelen skole utgjør én enhet. - Tolga skole ligger i Tolga sentrum og er en 1.–10.-skole med ca. 150 elever. - Vingelen skole er en 1.–7.-skole med ca. 50 elever. Sammen med Vingelen barnehage utgjør den et oppvekstsenter. Tolga kulturskole er en del av Tolga skole og har aktiviteter både i Tolga og Vingelen. Barnehagene og skolene har lange tradisjoner for samarbeid og er tett knyttet til lokalsamfunnet. Kulturen preges av gode relasjoner og felles innsats på tvers av enhetene. Tolga kommune deltar i et skole- og barnehagefaglig samarbeid i Nord-Østerdal og er med i flere regionale utviklingsnettverk. Kommunen har også en egen «Plattform for oppvekst», som skal sikre felles verdier og en tydelig retning for tjenestene Visjon for oppvekst i Tolga Røtter i fortida, tro på framtida og læring i fellesskap Mål Tolga ønsker et lokalsamfunn og oppvekstmiljø som gir barn og unge trygghet, glede, selvstendighet og skaperglede.

jobs.title: Bli en del av Gullfunn Stovner og skap magiske minner for kundene. Vi søker etter to engasjerte tilkallinger
jobs.description:
Vi i Gullfunn Stovner søker en engasjert og resultatorientert selger til teamet vårt! Er du glad i høyt tempo, brenner for salg og elsker å skape gode kundeopplevelser? Vi søker deg som er over 18 år og klar for en utfordring i en spennende og aktiv butikkhverdag!

Som vår kollega i Gullfunn er du en viktig del av teamet og butikkens hverdag. Vi ser etter deg som møter på jobb med respekt for deg selv, kollegaene dine, kundene – og jobben som skal gjøres.

– varer av høy verdi krever oppmerksomhet

– et godt arbeidsmiljø skapes av alle – hver dag

– er aktiv i møte med kunder

Hos oss setter vi pris på struktur, ansvar og stolthet i jobben vi gjør.

jobs.title: Head Chef at Clarion Hotel The Edge
jobs.description:
Head Chef at Clarion Hotel The Edge – Ready to Make Your Mark?

We’re not looking for just any chef. We’re looking for someone who wants to own the kitchen, shape our menus with the finest local Arctic produce—and confidently present our food concepts to our event guests. Are you ready to elevate the culinary experience at The Edge?

At Clarion Hotel The Edge, "good enough" never is. Driven by energy, courage, and enthusiasm, we create memorable moments for our guests. As our new Head Chef, your mission is clear: raise the bar for both banquet and à la carte dining, craft bold food concepts, and serve as a passionate ambassador for our kitchen.

The best part? Day-to-day line management is not your primary focus. Here, your main energy goes toward craft, flavor, presentation, and incredible ingredients.

What the role is all about:

  • Crafting menus with local identity: You get the creative freedom to propose, experiment, and refine our à la carte and banquet menus using premium local produce. All menus are developed in close partnership with and approved by our Executive Chef and Strawberry central F&B team.

  • Presenting the food: You step up at major events to present the menu and the stories behind the dishes to our guests with confidence and pride.

  • Delivering under pressure: Main hours are during the evening when the heat is on and expectations are high.

  • Driving sustainability in practice: We mean it when we say "We Care". Through short-traveled ingredients, strong local supplier partnerships, and a clear commitment to reducing food waste, you’ll run a more sustainable kitchen operation.

  • Close collaboration and leadership backup: Reporting directly to our Executive Chef, you will be a key player in driving our culinary philosophy. The role may also involve temporary team leadership duties, particularly when stepping in while the Executive Chef is away or on vacation.

Our vision—and who you are:

Strawberry and Clarion share a clear vision: "To increase the quality of life for guests and colleagues."

To thrive with us, that purpose needs to resonate with you.

You are:

  • A highly skilled, uncompromising chef with a trade certificate and solid experience in banquet and/or à la carte service.

  • Sustainability-minded, innovative, and deeply passionate about local produce and Arctic flavor profiles.

  • Comfortable communicating and presenting food concepts to large groups when required.

  • Ready and willing to step up to take charge of the team when the Executive Chef is away.

  • At your absolute best during high-pressure evening shifts, bringing positive energy that inspires everyone around you.

Why join us?

We give you the platform to shine, grow, and push your limits:

  • Pure culinary focus: Spend your time where you shine brightest—at the stove, developing concepts, and executing top-tier service, while stepping up to lead when duty calls.

  • The power of Strawberry: Access unique opportunities for culinary competitions, leadership courses, and professional development across the group.

  • World-class team: Become part of an energetic, courageous, and enthusiastic culture at one of Northern Norway's most iconic hotels.

  • Unbeatable perks: Great employee discounts on stays and experiences across the entire Strawberry chain.

Ready to step up?

Apply now! We review applications continuously and will hire as soon as we find the right match.

  • Position: Head Chef (Banquet & À la Carte)

  • Working hours: Evening shifts

  • Reports to: Executive Chef

  • If you have any question please contact Lene Larsen, Executive Chef at  phone+47 41144512.  or email lene.larsen@strawberry.no

jobs.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
jobs.employer: OLR Holdings Ltd trading as DFYNE
jobs.description:
Role:

Senior QA Automation Engineer

About You:

Are you the kind of engineer who sees quality as a technical challenge rather than a manual process? Do you enjoy building automated test frameworks, creating release safeguards and preventing production issues before they happen? Are you as comfortable writing code as you are designing quality strategies and identifying risks across complex systems? If you enjoy improving how software is built, tested and released, DFYNE could be exactly where you belong.

About DFYNE:

A picture paints a thousand words… and we’re sure you don’t want to sit here reading a corporate essay about who we are. Honestly, how can you really get under the skin of DFYNE from a few lines on a screen? So instead, go have a look for yourself, see what we’re about, what we stand for, and why people love us: www.dfyne.com.

About the role — DFYNE Your Career:

Before I tell you more about the role, let me introduce myself. I’m Bruce, Head of Development at DFYNE, and I’m looking for our first dedicated Senior QA Automation Engineer. This is a hands-on engineering role that will help define quality engineering across DFYNE. Reporting directly to the Head of Development, you will work alongside our Staff Software Engineer to build the test infrastructure, automation coverage and quality gates that allow our teams to move quickly without compromising reliability. You will help protect systems that handle commission payouts, refunds, inventory synchronisation, shipping labels and other business-critical processes where quality has a direct commercial impact.

Attitude:

• Ownership mentality
• Engineering-first approach
• Attention to detail
• Risk-based thinking
• Continuous improvement

Key Responsibilities:

• Build and maintain integration test infrastructure that runs against real databases and realistic service environments.
• Design and implement automated regression coverage across business-critical workflows.
• Own CI quality gates and contribute to release readiness processes.
• Develop end-to-end testing coverage for revenue-critical customer journeys.
• Create and maintain realistic and secure test data strategies.
• Work closely with engineers to identify and prevent quality risks early in the development lifecycle.
• Improve test reliability, execution speed and developer adoption.
• Support incident investigations by identifying testing gaps and opportunities for preventative coverage.
• Contribute to engineering standards, software quality practices and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Collaborate with Product, Engineering and Operations teams to ensure quality requirements are understood and delivered.

Skills & Experience:

• 5+ years of experience in QA Automation, SDET or software engineering with a quality focus.
• Strong TypeScript or Python development experience.
• Deep integration testing experience using real dependencies including databases, queues and simulated third-party services.
• Strong Playwright, Cypress or equivalent end-to-end testing experience.
• Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD quality gates, ideally using GitHub Actions.
• Strong understanding of automated testing strategies and risk-based testing approaches.
• Experience building scalable, maintainable test frameworks.
• Ability to write production-quality code.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong problem-solving and analytical capability.

Nice to Have:

• E-commerce or payments experience.
• Contract testing experience.
• Performance and load testing experience.
• Google Cloud Platform familiarity.
• Terraform and Infrastructure as Code experience.

So, what’s in it for you?:

If you’ve made it this far down without being put off, brilliant. I’d genuinely love to hear from you. Beyond joining a work family and a genuinely great place to build your career, you’ll become DFYNE’s first dedicated quality engineering hire and help define how quality is delivered across one of the UK’s fastest-growing companies. You’ll build systems and processes that have a visible impact on reliability, customer experience and business performance.

You’ll be part of a high challenge; high reward culture.

What will aid a successful application with DFYNE:

• Cover letter
• Completed questionnaire

Salary starting from £55K per year.

jobs.title: Ledig stilling som barnehagelærar
jobs.description:
Me har ledig fast stilling for barnehagelærar frå 04.01.27 - evt pedagogisk leiar. 

Vil du gjera ein forskjell i barn sitt liv? Me trur at nysgjerrige, trygge og leikne barn skapar framtida, og me treng deg som vil væra med barna på denne reisa. Hos oss vil du bli ein del av eit stort fellesskap kor me legg vekt på å lage gode dagar for barn og tilsette, i arbeidsmiljøet er delingskultur, involvering og arbeidsglede viktige element. Eit språkleg og kulturelt mangfald i barnegruppene gir barna eit unikt høve til å utvklie evne til å være respektfulle, vise omsorg, empati og ha forståing for ulike perspektiv. Er du glad i å væra ute og på tur? Det er me, og med FUS-bussen tilgjengeleg kan me komme oss på eventyr, både nært og fjernt. På kjøkkenet er me så heldige å ha vår eigen kokk, som stadig inspirerer smak- og luktesansen vår med velsmakande retter. 

Er du engasjert? Tek du initiativ? Samarbeider du gode med andre? Snakkar du med barn på ein open, ærleg og tydeleg måte? 

Verdset du kunnskap? Er du trygg på eige kompetanse og erfaring? Søkjer du faglege råd og rettleiing i utfordrande situasjonar? Verdset du andre sin kunnskap og lærer av andre?

Er du reflektert og oppteken av å finne løysingar på utfordringar?

Ja? Då kan det væra akkurat deg me ser etter!

Arbeids- og ansvarsoppgåver vil mellom anna væra: 

* Ansvar for planlegging, gjennomføring, dokumentasjon og evaluering av det pedagogiske arbeidet

* Væra ein del av barnehagen sitt pedagogteam, og bidra til å rettleie og utvikle potensialet hos andre

* Bidra til å utvikle det fysiske og psykososiale barnehagemiljøet

* Sjå barnehagen i eit heilskapleg perspektiv, og samtidig bidra til heilskapleg omsorg for det einskilde barnet

Me tilbyr: 

* Rettleiing for nyutdanna barnehagelærarar

* Eit inkluderande og trygt arbeidsmiljø med fokus på samarbeid og utvikling

* Høve til å bidra med eigen relevant kompetanse eller interesser

* Høve til å bli ein del av ein større kjede med stot fagleg fokus

* Gode løns- og pensjonsvilkår

* Eigne FUS-klede

Me ønskjer at du: 

* Er utdanna barnehagelærarar

* Har eit sterkt engasjement for barnehagefaget, og likar å halde deg fagleg oppdatert

* Er tilpassingsdyktig - du trivst i ein variert kvardag, er fleksibel og løysingsorientert i møte med barn, føresette og kollegaer

Søkjarar vil bli vurderte ut frå personlege eigenskapar, i tillegg til kompetanse og erfaring. 

Tilsetjing føreset godkjent politiattest i samsvar med barnehagelova, som må leverast før eventuell oppstart i stillinga.

jobs.title: LIS 2-3 Indremedisin Elverum
jobs.description:
Har du ønske om å jobbe i Sykehuset Innlandet og være med å levere gode og likeverdige helsetjenester til alle som trenger det? 


Medisinsk avdeling Elverum har lokalsykehusfunksjon for en befolkning på ca. 60 000 og gir mulighet for spesialistutdanning del 2 og del 3 i hovedspesialitetene generell indremedisin, kardiologi, fordøyelsessykdommer, geriatri, nefrologi og lunge. I samarbeid med de øvrige medisinske avdelingene i Sykehuset Innlandet kan vi etter avtale tilrettelegge for utdanning i andre medisinske spesialiteter som f.eks. akutt-og-mottaksmedisin, blodsykdommer, endokrinologi og infeksjon dersom det er ønske om dette. De fleste indremedisinske hovedspesialiteter krever en periode med suppleringstjeneste ved annet helseforetak i tillegg til tjeneste i Sykehuset Innlandet. For detaljer viser vi til de overordnede utdanningsplanene som er tilgjengelige på våre internettsider under "Jobbe i Sykehuset Innlandet/Utdanning og kompetanse/Spesialistutdanning for leger/Spesialistutdanning for LIS2 og LIS3
Avdlingen er seksjonert i hjerte-, lunge-, gastro- og nyreseksjon med dialyseenhet. Slagenhet med geriater er inkludert i avdelingen. Avdelingen dekker hele opptaksområdet i tidligere Hedmark fylke innenfor nefrologi, spesiell lungemedisin og implantasjon av pacemakere. LIS2/3 går i 11-delt sekundærvakt med aktiv tjeneste hele døgnet fordelt på dagvakt og nattevakt. LIS 1 i primærvakt og overlege i tertiærvakt samt nyrevakt med passiv tid på kveld/natt. Elverum sykehus er organisert i medisinsk klinikk og har tett samarbeid med Hamar sykehus.  


Elverum er en liten og hyggelig by ca. 3 mil fra Hamar, og en times kjøretur fra Gardermoen. Byen har gode kultur- og fritidstilbud, og ligger bare en times kjøring fra destinasjon Trysil med et stort aktivitetstilbud sommer som vinter.

jobs.title: Vastaanottovirkailija Aava Glass Igloosille – tule osaksi ainutlaatuista matkailukohdetta!
jobs.description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme Aava Glass Igloosille vastaanottovirkailijaa tulevaan talvisesonkiin.


Aava Glass Igloos tarjoaa vierailleen ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden kokea Lapin taian korkeatasoisessa majoitusympäristössä. Etsimme asiakaspalvelun ammattilaista, joka haluaa olla mukana luomassa vieraille unohtumattomia elämyksiä kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä.

Vastaanottovirkailijana toimit Aava Glass Igloosin käyntikorttina ja tärkeänä osana vieraskokemusta. Tässä tehtävässä toimit resortin kasvona ja tärkeänä osana vieraiden kokonaisvaltaista elämystä. Olet ensimmäinen henkilö, jonka vieraat kohtaavat saapuessaan, ja viimeinen, jonka he näkevät lähtiessään.


Siksi etsimme henkilöitä, jotka ovat luontevia ja elegantteja asiakaspalvelijoita, kykenevät luomaan vieraille lämpimän ja henkilökohtaisen vastaanoton sekä ymmärtävät luksusmatkailun korkeat palveluodotukset. Haluat ylittää asiakkaiden odotukset ja varmistaa, että jokainen vierailu jää mieleen poikkeuksellisen hyvänä kokemuksena.

Tehtävän kuvaus

Vastaanottovirkailijana vastaat vieraiden vastaanotosta ja heidän sujuvasta palvelukokemuksestaan koko vierailun ajan. Työskentelet osana ammattitaitoista vastaanottotiimiä kansainvälisessä ympäristössä, jossa palvelun laatu, yksityiskohtien huomioiminen ja erinomainen asiakaskokemus ovat keskeisessä roolissa.



Tehtäviisi kuuluvat

- vieraiden vastaanotto ja korkeatasoinen asiakaspalvelu
- sisään- ja uloskirjautumiset sekä maksutapahtumien käsittely
- varausten hallinta ja vastaanottojärjestelmien käyttö
- asiakkaiden neuvonta resortin palveluista, aktiviteeteista ja alueen nähtävyyksistä
- asiakkaiden toiveiden ja erityistarpeiden huomioiminen
- tiivis yhteistyö resortin muiden osastojen kanssa
- ensiluokkaisen palvelukokemuksen varmistaminen kaikissa tilanteissa


Etsimme sinua, joka

- olet luonteva, tyylikäs ja aidosti palveluhenkinen asiakaspalvelija
- viihdyt kansainvälisten asiakkaiden parissa
- osaat kohdata vieraat lämpimästi, ammattimaisesti ja yksilöllisesti
- tunnistat asiakkaiden tarpeita ja pystyt ennakoimaan niitä
- toimit rauhallisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti myös kiireellisissä tilanteissa
- työskentelet huolellisesti ja tarkasti järjestelmien sekä varausten parissa
- haluat olla osa laadukasta palvelukulttuuria


Edellytämme

- aiempaa kokemusta vastaanoton tehtävistä korkeatasoisessa hotellissa, resortissa tai muussa premium- tai luksusmatkailun toimintaympäristössä
- kokemusta vaativasta asiakaspalvelusta ja vahvaa palveluasennetta
- erinomaista englannin kielen taitoa
- hyviä tietoteknisiä valmiuksia ja kykyä omaksua uusia järjestelmiä
- täysi-ikäisyyttä
- omaa autoa työmatkojen sujuvuuden vuoksi
- Suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.


Tarjoamme

- mahdollisuuden työskennellä korkeatasoisessa ja kansainvälisessä resort-ympäristössä
- arvokasta kokemusta luksusmatkailun ja premium-palveluiden parissa
- ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön
- kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan
- mahdollisuuden kehittyä matkailu- ja hospitality-alan huippuammattilaisena


Työsuhteen tiedot

Työt alkavat 9.11.



Työsuhde on määräaikainen kausityö ja kestää maaliskuun loppuun saakka.

Palkkaus on sopimuspalkka, joka määräytyy kokemuksen, osaamisen ja aiemman työhistorian perusteella.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, sillä paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

Jos tunnistat itsesi laadukkaasta palveluasenteesta, viihdyt kansainvälisessä ympäristössä ja haluat olla mukana luomassa vieraille ainutlaatuisia elämyksiä maailmanlaajuisesti tunnetussa matkailukohteessa, kuulemme mielellämme juuri sinusta.

Hae jo tänään ja tule osaksi unohtumattomia vieraskokemuksia.

jobs.title: Security & Compliance Specialist - Gothenburg or Hälsingland
jobs.description:
Help us build trust, strengthen resilience, and shape the future of compliance in a growing software company.

At Bjorn Lunden, we develop software and services that help businesses manage critical financial and administrative processes. Every day, thousands of customers trust us with sensitive data and business-critical information, making security, transparency, and compliance a natural part of everything we do.

We're now looking for a Security & Compliance Specialist who wants to help strengthen our work within governance, risk, security, and compliance. If you enjoy turning regulatory requirements into practical business solutions and collaborating across both business and technology, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

As a Security & Compliance Specialist, you will play an important role in developing and strengthening Bjorn Lunden Group's work within information security, compliance, governance, and risk management.

Working closely with our Security & Compliance Officer and colleagues across IT, Development, Operations, Product, and Management, you will help ensure that our processes, controls, and regulatory requirements are translated into practical and effective ways of working.

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of business, technology, and regulation, supporting initiatives within ISO 27001, NIS2, DORA, GDPR, ISAE 3000, and AI governance while helping strengthen security and compliance across the Group.

You will:

    Support control monitoring, audit readiness, and ongoing compliance activities
    Maintain and improve policies, documentation, and governance processes
    Support process owners and stakeholders in strengthening governance, controls, and risk-based ways of working
    Contribute to compliance initiatives related to ISO 27001, NIS2, DORA, GDPR, and the EU AI Ac
    Monitor regulatory developments and help assess their impact on the business
    Perform gap analyses and follow up on improvement initiatives
    Advise stakeholders across the business on security, risk, and compliance matters
    Support customer audits, security questionnaires, and compliance inquiries
    Create awareness and training materials that strengthen security culture across the Group

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to build broad expertise within information security and compliance while working close to both technology and business.

About You

We're looking for someone who combines analytical thinking with strong collaboration and communication skills. You enjoy bringing structure to complexity and can translate security and compliance requirements into practical actions that support the business.

We believe you have:

    1-3 years of experience within information security, compliance, audit, risk management, privacy, or IT governance
    Knowledge of frameworks and regulations such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, ISAE 3000/3402, GDPR, or similar
    A structured and detail-oriented way of working
    Strong communication skills and the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders
    The confidence to challenge existing processes and identify opportunities for improvement
    Fluent Swedish and strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in Dutch or Danish is considered an advantage.

A degree within information security, IT, business administration, law, risk management, audit, or a related field is preferred, but we also value equivalent work experience and practical knowledge.

Certifications such as ISO 27001 Foundation, CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CISM, CIPP/E, CIPT, or similar are considered an advantage. Most importantly, you have a genuine interest in continuous learning and professional development within the security and compliance field.

Who We Are

We are Bjorn Lunden, the business platform that simplifies everyday life for small and medium-sized businesses. Our belief is simple: every business deserves opportunities to grow, and we’re here to make that happen 🐻.

We’re on an exciting journey. With bold ambitions, our vision is to become one of the leading providers of accounting and financial software solutions in Northwestern Europe. With our roots in Hälsingland, specifically in the small village of Näsviken, we’ve grown rapidly in recent years, transforming from a smaller national company into an international group. Today, we operate in Sweden, the Netherlands, and Denmark.

Our goal is straightforward: to make life a little easier for entrepreneurs and business owners. We believe we can do that through great software, knowledge, innovation, and TACO. Not the kind you might be thinking of - but our version: Trust, Ambition, Collaboration, and Ownership.

What We Offer

We offer you a role in an international, growing company with a strong market position and the ambition to challenge industry giants. The wellbeing of our employees truly matters to us, and we want to be a fair and responsible employer where people feel good and enjoy their work.

We strive for a healthy work-life balance and support this through competitive conditions and benefits and flexible work opportunities. We want to be the natural first choice for people who want to thrive and have fun at work.

Application

We are looking for a Security & Compliance Specialist located in Gothenburg, Stockholm, Hudiksvall, Näsviken, or Ljusdal.

The application deadline is 4th October 2026, but selection and interviews may take place on an ongoing basis. The position may therefore be filled before the deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the role, please contact:

Robert Dahlin, Group Head of IT Robert.Dahlin@bjornlunden.com

*For this recruitment, we kindly ask that recruitment agencies or other external partners refrain from contacting us.

St.Olavs hospital medtie 11 500 barkijh åtna jïh brutto budsjedte lea 14,6 millijardh kråvnine. Vielie bïevnesh sijjesne www.stolav.no

Gellievoetebæjhkoehtimmie

Mijjieh sïjhtebe barkijh edtjieh guvvine årrodh årroji gellievoeteste, jïh dan åvteste haestebe gaajhkesidie gïeh maehteles, barkoem mijjen luvnie ohtsedh, saaht mij tjoelide, aaltere, funksjovneheaptoe, nasjonaale jallh etnihkeles maadtoe. Seammalaakan jis datne guhkebe gaatoem barkoejieleden ålkolen åtneme.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja yövuoroihin Lappeenrantaan
jobs.description:
Hei avustajan työstä kiinnostunut, tule onnilaisten joukkoon tekemään tärkeää ja asiakaslähtöistä työtä avustajapalveluihin toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen!


HENKILÖKOHTAISIA AVUSTAJIA YÖVUOROIHIN – LAPPEENRANTA

Etsimme kahta luotettavaa ja rauhallista henkilökohtaista avustajaa yövuoroihin Lappeenrantaan.

Työ on itsenäistä henkilökohtaisen avustajan työtä, jossa tärkeää on asiakkaan turvallinen ja sujuva yö sekä hyvä ja luottamuksellinen yhteistyö.


MITÄ TOIVOMME SINULTA?

Olet luotettava, rauhallinen ja vastuuntuntoinen. Pystyt työskentelemään itsenäisesti ja kohtaat toisen ihmisen kunnioittavasti ja kiireettömästi.

Aikaisempi kokemus henkilökohtaisen avustajan työstä on eduksi, mutta asenne ja luotettavuus ovat tärkeimpiä. Perehdytämme sinut tehtävään.


TYÖ JA PALKKAUS

* Työpaikka: Lappeenranta

* Tehtävä: henkilökohtainen avustaja, yövuorot

* Avoimia työpaikkoja: 1-2

* Työvuorot: Yötyö

* Palkkaus: yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen (TES) mukaan

* Työn aloitus: Heti kun sopiva tekijä löytyy

Työvuoroista ja työjärjestelyistä sovitaan tarkemmin valittujen henkilöiden kanssa.


KIINNOSTUITKO?

Lähetä lyhyt esittely itsestäsi ja kerro, millaista kokemusta sinulla on sekä milloin pystyt työskentelemään yövuoroissa.

Olisi mukava kuulla sinusta!

Kaikki uudet avustajamme perehdytetään kattavasti Onnin omassa Avustaja Akatemiassa ennen työn aloittamista, ja perehdytys jatkuu tarpeesi mukaan myös työn aikana. Saat jatkuvan ohjauksen ja tuen omalta tiimiesihenkilöltäsi, etkä jää koskaan yksin kysymystesi tai mahdollisten työhön liittyvien haasteiden kanssa, siitä me huolehdimme!

Otamme huomioon sekä asiakkaidemme avustajatarpeet että avustajiemme työtoiveet niin, että ne sovitetaan mahdollisimman hyvin yhteen. Ensimmäinen vuoro asiakkaalle on tarvittaessa perehdytysvuoro, ja sen jälkeen sekä avustaja että asiakas voivat arvioida muun muassa yhteistyön sujuvuutta ja henkilökemioiden yhteensopivuutta. Mikäli myöhemmin koet, että jokin asia mietityttää tai ei toimi suunnitellusti, käsittelemme asian yhdessä ja etsimme sinulle sopivan ratkaisun. Halutessasi voit työskennellä Onnilla useammalle asiakkaalle, kun aikataulut sovitetaan yhteen.

TOIVOMME SINULTA

B2-tason suomen kielen taitoa

Ajokorttia ja oman auton käytön mahdollisuutta tarvittaessa

Täysi-ikäisyyttä


TARJOAMME SINULLE
