jobs.title: Drømmer du om en meningsfull jobb der du får gjøre en forskjell i andres liv hver eneste dag?
jobs.description:
Da kan dette være stillingen for deg. Vi trenger flere inn i teamet vårt, og ser etter vår nye koordinator. Som BPA-koordinator hos Prima Assistanse får du ansvar for din egen kundeportefølje og blir en viktig støtte for arbeidsledere og assistenter i hverdagen. Rollen passer godt for deg som liker å jobbe med mennesker, samtidig som du trives med struktur, koordinering og å finne gode løsninger på små og store utfordringer.


Vi ser etter deg som er trygg i møte med ulike mennesker, kommuniserer godt og evner å skape tillit. Du trives med ansvar, liker å ha mange kontaktflater og motiveres av å bidra til at mennesker lykkes i arbeid og hverdagsliv. En stor del av jobben handler om rekruttering av assistenter, der målet er å finne mennesker som passer godt sammen. Derfor trenger vi deg som evner å se andre menneskers behov og styrker, og som kan bistå med stillingsutlysninger og intervjuprosesser. Stillingen dekker et stort geografisk område fra Rognan i sør til Hammerfest i nord og Vadsø i øst. Det må derfor påregnes en del reisevirksomhet og bilkjøring. Det er en fordel om du disponerer egen bil og trives med en arbeidshverdag som til tider foregår ute hos kunder og samarbeidspartnere.


Dine arbeidsoppgaver vil blant annet være: 

  • Oppfølging og ansvar for egne arbeidsledere 
  • Råd, opplæring og veiledning til arbeidsledere og assistenter 
  • Bidra til gode samarbeidsforhold mellom arbeidsledere og assistenter 
  • Administrative oppgaver knyttet til BPA-ordninger og funksjonsassistanse, slik som onboarding og offboarding i systemer 
  • Bistå med oppsett av turnus 
  • Rekruttering og onboarding av assistenter 
  • Tilrettelegging av kurs og fellessamlinger 
  • Markedsføring av Prima Assistanse i regionen 

Arbeidstiden er hovedsakelig på dagtid, men noe kvelds- og helgearbeid må påregnes. 

 

Vi ser etter deg som: 

  • Er menneskeorientert, pedagogisk og trygg i veilederrollen 
  • Er åpen, løsningsorientert og finner gjerne løsninger utenfor boksen
  • Trives med en variert arbeidshverdag og mange oppgaver samtidig 
  • Er strukturert og selvstendig 
  • Følger rutiner og avtale prosesser 
  • Er serviceinnstilt, positiv og fleksibel 
  • Lærer nye datasystemer raskt, og er komfortabel med digitale verktøy da vi benytter ulike systemer i arbeidshverdagen. Du må gjerne være stødig på Microsoft Teams og Outlook. 
  • Behersker norsk muntlig og skriftlig, og gjør deg forstått av andre 

Erfaring med BPA er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det er også positivt om du har kjennskap til HR, arbeidsmiljøloven eller annet relevant lovverk.

 

Vi kan tilby

En stilling i en spennende og meningsfull rolle med gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling. Som BPA-koordinator får du en variert arbeidshverdag med stor grad av selvstendighet, samtidig som du har et sterkt faglig fellesskap rundt deg. Hos oss vil du bli en del av en gjeng som liker å ha mange baller i lufta, trives med oppsøkende virksomhet og har en genuin interesse for å tilpasse og se muligheter. Siden vi dekker et stort distrikt er vi ofte ute og reiser, men møtes på kontoret over en kaffe hvor latteren henger løst.


Lurer du på noe? Ta kontakt da vel! Vi vurderer kandidater fortløpende, så ikke nøl med å søke. Vi ønsker at du svarer på noen skriftlige spørsmål og ett videospørsmål. Du kan spille inn videoen så mange ganger du vil før du leverer den.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

I Prima Assistanse ser vi stor verdi av å være en mangfoldig organisasjon. Derfor ønsker vi at du uavhengig av etnisitet, alder, kjønn, legning, funksjonsnedsettelse, utdanning eller bakgrunn søker på jobb hos oss. Gjennom verdiene våre "humor, tillit, fleksibilitet og lagarbeid" jobber vi hver dag for at alle skal få frihet til å leve! BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. For mer informasjon: www.prima-assistanse.no

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow position in remote sensing and modeling of the cryosphere
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Postdoctoral Research Fellow position in remote sensing and modeling of the cryosphere, available at the Department of Geosciences, Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences.

Starting date as soon as possible.

The appointment is a full-time position and is for a period of three years (10% of which is devoted to other career-promoting work, usually in the form of teaching activities).

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Research Fellowship at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is Department of Geosciences at Blindern, Oslo.


Project description

The position is affiliated with the Department’s Section for Physical Geography and Hydrology, which has long-term experience in investigating the terrestrial cryosphere and is involved in various high-level research projects and centers. (See for instance http://www.mn.uio.no/geo/english/about/organisation/geohyd and https://www.mn.uio.no/geo/english/research/groups/remotesensing). We are a growing, lively, friendly and collaborative research environment in cold regions sciences, in particular in glaciology, remote sensing, geohazards, hydrology and geomatics. We participate in a number of international projects such that the successful candidate will have excellent opportunities to participate in international research networks. We also run an advanced drone lab on behalf of the entire faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences (https://www.mn.uio.no/geo/english/research/about/infrastructure/facilities/observations/geosciences/the-drone-infrastructure-laboratory/).

  • The position is embedded in a network of projects that involve remote sensing of the cryosphere and related data science methods: 
    the European Research Council (ERC) Synergy Grant SnowShifts with University of Oslo (Prof. A. Kääb), EPFL Sion and WSL/SLF (Prof. M. Lehning), and BOKU Vienna (Dr. F. Koch) as PI institutions, and GFZ Potsdam, CESBIO Toulouse and ANavS Munich as further key partners. (https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101224858) 
  • the SchmidtSciences project MountAInWater (lead: F. Pelliciotti, ISTA, and W. Immerzeel, Utrecht, and further PIs from Canada, Singapore, Netherlands, Switzerland, Norway and Germany.  (https://www.schmidtsciences.org/view/#modal-mountainwater-water-from-the-mountains-global-reanalysis-and-future-tipping-points) 
  • various ESA projects including Glaciers_CCI, Permafrost_CCI, Karakoram Anomaly, and the forthcoming EarthExplorer 10 mission Harmony. (https://climate.esa.int/en/projects/, https://climate.esa.int/en/Cross_ECV_Projects/ , https://www.esa.int/Applications/Observing_the_Earth/FutureEO/ESA_selects_Harmony_as_tenth_Earth_Explorer_mission)

The candidate will develop and apply cutting-edge remote sensing or photogrammetry methods, in combination with data science approaches such as machine learning and data assimilation via cryospheric models. A main focus of this work is snow and glaciers in the mountains around the globe. Candidates with relevant prior research experience in these areas will therefore be given preference. The candidate will have ample opportunities to collaborate internationally with other world-leading research environments and space agencies, and for field work in mountain environments and the Arctic.

The exact focus of the position and its primary project affiliation will be developed together with the successful candidate.

The main purpose of a postdoctoral fellowship is to provide the candidates with enhanced skills to pursue a scientific top position within or beyond academia. To promote a strategic career path, all postdoctoral research fellows are required to submit a professional development plan no later than one month after commencement of the postdoctoral period.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in geomatics, geosciences, geophysics, environmental sciences, computer/data science or relevant topics in other fields. Doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defence are eligible for appointment
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.
  • Must document a strong quantitative background and interest in remote sensing or photogrammetry, and related data science approaches, and a strong interest in geosciences/climate sciences.
  • Must document scientific programming experience, specifically for data processing, analysis, or modeling of the cryosphere.
  • The candidate must have proof of excellence in research as demonstrated through publications in refereed journals and presentations at scholarly conferences. The candidate’s publication record must show evidence of creativity and capability of independent research.

Desired qualifications:

  • Good knowledge about cryospheric and mountain processes.
  • Interest and willingness for, or experience with, field work in high-mountain/cold environments is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in automated processing of large data volumes such as Earth observation data is beneficial. 
  • It is an advantage if potential previous experience with data science approaches includes the application of Bayesian inference or probabilistic machine learning to geophysical models.
  • Previous experience with or strong interest in Bayesian inference or probabilistic machine learning is beneficial.

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • You share our genuine enthusiasm for the cryosphere, and the technologies and methods to observe and understand its changes.
  • You are a person who prefers being present at work and actively contributes to the professional and social environment you are a part of.
  • You are able to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • You look forward to working in an interdisciplinary and international scientific environment.

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Postdoctoral development programmes.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK 595 000 - 690 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copies of educational certificates, academic transcript of records
  • A complete list of publications and up to 5 academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Please see the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Postdoctoral fellowships at the University of Oslo.

If an applicant has applied for and been granted funding for a fulltime research stay abroad while being employed as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, the employment will be prolonged with the equivalent time as the research stay, but for no longer than of twelve months ( thus extending the employment to a maximum of four years)

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results a.o.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The geosciences are the studies of the planet Earth and its comparative planetology; the atmosphere, the hydrosphere and cryosphere, the Earth's surface and its interior. The Department of Geosciences conducts research and teaching in most of the domains of geoscience; geology, geophysics, physical geography, geomatics, hydrology, meteorology and oceanography. The Department is the broadest geoscience research and education environment in Norway. We perform research at a high international standard and have five ERC (European Research Council) research projects ongoing.

The Department encompasses six scientific sections; Meteorology and Oceanography, Geography and Hydrology, Study of sedimentary basins, Environmental geosciences. and Crustal Processes. We host now a third in the line of three Centre of Excellences:  PHAB – Centre for Planetary Habitability, and have a Norwegian Research School for PhD students (Research School for Dynamics and Evolution of Earth and Planets, DEEP).

The Department aims to contribute to the new and important UN Sustainability Development Goals, and are important contributors to IPCC (UN’s Inter-governmental Panel on Climate Change). The staff consists of 40 professors and associate professors, in addition to postdoctoral fellows, PhD students, researchers, technical- and administrative staff. The Department has around 200 employees.

jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead complex, global technology transfers that make a real difference to patients? As Associate Director, Packaging Tech Transfer Lead, you will drive the transfer of packaging technologies across AstraZeneca's diverse product portfolio, working with pioneering products and cross-functional teams around the world. This is a unique opportunity to influence strategic decisions, shape future ways of working, and deliver medicines safely and reliably to patients!



Your role and accountabilities

In this role, you will:

    Lead packaging technology transfers for vials, APFS, and autoinjector presentations across internal and external manufacturing sites.
    Own end-to-end transfer activities, including labelling, secondary packaging, device assembly, documentation, readiness, and implementation.
    Assess site capabilities and readiness, including equipment, process fit, capacity, technical maturity, materials, and operational risks.
    Develop robust transfer plans in collaboration with Technical Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Device teams, Drug Product, Engineering, and external partners.
    Ensure GMP and regulatory compliance by embedding quality, risk management, and inspection readiness into transfer activities.
    Provide oversight of packaging process readiness, including line readiness, process validation considerations, comparability, material readiness, and transfer documentation.
    Support device and combination product transfers, considering the interfaces between the primary container, device components, assembly operations, packaging configuration, and market requirements.
    Consider drug product requirements and their impact on packaging configuration, handling, process conditions, product protection, and transfer strategy.
    Contribute to shipping qualification and distribution readiness, including transport validation, distribution conditions, and product protection requirements.
    Lead risk and issue management by identifying critical risks, defining mitigation plans, and calling out decisions when needed.
    Influence strategic decisions related to transfer approach, site selection, execution priorities, and risk management.
    Drive continuous improvement by simplifying, standardising, and improving packaging transfer processes, governance, and ways of working.
    Champion digital enablement, including the use of Digital TT and other digital tools to improve visibility, data quality, knowledge management, and execution efficiency.
    Lead through a matrix organisation, creating clarity, aligning stakeholders, and maintaining momentum across functions, sites, countries, and external partners.

Essential requirements

You will bring:

    Significant experience (typically 5-10 years) within CMC, pharmaceutical packaging, technology transfer, manufacturing science and technology, technical operations, or a related field, supported by a Bachelor's or equivalent in a relevant scientific or engineering field.
    Proven experience leading packaging technology transfers involving vials, APFS, autoinjectors, or similar presentations, with a strong understanding of labelling and packaging operations, device assembly where applicable, and associated transfer requirements.
    Strong technical knowledge of GMP, quality systems, regulatory expectations, and manufacturing environments, including line readiness, validation, change control, process performance, material flows, and operational risk management.
    Experience assessing manufacturing site capabilities and readiness, including technical fit, operational capacity, execution risk, and the successful planning and delivery of manufacturing transfers.
    A solid understanding of drug product considerations relevant to packaging transfers, including the relationship between formulation, primary packaging, process conditions, product protection, shipping qualification, and distribution requirements.
    Demonstrated leadership, influencing, and communication skills, with the ability to lead through ambiguity, engage stakeholders without direct authority, and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.
    Strong collaboration skills and experience working across functions, cultures, geographies, and organisational boundaries to deliver business outcomes.
    An improvement attitude with the ability to simplify processes, develop scalable ways of working, and embrace digital tools and digital ways of working, particularly Digital TT.



Desirable requirements

    Experience with combination products, biologics packaging, or other complex pharmaceutical product environments, including device-related manufacturing and assembly operations.
    Experience leading transfers across internal manufacturing sites and external contract manufacturing organisations, supporting global supply networks, product launches, and lifecycle change management.
    Experience working with Global CMC teams and translating CMC priorities into practical transfer plans, supported by experience using digital technology transfer tools or similar systems to manage transfer activities, data, actions, and documentation.

What's next

Own the transfers that keep medicines on shelves and launches on time-send your CV to lead the next wave of digital, data-driven tech transfer excellence.

Welcome with your application, no later than 20th of September. Interviews will be held continuously so don't hesitate to apply!

jobs.title: Bli min nye assistent - lek, lær og vær en del av min hverdag!🌸
jobs.employer: MIO BPA AS AVD KONTOR OSLO
jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest
📌 Stillingstype: Fast og tilkalling
⏰ Arbeidstid: Ettermiddager i ukedager, dagtid i helger


Hei!

Jeg er en glad og sprudlende jente på 8 år som bor sammen med familien min på Blaker, utenfor Lillestrøm. Jeg er glad i å leke og være sosial, og jeg hilser gjerne på folk og dyr. Vi bor litt landlig til, så du må ha egen bil for å komme deg til og fra jobb. Jeg er glad i fysisk aktivitet som sykling, gå turer og leke ute på lekeplass, så vel som bordaktiviteter som plastilina og perling. Liker også godt å leke med bamser og dukker/ dyr. Selv om jeg ikke alltid forstår sosiale regler, vil jeg veldig gjerne være med på leken. Om du blir min assistent, håper jeg at du kan hjelpe meg med å bli mer selvstendig, ta initiativ til lek og ha det gøy sammen med meg!

Kognitivt går ting litt langsommere for meg, men motorisk fungerer jeg som en helt vanlig åtteåring. Jeg har et lite verbalt språk og kommuniserer hovedsakelig gjennom lyder, mimikk og kroppsspråk. Som assistent vil du ofte gjenta det jeg uttrykker og støtte kommunikasjonen min ved hjelp av ASK - for eksempel piktogrammer, talemaskin og tegn til tale. Jeg viser deg gjerne hva jeg trenger i form av håndleding, peking, lyder og mimikk. Noen ganger tar jeg deg i armen eller peker for å få deg med. Etter hvert som du blir kjent med meg, vil du stadig lettere forstå signalene mine og hva jeg ønsker å formidle.

Jeg trenger en trygg voksen som kan bistå meg til å bli mer selvstendig i hverdagslige gjøremål og tilrettelegge i forbindelse med blant annet matsituasjoner og personlig stell. Jeg lærer gjennom å herme og trenger deg som gir meg positiv veiledning og oppmuntring.

Stilling og arbeidstid:

Jeg søker én fast assistent til 18 timer per uke. Stillingen innebærer arbeid i turnus med følgende vakter:

  • Annen hver helg, lørdag og søndag, kl. 12/13.00-18/19.00

  • Mandag, tirsdag og torsdag kl.15.00-19.00

I tillegg søker jeg en fleksibel tilkallingsvikar som kan stille opp ved behov og på kort varsel.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

• Leke og ta initiativ til ulike aktiviteter (med ASK- opplæring vil bli gitt)

• Tilrettelegge i matsituasjoner og personlig stell

• Bistå meg til å bli mer selvstendig i hverdagslige gjøremål

• Være en trygg og støttende person i hverdagen

• Delta i min hverdag; dette inkluderer lek både inne og ute

Hvem er du? Jeg ser etter en assistent som er:

• Engasjert og tilstedeværende

• Tålmodig og villig til å lære

• Omsorgsfull og leken

• Trygg og ansvarlig

Kvalifikasjoner:

• Førerkort klasse B (må ha egen bil)

• Fri vandel (kunne fremvise politiattest ved forespørsel)

• Erfaring med barn er en fordel

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper jeg du søker! Jeg gleder meg til å få en ny assistent som kan bli en del av min hverdag.

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Hanna Brurås på epost: hanna.bruras@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

jobs.title: Sales Advisor 25h - Permanent contract
jobs.employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a H&M Sales Advisor, you will be essential in delivering an exceptional shopping experience. Some of your responsibilities will include:

    Representing the H&M Brand positively and engaging with our customers to provide an excellent service and an exciting shopping experience.
    Supporting with commercial and operational actions together with your colleagues, to reach store goals and sales targets.
    Keep informed about the latest fashion trends, brands and competitors, using your knowledge to inspire and guide our customers.
    Providing and receiving feedback to support yourself and your colleagues to learn and develop.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

Our stores are the heart of our company, where customers will experience our brand firsthand. Being part of a dynamic Store Team, which include, Sales Advisors, Team Leaders, Department Managers, Visual Merchandisers and Store Managers, together you will create an inspirational environment for our customer and colleagues.

WHO YOU ARE

We welcome applicants who are:

    Passionate about people and fashion.
    Self-motivated and able to motivate others to ensure strong teamwork.
    Clear communicators, creative and curious.
    Motivated to contribute to H&M's vision, leading us to success.

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

     All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online.
    In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

This is a permanent position offering 25 hours per week with start in October or by agreement. This position is based in Vetlanda and you should be able to work during store opening hours. Language skills in Swedish or English is needed.

We have an ongoing selection, so the position may be filled before the application deadline, so send in your application today! The last application date is 10/8.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

* Store roles assessment:

To manage the high volume of applications for the Sales Advisor role, we use an online assessment method for skills-based recruitment within some of our stores. You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies predefined criteria set by H&M Group. Please look out for an email in your inbox/junk email from MAKI.

After completing the assessment, you’ll have the opportunity to share feedback and ask questions. If you experience any difficulties or prefer an alternative assessment method, please contact recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative will not impact on your application.

For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.

** We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in remote sensing of the cryosphere
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for position as PhD Research Fellow in remote sensing of the cryosphere at the Department of Geosciences, Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences.

Starting date as soon as possible.

The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year may be considered, and it will involve 25 % of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualifications of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.
Place of work is department of Geosciences, Oslo.


Job description

The position is affiliated with the Department’s Section for Physical Geography and Hydrology, which has long-term experience in investigating the terrestrial cryosphere and is involved in various high-level research projects and centers. (See for instance http://www.mn.uio.no/geo/english/about/organisation/geohyd and https://www.mn.uio.no/geo/english/research/groups/remotesensing). We are a growing, lively, friendly and collaborative research environment in cold regions sciences, in particular in glaciology, remote sensing, geohazards, hydrology and geomatics. We participate in a number of international projects such that the successful candidate will have excellent opportunities to participate in international research networks. We also run an advanced drone lab on behalf of the entire faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences (https://www.mn.uio.no/geo/english/research/about/infrastructure/facilities/observations/geosciences/the-drone-infrastructure-laboratory/).

The position is embedded in a network of projects that involve remote sensing of the cryosphere and related data science methods: 

  • the European Research Council (ERC) Synergy Grant SnowShifts with University of Oslo (Prof. A. Kääb), EPFL Sion and WSL/SLF (Prof. M. Lehning), and BOKU Vienna (Dr. F. Koch) as PI institutions, and GFZ Potsdam, CESBIO Toulouse and ANavS Munich as further key partners. (https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101224858) 
  •  the SchmidtSciences project MountAInWater (lead: F. Pelliciotti, ISTA, and W. Immerzeel, Utrecht, and further PIs from Canada, Singapore, Netherlands, Switzerland, Norway and Germany.  (https://www.schmidtsciences.org/view/#modal-mountainwater-water-from-the-mountains-global-reanalysis-and-future-tipping-points) 
  • various ESA projects including Glaciers_CCI, Permafrost_CCI, Karakoram Anomaly, and the forthcoming EarthExplorer 10 mission Harmony. (https://climate.esa.int/en/projects/, https://climate.esa.int/en/Cross_ECV_Projects/ , https://www.esa.int/Applications/Observing_the_Earth/FutureEO/ESA_selects_Harmony_as_tenth_Earth_Explorer_mission)

The candidate will develop and apply cutting-edge remote sensing or photogrammetry methods, in combination with data science approaches such as machine learning and data assimilation via cryospheric models. A main focus of this work is snow and glaciers in the mountains around the globe. Candidates with relevant prior research experience in these areas will therefore be given preference. The candidate will have ample opportunities to collaborate internationally with other world-leading research environments and space agencies, and for field work in mountain environments and the Arctic.

The exact focus of the position and its primary project affiliation will be developed together with the successful candidate. 


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in in geomatics, geosciences, computer science/data science/statistics, physics, mathematics, environmental sciences, geophysics or similar. Candidates must have submitted and defended their Master’s degree before the starting date.
  • Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Must document a strong quantitative background and interest in one or several remote sensing and data science approaches.  
  • Must document scientific programming skills, specifically for data processing and analysis of large datasets.
  • Evidence of creativity and capability of independent research.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Desired qualifications:

  • It is an advantage if the required remote sensing or photogrammetry experience is within satellite-based observation of Earth surface processes, using optical, radar or lidar methods.
  • Good knowledge about cryospheric and mountain processes.
  • Previous experience with data assimilation and numerical modeling will be regarded as positive in the selection process.
  • Experience in automated processing of large data volumes. 
  • Experience with scientific publishing is regarded as beneficial.
  • Interest and willingness for, or experience with, field work in high-mountain/cold environments is an advantage. 

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • You share our genuine enthusiasm for the cryosphere, and the technologies and methods to observe and understand its changes
  • You are a person who prefers being present at work and actively contributes to the professional and social environment you are a part of
  • You are able to work both independently and as part of a team
  • You look forward to work in an interdisciplinary and international scientific environment

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Career development programmes.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities.
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter - statement of motivation and research interests
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • Copies of the original Bachelor and Master’s degree diploma and transcripts of records
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".
Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The geosciences are the studies of the planet Earth and its comparative planetology; the atmosphere, the hydrosphere and cryosphere, the Earth's surface and its interior. The Department of Geosciences conducts research and teaching in most of the domains of geoscience; geology, geophysics, physical geography, geomatics, hydrology, meteorology and oceanography. The Department is the broadest geoscience research and education environment in Norway. We perform research at a high international standard and have five ERC (European Research Council) research projects ongoing.

The Department encompasses six scientific sections; Meteorology and Oceanography, Geography and Hydrology, Study of sedimentary basins, Environmental geosciences. and Crustal Processes. We host now a third in the line of three Centre of Excellences:  PHAB – Centre for Planetary Habitability, and have a Norwegian Research School for PhD students (Research School for Dynamics and Evolution of Earth and Planets, DEEP).

The Department aims to contribute to the new and important UN Sustainability Development Goals, and are important contributors to IPCC (UN’s Inter-governmental Panel on Climate Change). The staff consists of 40 professors and associate professors, in addition to postdoctoral fellows, PhD students, researchers, technical- and administrative staff. The Department has around 200 employees.

jobs.title: Vill du vara med och bidra till förändring i människors liv?
jobs.description:
Vi söker nu engagerade och drivna timvikarier till båda våra två enheter i Hunnebostrand och i Surte.

Vår värdegrund

På Nya Tag utgår vi från varje människas lika värde och rätt till ett värdigt liv. Vi möter alla individer med respekt, värme och professionalism. Vi tror på människors förmåga till förändring och utveckling, oavsett livssituation eller bakgrund.

Vårt arbete präglas av kunskap, delaktighet, tydlighet och trygghet. Genom ett ödmjukt och lyhört förhållningssätt skapar vi förutsättningar för hållbar förändring och ökad självständighet för de individer som bor hos oss.

Om oss

Nya Tag är en del av Evidra Omsorg som är en samlad aktör inom HVB, behandling och omsorg med grund i värdeorden evidens, relation och ansvar. Bakom Evidra Omsorg står ett erfaret team med bakgrund inom individ- och familjeomsorg med fokus på behandling. Vi tror på hållbar förändring genom kunskap, engagemang och goda relationer.

Nya Tag har två enheter en i Hunnebostrand och en i Surte samt ett stödboende som erbjuder stöd, behandling och rehabilitering för män i åldern 21–59 år med missbruks- och beroendeproblematik. Vårt arbete syftar till att ge varje individ förutsättningar att skapa ett drogfritt, meningsfullt och självständigt liv.

Hos oss på Nya Tag finns ett engagerat team med lång erfarenhet från socialt arbete, behandling och omsorg. Vi kombinerar beprövade metoder med ett individanpassat arbetssätt där varje persons behov, resurser och mål står i centrum.

Vi är en arbetsplats som präglas av engagemang, samarbete och delaktighet. Vi värdesätter en god arbetsmiljö där medarbetare stöttar varandra, delar med sig av sin kompetens och bidrar till verksamhetens fortsatta utveckling.

Timvikarierande behandlare

Vi söker timvikarier som vill vara en del av vårt arbete med att stödja och motivera män på väg mot ett liv utan missbruk och beroende.

Som behandlare hos oss arbetar du nära våra klienter i deras vardag. Du fungerar som ett stöd i förändringsprocessen och arbetar utifrån individuella genomförandeplaner och uppsatta mål. Arbetsuppgifterna innefattar bland annat motiverande samtal, praktiskt stöd, social träning, aktiviteter, dokumentation samt samverkan med olika aktörer kring klienten.

Arbetstiderna är varierande och kan omfatta dag, kväll, helg samt jourtjänstgöring.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som är trygg, stabil och har ett genuint intresse för människor och förändringsarbete. Du har ett professionellt bemötande, god samarbetsförmåga och förmåga att skapa förtroendefulla relationer.

Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av arbete inom missbruksvård, psykiatri, HVB-verksamhet, socialt arbete eller liknande verksamheter. Du är flexibel, ansvarstagande och kan hantera utmanande situationer på ett lugnt och respektfullt sätt.

B-körkort är ett krav.

Utdrag ur belastning- och misstankeregister är ett krav.

Krav på utbildning

Vi söker dig som har en pågående eller avslutad eftergymnasial utbildning inom socialt arbete, socialpedagogik, beteendevetenskap, behandlingspedagogik eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig.

Vad säger våra medarbetare?

"Nya Tag är en arbetsplats där vi arbetar tillsammans mot samma mål – att skapa möjligheter till förändring för de människor vi möter. Här får jag använda min kompetens, utvecklas i min yrkesroll och samtidigt vara en del av ett engagerat team. Det bästa med arbetet är att få följa människors utveckling och se hur små steg framåt kan göra stor skillnad i deras liv."

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan.

Varmt välkommen!

jobs.title: Project Engineer – Vaasa
jobs.description:
About the role

In this position, you will become part of a close-knit and experienced team of experts. We are looking for a long-term addition to the team: someone for whom this role offers an inspiring next step in their career, and who wants to thrive and grow in the position for years to come.

What We Offer You
- Salary: Approximately €2,800 – €3,500/month depending on your experience and background.
- A long-term career path: We offer a role where you are invested in and where you can genuinely deepen your professional skills over the long term.
- Responsibility and freedom: Once you prove your skills, you will have the freedom to independently drive your projects to completion.
- Comprehensive support: Although we expect an ability to work independently, you will not be left alone. Your supervisor and a team of top professionals will support your success, especially during the onboarding phase in the first few months.

Work tasks

Your role is not pure design work in front of a screen; instead, you will act as a dynamic technical coordinator. Working as the Project Manager's right hand, you will be responsible for the technical success of energy plant lifecycle upgrades and automation retrofits in accordance with contract specifications.
- Guide and supervise design work, review electrical and automation drawings, and ensure the technical correctness of procurements.
- Act as a knowledgeable link between designers, logistics, subcontractors, and international customers.
- Depending on the size of the projects, you may manage several (max. 10) smaller automation upgrades simultaneously or extensive plant retrofit projects (from foundations up to the MV side).

What We Are Looking For

In this role, technical theory alone is not enough; you need a professional approach and strong drive to push things forward. You are no longer a complete beginner—you have already gained valuable experience and now want to take on broader responsibility.

To succeed in the position, we expect you to have:
- A solid professional foundation: You hold a relevant technical degree (e.g., Electrical or Automation Engineering, B.Sc. or M.Sc.) and previous work experience (e.g., a few years) in industry, commissioning, field service, or automation projects.
- The right personality: You are stress-tolerant and understand that the project world evolves daily. You are a proactive expert who also knows how to justify technical choices constructively and firmly.
- Language skills: Fluent spoken and written English is mandatory. Finnish language skills are considered a major asset in teamwork.

Vaasa is the Heart of This Role

This is a role where you grow into an expert and solve challenges together with the team on site. We strongly believe that the deepest expertise and best support are transferred most effectively when working alongside more experienced colleagues. Therefore, we expect you to work mainly at the Vaasa office. We are not looking for a remote worker for this position, but rather a team player who enjoys communal daily life on site. The position also includes occasional travel to global customer sites (estimated at approx. 30 travel days per year).

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Klargjører

Arbeidssted: Bodø lufthavn

Arbeidstid: Rullerende vaktplan (dag, kveld, helg)

Oppstart: Så snart som mulig - intervjuer kjøres fortløpende

Stillingsprosent: 100%

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som klargjører er du ansvarlig for at våre leiebiler er klargjort og vasket i henhold til standard. I samarbeid med våre utleierepresentanter planlegger du behovet for leiebiler og leverer disse i henhold til plan. Du har også ansvar for produkter (barneseter, skistativ mm), skaderegistrering, oppfølging av servicer og dekkomlegg i samarbeid med stasjonsleder. Det vil også være dager hvor du møter våre kunder og må hjelpe disse på en best mulig måte. 

  • Klargjøre leiebiler i henhold til våre standarder (vask mm)

  • Yte utmerket kundeservice i alle situasjoner 

  • Oversikt og kontroll på bestillinger og tilgjengelig bilpark

  • Oversikt og kontroll på skader, servicestatus og dekklager

  • Skifte dekk ved dekk omlegg

  • Holde orden i utstyr og på arbeidsplassen

Kvalifikasjoner

Som klargjører har ansvar for standarden på produktet vi leverer til våre kunder. Vår hverdag styres av våre kunders behov, og din evne til å arbeide hurtig og nøyaktig er avgjørende for den kvalitet vi leverer. 

  • Minimum førerkort klasse B (manuelt og automatgir)

  • Plettfri vandel (politiattest)

  • Hurtig og nøyaktig med stor fysisk arbeidskapasitet

  • Strukturert med ordenssans

  • Flytende norsk / engelsk muntlig og skriftlig

  • Datakunnskaper (Microsoft Office). 

Vi tilbyr

Som ansatt i Sixt Bilutleie vil du være del av en organisasjon med flinke kolleger som alle ønsker å yte det beste for våre kunder. Som del av et team vil din innsats utgjøre en forskjell, og verdsettes deretter. Vi har gode trenings- og utvekslingsprogram som alle våre ansatte følger. For den rette vil det også være utviklingsmuligheter innen organisasjonen. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. jobs.title: BIM Coordinator, Granlund
jobs.description:
**Looking for a role where you can take ownership of BIM coordination in large-scale construction projects? We are now looking for a BIM Coordinator to join Granlund!**

**_Granlund_** _is a rapidly growing expert organization in the real estate and construction sector. Together with our clients and stakeholders, we are building a sustainable and intelligent future. Our more than 1,600 professionals serve across 30 locations throughout Finland._

**Would you be our new BIM Coordinator?**

As a BIM Coordinator, you will take responsibility for the technical coordination and quality assurance of BIM models across a variety of construction projects, including data center, commercial, and residential developments. Acting as the project's BIM expert, you will ensure that models meet project requirements and support smooth collaboration between all stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Your responsibilities include coordinating BIM activities, leading model review meetings, and ensuring the technical quality of BIM models throughout different project phases. You will also support designers and project teams with BIM-related questions and help ensure that project requirements are met consistently across all disciplines.

You will work closely with the Project Manager, who is primarily involved during the early phases of the project. As the project progresses, you will take primary responsibility for its technical responsibilities. You will typically work on several projects simultaneously, supporting Project Managers, designers, contractors, and clients throughout different project phases while acting as a key link between stakeholders.

The position is a full-time and permanent role, and you will be employed directly by Granlund. The role offers a highly flexible working model with the possibility to work remotely from anywhere in Finland. You may also work from any Granlund office according to your own preference. Occasional travel to project sites across Finland is expected as part of the role.

**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for a BIM professional who can work independently and confidently guide projects through BIM-related matters. You have at least two years of experience in BIM coordination and understand how construction projects progress from design through execution. Experience in commercial construction projects is particularly valuable, while experience in data center projects is considered an advantage.

A relevant educational background in construction or engineering is required. Strong Solibri expertise is essential for success in this role, while experience with Navisworks and Revit is a plus. BIM Coordinator certification is an advantage, but not required. Most importantly, you understand BIM processes and can ensure the technical quality of project models. You communicate fluently in both Finnish and English.

As a person, you are proactive, analytical, and comfortable taking responsibility for your work. You are able to work independently when needed, but also collaborate effectively with others. You have the confidence to raise issues, challenge assumptions, and communicate openly when challenges arise.

**Why join us?**

At Granlund, you will work in a company that has been a pioneer in Finnish building services engineering for decades. You will contribute to demanding and large-scale projects such as data centers and commercial environments, where your work truly matters. As one of the leading data center design and consulting companies in the Nordics, we offer long-term career opportunities in a rapidly growing field, where projects are becoming increasingly significant in scale and impact. You will have strong opportunities to grow and develop your expertise, with career paths that can be shaped around your strengths and interests.

We place real emphasis on employee well-being, continuous learning, and a supportive, professional work environment. You will be part of a collaborative and ambitious team where people take ownership, share knowledge, and work together toward common goals.

The monthly salary for this position is approximately 4000 euros, depending on the candidate's experience and skills.

**Are you interested?**

Could you be our new colleague? Please submit your application via the link either in English or Finnish as soon as possible, but no later than 25.9.2026. We will begin interviews during the application period.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information, please contact Biisonis Recruitment Consultant Nea Repo (**nea.repo@biisoni.fi**).

jobs.title: Kranförare
jobs.description:
Företag: Stuveribolaget

Arbetsplats: Varberg

Om företaget:

Stuveribolaget är ett ledande bemanningsföretag som erbjuder kompletta bemanningslösningar till svenska hamnar. Med många års erfarenhet inom branschen är vi specialister på att tillhandahålla kvalificerad personal för alla typer av hamnarbete. Vi erbjuder kompletta kundanpassade lösningar för att lösa bemanning och skiftgång vid arbetstoppar ute i hamnarna. Stuveribolaget befinner sig i en tillväxtfas, vi är en liten organisation vilket medför en nära relation till arbetstagaren där beslutsvägarna är korta och flexibiliteten är stor. Stuveribolaget värnar om en god arbetsmiljö, ett gott arbetsklimat. Vi är övertygade om individens möjlighet att påverka verksamheten och utveckla arbetet bidrar till både personlig utveckling såväl som att föra bolaget framåt.

Om tjänsten:

Stuveribolaget söker nu erfarna och engagerade kranförare för att stärka vårt team. Arbetet består i huvudsak av lastning och lossning av fartyg, främst med vikarmskran. Utöver hamnarbetet förekommer krankörning även i andra verksamheter, där det främst är skrot, bulkmaterial och skogsprodukter som hanteras. Erfarenhet av hamnkran är meriterande.

Arbetstiderna är oregelbundna. Resor samt övernattningar förekommer i tjänsten då vi är verksamma på flera orter med Varberg som utgångspunkt. Vid anställning kommer arbetsgivaren kräva utdrag ur belastningsregistret då vi är verksamma inom hamnar klassade som skyddsobjekt.

Kvalifikationer:

Vi söker dig som har god erfarenhet av materialhanterare (vikarmskran). Har du dessutom erfarenhet av hamnkran är det extra meriterande. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper för att passa in i teamet.

•    Erfarenhet av materialhanterare (vikarmskran) – krav

•    Erfarenhet av hamnkran/fartygskran är meriterande

•    Giltigt utbildningsbevis/kranförarbevis för aktuell krantyp

•    Körkort

jobs.title: Product Manager - Discover
jobs.description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.


Your Mission

As the Product Manager for the Discover squad, you will focus on the upper funnel of the passenger journey. Your mission is to capture global traffic via SEO and emerging LLM-based search (GEO), ensuring passengers have a seamless experience when they land on our platform. You will build a vision that maximizes conversion from all acquisition channels, prioritizing high-impact projects across our core markets.

The Team

  • The Demand Team: The Discover squad is a core team of the Demand pillar, owning the end-to-end passenger experience alongside Search, Booking, Payment, and Post-booking.

  • Your Squad: You will co-lead the Discover squad alongside an Engineering Manager. The squad consists of 6 front-end engineers.

  • Internal Stakeholders: Product Marketing, SEO and Digital Marketing Managers, Product Data, Product Design, and Business leads.


Your Responsibilities
  • Shape the Discover strategy & roadmap: Define the Product and Engineering vision for the Discover scope, along with the appropriate KPIs to measure progress. You will take full responsibility for your scope from strategy to execution.
  • Drive top-funnel acquisition: Partner with the Marketing and SEO teams to define and deliver the acquisition roadmap. This includes adapting our architecture for the AI era to ensure our inventory is easily crawlable by LLMs and AI agents.
  • Maximize landing page conversion: Define and deliver a strategy to optimize the landing experience and maximize conversion from all channels. You will leverage AB tests to run experiments and drive our Land-to-Book conversion targets.
  • Navigate cross-functional alignment: Act as the go-to product person for all Discover topics. Communicate the strategy, formalize major decisions, and ensure alignment across Engineering, Marketing, Design, Data, and Business teams.
  • Manage the Busfor platform: Act as the referent Product Manager for Busfor, a standalone brand acquired and owned by BlaBlaCar operating in Eastern Europe

    • Your Qualifications
  • Experience: 3+ years of Product Management. An experience in top-of-funnel acquisition, growth, or SEO is preferred but not required.
  • Problem-Solving: Highly analytical with a proven track record of using A/B testing to deliver fast, incremental impact on conversion rates.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Strong interpersonal skills to navigate cross-functional relationships, gain buy-in, and clearly communicate prioritization decisions.
  • Languages: Full fluency in English is mandatory.
    • If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application!

    What we have to offer
  • 2 to 3 days at the office per week
  • 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves
  • 50% healthcare coverage (Alan)
  • Financial support for home office equipment
  • Minimum 25 days holiday per year
  • Local meal plan policy (Swile card)
  • 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)
  • Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides

    • Interested in joining the ride? Here’s what your hiring journey will look like.
  • A 45-min video-call with Talent Acquisition.
  • A 45-minute video call with the Lead Product Manager.
  • Remote use case exercise, followed by a 45-minute presentation to a cross-functional panel of key stakeholders.
  • 30-minute video call with the CPO for final validation
    • Our hiring process lasts on average 20-25 days and offers usually come within 48 hours.

jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Chinese, Swedish & English speaking Facility Coordinator/Services Specialist for a company in Gothenburg. Start is November 15th, 7 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg.

Assignment description

Seeking an experienced Facility Services Specialist to develop and maintain tenant-facing facility services in a modern multi-tenant innovation campus environment. The assignment focuses on service innovation, tenant experience, service agreements, supplier performance, customer administration, and continuous improvement across the campus.

﻿

Scope, Responsibilities and Duties

Facility Service Delivery & Continuous Improvement

    

Drive innovation, development, and strategic improvement of tenant-facing facility services within a multi-tenant innovation campus environment.

    

Lead improvement initiatives in public areas and coordinate service-related processes, signage, workflows, and operational documentation.

    

Provide workplace and office management expertise to customers, including guidance related to workplace regulations.

﻿

Service Agreements, Commercial Handling & Customer Administration

    

Prepare proposals and manage the signing, maintenance, and updating of service agreements with tenants.

    

Maintain customer records with accurate service levels, pricing, and operational details, and propose service adjustments when needed.

    

Manage service-related budgets, cost structures, business models, customer invoicing frameworks, and support leasing agreements when required.

﻿

Supplier Management & Service Quality Assurance

    

Lead supplier relationships and maintain service agreements, including KPIs, SLAs, scope definitions, and compliance expectations.

    

Follow up on supplier performance through regular reviews, audits, and development discussions.

﻿

Tenant Experience, Care & Engagement

    

Oversee tenant onboarding and offboarding and drive tenant care, benefits, communications, and experience-enhancing initiatives.

    

Plan and coordinate tenant events, including supplier-provided event services, and support broader campus development projects.

﻿

Administrative & Operational Support

    

Maintain documentation, reporting, templates, guidelines, service processes, and internal coordination.

    

Support financial follow-up, cost verification, and internal controls related to supplier services and customer billing.

﻿

Required Experience and Qualifications

    

Minimum three years of relevant experience in facility services, workplace services, property management, or a similar operational role.

    

Proven experience in supplier management, KPIs, compliance, service agreements, contract lifecycle management, and operational development.

    

Relevant post-secondary education in Facility Management, Property/Real Estate, or a related field. Relevant certifications are considered an advantage.

    

Strong stakeholder management skills, structured ways of working, documentation accuracy, and the ability to lead multiple initiatives independently.

    

Professional communication skills in English and Swedish. Chinese language skills are considered an advantage.

    

Service-minded, proactive, solution-oriented, and committed to continuous improvement.

﻿

  This role requires fluency in both Swedish and English - Chinese knowledge is a big advantage!

This is a full-time consultant position in Gothenburg through Incluso. Start is November 15th, 7 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg.

Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

jobs.title: Refurb Technician - Bikes
jobs.description:
At Bike Club, we offer subscriptions for children’s bikes that grow with your kids. Families pay a monthly fee, and when their children outgrow their bikes, we exchange them for a larger size. We refurbish the used bikes and make them available to other families. It’s sustainable and hassle-free.

With over 80,000 bikes, we are the second-largest bike rental network globally, and the largest in the children’s bike sector. With over $50 million in funding, we are rapidly expanding across Europe. While our headquarters is in the United Kingdom, we are also active in Germany.

Tasks

As a Bike Refurb Technician, you will play a key role in the workshop, ensuring high-quality servicing, repairs, and pre-delivery inspections (PDIs). You will oversee the bike workflow from start to finish.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Work & Performance Targets

  • Complete 15 rebike services & repairs per day or 20 new bike PDIs per day.
  • Perform advanced servicing, diagnostics, and repairs, including but not limited to:
  • Brake system maintenance (including hydraulic disc brakes).
  • Drivetrain servicing (including bottom bracket replacement).
  • Wheel maintenance (including truing).
  • Steering maintenance (including headset replacements).
  • Suspension and rigid fork replacement.
  • Gear system maintenance (including front derailleur replacements).
  • Bikes will go through QC (Quality control) before packing, ensure your bikes meet safety, cleanliness and performance standards with the use of M-check .
  • Report quality control issues the QC member.

Leadership & Workshop Operations

  • Promote teamwork and a healthy, inclusive workshop culture.
  • Ensure full compliance with Health & Safety (H&S) requirements.
  • Keep the workshop clean and tidy, maintaining a well-organised workspace.
  • Proactively share new ideas to create efficiency and improvements.
  • Monitor parts usage day to day and report low stock to the Parts Inventory Supervisor.

Requirements

Skills & Experience:

  • Cytech Level 2 certification (or equivalent experience).
  • Proven experience servicing hybrid, mountain, gravel, and BMX bikes, including rigid and suspension forks.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced workshop environment.
  • Good communication skills and a team-oriented mindset.

Benefits

🌴We offer 26 days per year + bank holidays
💷Pension salary sacrifice

🏡Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave

🚴Employee Discount on our bikes

🚲Cycle to Work scheme

Please note: As part of the interview process, candidates will be asked to assemble a bike on the day.

jobs.title: Electrical Works Supervisor - Switzerland
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
As an Electrical Works Manager within the Cabling Section, you'll play a key role in expanding, strengthening, and maintaining CERN's control and power cable installations, required for various systems within the CERN accelerators, such as alarm systems, process control systems, beam instrumentation and magnet powering systems.

Your responsibilities:
- Analyse installation and dismantling requests, liaising directly with requestors as needed to complete the required information.
- Conduct on-site technical visits to prepare and coordinate the activities.
- Prepare bills of quantities and quotations.
- Develop comprehensive technical documentation detailing the work to be carried out by CERN's electrical installation contractor.
- Manage the logistics required for the activities, such as material delivery, scaffolding setup, and site access.
- Carry out risk assessments related to the execution of the work, identifying potential hazards and defining mitigation measures to ensure safety and compliance with CERN standards.
- Supervise daily activities and report the progress, safety and quality of the works.
- Perform the inspection, testing and acceptance of completed work.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience in planning, preparing, and overseeing industrial electrical works, including the implementation of lockout/tagout procedures.
- Experience in verifying the technical quality and compliance of electrical installations with applicable standards and specifications.
- Experience in technical supervision of contractors.
- Technical certificate or general secondary education or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Industrial Electrical Installation or a related field.

Your skills:
- Construction, test and commissioning of electrical circuits and networks.
- Operation and maintenance of electrical circuits and networks.
- Organisation, planning and control.
- Drives work / projects along and sees them through to their conclusion.
- Listens actively to others and lets others speak.
- Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
- Anticipates obstacles; assesses alternative solutions in order to have a fall-back plan.
- Builds and maintains constructive and effective work relationships.
- Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Employment conditions:
- A valid driving licence.
- Shift work, stand-by duty, and work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organisation.
- Interventions in underground installations.
- Work in Radiation Areas.

jobs.title: Elevassistent till Gransäterskolan
jobs.description:
Om arbetsplatsen

Gransäterskolan är en F–9-skola med cirka 500 elever och två paralleller i varje årskurs. Hos oss står trygghet, relationer och lärande i centrum och vi arbetar för en tillgänglig lärmiljö där elever får möjlighet att utvecklas både kunskapsmässigt och socialt.

Skolan ligger nära centrum med goda kollektivtrafikförbindelser och närhet till naturen.

Nu söker vi en elevassistent för en tidsbegränsad anställning till och med den 14 december till vår mellanstadieenhet. Här arbetar vi i ett mindre arbetslag där samarbete, öppenhet och kollegialt lärande är viktiga delar av vardagen.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som elevassistent arbetar du med en elev på mellanstadiet under skoldagen. Uppdraget handlar framför allt om att bidra med struktur, tydlighet och trygg vuxennärvaro. Du arbetar förebyggande, hjälper eleven att navigera olika situationer och stödjer utvecklingen av fungerande strategier och socialt samspel.

Du behöver vara närvarande och uppmärksam, kunna läsa av situationer innan de blir svåra och sätta tydliga gränser när det behövs, samtidigt som du behåller ett lugnt och respektfullt bemötande.

Arbetet sker nära undervisande lärare. Du behöver kunna följa gemensamma rutiner och överenskommelser konsekvent.

Kvalifikationer

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Vi söker dig som är trygg och stabil i din vuxenroll och kan bygga en god relation utan att ge avkall på tydliga ramar och förväntningar. Du är lyhörd, ansvarstagande och har gott omdöme även i utmanande situationer.

Erfarenhet av arbete med barn och elever och av att möta elever i behov av särskilt stöd är meriterande.



Urval och intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Om Håbo kommun

Håbo kommun ligger omgiven av Mälaren med närhet till både levande landsbygd och stadsliv. Centralorten Bålsta ligger mellan Stockholm, Uppsala, Enköping och Västerås. I Håbo kan du leva, bo och arbeta. Du kan också pendla i nästan alla väderstreck och snabbt ta dig via buss, tåg eller pendel till fyra städer inom knappt en timme. Traktens rika omväxlande natur- och kulturhistoria ger dig goda förutsättningar för friluftsliv och fritid.

Här finns också närheten i vardagen, med korta vägar mellan kollegor, verksamheter och beslut. Som en del av Håbo kommun är du med och bidrar till ett viktigt samhällsuppdrag, och skapar värde för Håboborna varje dag. Vi är omkring 1 700 medarbetare som tillsammans driver kommunens verksamheter framåt. Vi bygger en arbetsplats där tillit, samarbete och lärande står i centrum.

Hos oss får du vara delaktig och växa i en arbetsmiljö som främjar både utveckling och arbetsglädje.
