jobs.title: Deal Desk Senior Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.


About the Role

This is a rare opportunity to build a truly strategic Deal Desk function at Perk — one that shapes how our Sales organisation structures, prices, and closes its most complex, high-value deals. We're investing in this transformation now, and we want a leader who can turn that ambition into reality.

We're hiring a Senior Deal Desk Manager to lead this shift. You'll take ownership of the Deal Desk team and its transformation, personally running point on our most complex and strategic deals while building a team that operates as trusted commercial partners to Sales, Finance, and Legal. A major part of the role will be modernising how the team works: automating manual processes through AI and automation, and improving our CPQ and quoting systems so Sales can move faster with confidence.

This is a coach-player role: you'll lead and develop a team while staying hands-on with the deals that matter most.


What You'll Do

Lead the transformation

  • Rebuild Deal Desk's operating model so the team spends its time on complex deal structuring and pricing strategy for high-value opportunities, not manual admin like company setup or payment profile processing — and put in place the triage, tools, and ways of working that make that shift stick.

  • Decide what Deal Desk should own, support, automate, or hand off to other teams, and build the case for change with Legal, Finance, and Sales Operations leadership.

  • Agree clear ownership and service levels for work that moves to other teams (for example, NDAs, supplier and financial forms, payment term changes, and downgrade/churn processing), so handovers actually stick.

  • Build performance metrics and reporting to track deal velocity, team output, and the impact of process and automation improvements over time.

  • Represent Deal Desk as a trusted, credible partner in cross-functional forums and with Sales leadership.

Lead the team and run point on complex deals

  • Build, lead, and develop a team of Deal Desk professionals, setting clear goals and performance standards as the team matures into a more strategic function.

  • Act as a coach-player: personally run point on Perk's most complex, highest-value deals, modelling the standard of deal structuring, negotiation support, and stakeholder management expected of the team.

  • Own pricing governance and deal structuring for complex, non-standard commercial deals, balancing commercial risk with deal velocity.

  • Mentor the team on complex deal structuring, pricing strategy, and commercial risk judgement, and coach them through escalations.

  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Sales Operations, and Product to unblock deals and resolve cross-functional friction quickly.

Own our systems and quoting experience

  • Own the relationship with our CPQ platform end to end, bringing prior experience owning a complex CPQ implementation elsewhere.

  • Identify and drive improvements to CPQ configuration, pricing logic, and quoting workflows so Sales can quote and close faster with confidence.

  • Act as the primary Deal Desk voice in Revenue Systems and CPQ/CLM tooling roadmap decisions.

Drive automation and AI

  • Own the automation roadmap for Deal Desk, with a clear mandate to remove manual, repetitive work from the team through AI and automation.

  • Prioritise and deliver automation of the highest-impact manual workflows first, such as company and payment profile setup and post-signature subscription provisioning, which today account for a significant share of the team's ticket volume.

  • Partner with engineering/systems teams to scope, sequence, and deliver automation initiatives, and track the time saved and volume shifted off manual processing.

  • Evaluate and pilot AI tools for use cases such as contract redline review, NDA triage, and deal risk flagging, working closely with Legal.

Protect the business

  • Act as Deal Desk's first line of defense on contract redlines and non-standard deal terms, escalating to Legal or Finance where needed.

  • Own commercial governance frameworks, pricing and discounting policy, and approval structures across the function.

  • Safeguard deal commercials, business risk, and revenue recognition implications on complex and non-standard deals.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong Deal Desk experience within B2B SaaS, ideally spanning mid-market and enterprise segments.

  • Proven experience leading a Deal Desk (or equivalent commercial/sales operations) team, with direct people management responsibility.

  • A genuine coach-player: comfortable personally running complex, high-value deals while simultaneously leading and developing a team.

  • Prior ownership of a complex CPQ platform, with a track record of driving measurable improvements to quoting, pricing, and deal velocity for Sales.

  • Experience scoping and delivering automation and/or AI initiatives that reduce manual operational work, ideally in partnership with engineering or systems teams.

  • Strong cross-functional stakeholder management skills, comfortable partnering across Legal, Finance, Sales Operations, and Product.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-changing, ambiguous environment where processes are still being defined and improved.


What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk.

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays.

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex.

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva.

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen.

  • Rest assured that you're covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence.

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus.

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party.

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks' paid parental leave.

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes.

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year.

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards.

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years.

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support.

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.title: Lead Business Analyst, Process & automation (London | remote)
jobs.description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

 

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for a Lead Business Analyst, Process & Automation to join our Capital and Payments team. Process & Automation is a small team working across the operations behind payments, lending, underwriting, risk, and billing. We find operational friction, diagnose root causes, and build the process, data, tooling, and automation solutions that fix it.

You will own projects end to end: find where a process is failing or create toil, prove it with data, design something better, coordinate the build with stakeholders, and stay with it until the receiving team owns it and the numbers have moved. AI is a default tool in how we work rather than a separate initiative.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with full ownership of your projects.

 
 

What you’ll be doing:

  • Define: map end-to-end flows, trace handoffs, and understand how a process actually runs rather than how it is documented.

  • Diagnose: separate root causes from symptoms and quantify where time, money, and customers are being lost.

  • Design: turn what you find into clear requirements, better flows, and delivery plans with measurable success criteria, then build or coordinate the automation, tooling, data, and controls they depend on.

  • Instrument: lead testing and launch readiness, track impact against agreed measures, drive adoption, and hand ownership back to the team that owns the outcome.

  • Establish how we use AI agents in operations: identify where they create real leverage, then design, test, and deploy them for bounded, multi-step workflows, including the evaluation methods that prove they work.

  • Partner with teams outside operations whose work affects these outcomes, and turn operational findings into business cases that help Product and Technology prioritize longer-term solutions.

 
 

What you need to bring:

We're looking for a candidate who has experience with the following:

  • 7+ years in business analysis, process improvement, operations, implementation, or product operations.

  • A track record leading complex cross-functional projects from problem definition through implementation and ongoing measurement.

  • Strong analytical skills - you use data, queries, and dashboards to validate problems and prove outcomes, not only to report on them.

  • Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business needs into clear requirements, process designs, and delivery plans.

  • Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, written communication, and presentation skills, with a track record of driving alignment and outcomes across teams you do not manage.

 
 

Even better if you have, but not necessary:

  • Financial services, fintech, payments, lending, or insurance - or another complex, regulated operating environment.

  • Commerce, e-commerce, point-of-sale, or marketplace experience.

  • Hands-on experience with workflow, case-management, or process-automation platforms.

  • SQL, business-intelligence tools, or data modelling.

  • Experience evaluating or deploying AI-enabled solutions for operational use cases.

  • Experience driving adoption and effectiveness after launch, not just delivery.

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

Be a changemaker

 
 

You’ll enjoy:

  • A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work

  • A culture that celebrates performance

  • The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard

  • Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

  • Flexible paid time off and remote work policies

  • Equity options, because this is your company too

  • Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters

  • Training opportunities to grow your skills and career

  • Health and wellness credit so you feel your best

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams

  • Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook

  • Enhanced parental leave to support growing families

  • Etc…

 

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities

Please note that we ask applicants to disclose any criminal convictions, and we conduct criminal record checks as part of our hiring process for this role.

jobs.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Strategic Finance Manager — The Flex

The Flex is creating the future of flexible accommodation.

We operate and manage properties across multiple cities and countries, bringing together hospitality, technology and operational excellence to make renting a home as effortless as booking a hotel.

As our international footprint expands, we are searching for an outstanding Strategic Finance Manager to help build the financial systems, controls and insights required to support a rapidly growing global business.

This is far more than a conventional accounting position. You will work closely with our founders and leadership team, take ownership of essential financial processes, evaluate business performance and provide the insights that enable better decisions as we scale.

Your Mission

As Strategic Finance Manager, you will play a central role in The Flex’s financial operations.

Your objective will be to give the business complete clarity over where its revenue comes from, how its money is spent, how each area is performing and where profitability can be improved.

Your responsibilities will span accounting, financial analysis, management reporting, payment reconciliation, budgeting and business performance.

You will have exposure to the entire organisation, collaborating directly with operations, revenue management, property teams and senior leadership.

For an ambitious individual, this position offers a clear path toward becoming Head of Finance or, ultimately, moving into a CFO-track role as The Flex continues to grow.

What You Will Own

  • Lead and continuously strengthen our day-to-day financial controls and reporting, ensuring that every number shared with management is accurate, validated, complete and supported by reliable evidence.

  • Identify repetitive and manual finance tasks, create more efficient processes and collaborate with our engineering teams to automate them.

  • Reconcile payments from Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia, direct reservations and other distribution partners, confirming that every expected payment is received correctly and on schedule.

  • Reconcile bank accounts and incoming transactions, ensuring that funds are properly received and recorded while investigating and resolving discrepancies quickly.

  • Monitor and manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

  • Review supplier invoices and expenses incurred across the company.

  • Oversee statutory filings and corporate compliance requirements across several jurisdictions, making sure that all submissions are correct and completed within the required deadlines.

  • Coordinate with external accountants, tax advisers, auditors and banking partners to maintain accurate financial records and ensure timely compliance.

  • Assist with financial statements for landlords and property owners whenever required.

  • Develop dashboards and reporting tools that provide management with real-time visibility into company performance.

  • Evaluate financial results across individual properties, cities, countries and business units.

  • Create and maintain company budgets, forecasts and financial models.

  • Track cash flow and support management in planning future funding and capital needs.

  • Detect financial risks, discrepancies and potential sources of revenue leakage.

  • Review the company’s cost base and uncover opportunities to strengthen margins.

  • Partner with operational teams to understand, control and reduce costs at property level.

  • Contribute to financial due diligence for acquisitions, investments and expansion into new markets.

  • Communicate financial findings, recommendations and actionable insights directly to the founders and management team.

What We Are Looking For

  • A highly analytical individual who is confident and comfortable working with numbers.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and an uncompromising approach to financial accuracy.

  • A strong understanding of accounting concepts and financial principles.

  • The ability to work effectively with significant volumes of financial and operational data.

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.

  • Strong capabilities in financial reconciliation, controls and problem-solving.

  • A commercial mindset—you do more than report figures; you understand their meaning and implications for the wider business.

  • A strong sense of ownership, responsibility and accountability.

  • The confidence to work independently, find solutions and navigate unfamiliar challenges.

  • The ability to perform in a fast-paced environment where priorities may evolve quickly.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • The confidence to communicate and work directly with senior management.

  • A genuine interest in technology, automation and AI, together with the ability to identify opportunities to improve and automate finance processes.

  • The ambition to grow quickly and assume substantially greater responsibility over time.

  • Experience in accounting, audit, investment banking, private equity, FP&A, consulting, hospitality, real estate or a high-growth startup would be highly valuable.

  • A degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Mathematics or another analytical discipline is preferred, although exceptional applicants from other backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

What Success Will Look Like

During your first 6–12 months, you will have:

  • Developed a detailed understanding of the financial performance of every major area of The Flex.

  • Established dependable monthly management reporting across the company.

  • Ensured that payments from booking platforms and commercial partners are fully reconciled and that all expected funds are received.

  • Significantly improved visibility into cash flow, profitability and unit economics.

  • Uncovered meaningful opportunities to lower costs and improve margins.

  • Automated several finance processes that were previously completed manually.

  • Established yourself as a trusted financial partner to the founders and management team.

  • Taken responsibility for increasingly important areas of the company’s finance function.

Why Join The Flex?

  • Become part of a rapidly growing international business operating at the intersection of real estate, hospitality and technology.

  • Work closely and directly with the company’s founders and senior leaders.

  • Gain hands-on exposure to the financial operations of a business spanning multiple countries.

  • Influence profitability and contribute directly to major strategic and commercial decisions.

  • Help design and build the finance function instead of simply taking over an established set of processes.

  • Apply technology and AI to reimagine how a modern finance function should operate.

  • Take meaningful ownership and responsibility from your first day.

  • Receive a competitive salary together with performance-based incentives.

  • Benefit from exceptional long-term career progression as The Flex continues its international expansion.

You Should Not Apply If

  • You want a conventional corporate 9-to-5 position with limited and narrowly defined responsibilities.

  • You rely on someone else to continuously tell you what needs to be done.

  • You are uncomfortable taking responsibility and being accountable for the quality of your work.

  • You would rather report financial figures than understand, challenge and improve them.

  • You engage in workplace politics, gossip or conversations about colleagues behind their backs.

  • You are searching for a slow-moving, predictable role with limited career progression.

  • You do not aspire to become one of the very best in the world at what you do.

Sales & Business Development Manager

Affix Scaffolding Europe Oy – Hyvinkää, Finland

Position: 1

Location: Hyvinkää, Finland

Employment & compensation: Negotiable based on experience and profile

About the role

Affix Scaffolding Europe Oy is a newly established Finnish business preparing to launch its operations in Hyvinkää for the import, sales, rental, storage and logistics of professional scaffolding systems and related equipment.

Our Finnish operations are currently being established and are expected to commence by the end of 2026 at the latest.

We are looking for an experienced Sales & Business Development Manager to take a key role in building Affix's commercial presence in Finland and supporting further growth in selected European markets.

This is a newly created role in a new business operation, offering significant responsibility and the opportunity to shape the company's sales approach, customer acquisition processes, CRM setup and go-to-market activities from an early stage.

The successful candidate will be expected to actively develop new business, establish customer relationships, build and manage a sales pipeline, negotiate commercial terms and, most importantly, successfully close sales and rental agreements.

Main responsibilities

Identifying and developing new B2B customers and business opportunities.

Building relationships with construction companies, scaffolding contractors, industrial companies, equipment-rental businesses and other relevant customers.

Managing the full sales cycle from prospecting and first contact through meetings, quotations, negotiations and deal closing.

Developing and maintaining a structured sales pipeline and sales forecast.

Preparing commercial offers and actively following opportunities through to a decision.

Understanding customer requirements and proposing suitable scaffolding systems, equipment and commercial solutions.

Developing long-term customer relationships and identifying repeat-sales and cross-selling opportunities.

Supporting the company's market-entry and growth strategy in Finland and selected European markets.

Monitoring market developments, competitors, pricing and commercial opportunities.

Participating in customer visits, trade events and other relevant sales activities.

Coordinating with Affix's international manufacturing, sourcing, technical, operational and back-office teams.

Helping establish scalable sales, CRM and growth-management processes for the Finnish business.

Required experience and skills

Applicants should have:

Proven B2B sales and business-development experience.

Demonstrated experience in negotiating and successfully closing commercial deals.

Relevant sales experience in scaffolding, construction equipment, industrial products, building materials, equipment rental or another comparable B2B sector.

Ability to independently develop new customer relationships and manage the complete sales process.

Strong commercial, negotiation and relationship-management skills.

Experience using leading CRM platforms, such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Pipedrive or comparable systems.

Experience using modern sales, prospecting, pipeline-management or growth tools to support lead generation, customer development and sales performance.

Ability to establish structured CRM practices, maintain high-quality pipeline data and use sales information for forecasting and decision-making.

Good understanding of quotations, pricing, commercial terms and customer account development.

Professional-level Finnish and English communication skills.

Ability and willingness to travel for customer meetings when required.

A proactive, target-oriented and highly independent approach to work.

Language skills

As Affix is developing an international European business, applicants should preferably speak at least one additional European language in addition to Finnish and English.

German or French is particularly valued. Other relevant European language skills are also considered an advantage.

Considered an advantage

Existing network within the Finnish construction, scaffolding, industrial or equipment-rental sectors.

Experience selling or renting scaffolding systems or related construction equipment.

Knowledge of Ringlock, Cuplock or other modular scaffolding systems.

Experience launching or developing a new market, business unit or customer portfolio.

Experience building sales processes and CRM structures for a new or rapidly growing business.

International B2B sales experience.

Experience in outbound sales, account-based sales, lead-generation platforms or other modern growth-management approaches.

Experience working with manufacturing, sourcing and back-office teams located outside Finland.

Experience in Nordic, German-speaking or French-speaking markets.

What we offer

This is an opportunity to join Affix Scaffolding Europe Oy at the beginning of its Finnish operations and play a central role in building the company's commercial foundation.

The successful candidate will have significant influence over customer acquisition, sales processes, CRM practices, commercial strategy and future growth.

    Own the end-to-end architecture, design, and evolution of the OneStream EPM platform
    Partner with the CFO, Finance Leadership Team, and Digital stakeholders to translate business and financial requirements into robust system solutions

jobs.title: Manufacturing Quality Engineer | Cytiva | Uppsala
jobs.description:

Forming part of the Biotechnology segment at Danaher, we bring together dedicated technical expertise and talent to develop the next generation of life-changing therapeutics. The Manufacturing Quality Engineer at Cytiva provides technical support to improve product quality, with a focus on data analysis, issue resolution, and continuous improvement. This role is responsible for driving the non-conforming material process and supporting root cause investigations by coordinating with Production Engineers, Quality Specialists, Supplier Quality Engineers, affected project teams, and manufacturing suppliers.

This position is part of the Custom Engineering Manufacturing team and located in Uppsala. At Cytiva, our vision is, to advance future therapeutics from discovery to delivery.

Who should apply for this job?

Essential qualifications

• Ownership of the Deviation handling process • Coordinate and document manufacturing quality issues to ensure clear ownership, effective follow-up, and timely resolution. • Coordinate resources to support problem-solving and rework activities in ongoing production for manufacturing quality-related issues. • Lead analysis of supplier deviations and quality follow up with suppliers • Collaborate with Supplier Quality, Global Sourcing, and other cross-functional teams on manufacturing quality-related topics. • Conduct root cause analysis for product quality issues, identify trends, and coordinate with Supplier Quality Engineers, Production Engineering, and Global Sourcing to drive resolution and submit improvement proposals to the Change Control Board. • Manage non-conforming material inventory to ensure accurate control, follow-up, and disposition. • Support the customer complaints team by contributing manufacturing quality expertise and follow-up as needed.

Desirable qualifications

Who you are: • Technical knowledge of manufacturing processes • Quality focus • Strong communication skills, verbal and written • Experience from production or design of work of products for the Biopharmaceutical industry • Bachelor Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in: • Quality management, NC/CAPA process • ISO9001:2015

At Cytiva we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, hybrid working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement. This position is eligible for a hybrid work arrangement in which you can work part-time at the Company location identified above and part-time remotely from your home. Additional information about this hybrid work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Cytiva can provide.

As One of Us

As an employed staffing consultant at Lernia, you will always receive a competitive salary, vacation benefits, pension contributions, insurance coverage, and be part of our collective agreement. We care about your well-being, which is why we offer all our consultants wellness allowances and access to occupational health services. During your employment, you will have a dedicated consultant manager responsible for your assignment, ensuring you thrive at your workplace while supporting and developing you in your professional role.

Don't wait – apply today!

We work with continuous selection and may fill the position as soon as we find the right person. Therefore, please submit your application as soon as possible!

jobs.description:
About the role

Dieffenbacher is a German, globally operating machinery manufacturer focusing on the design and manufacture of press systems and complete production lines for the panel industry.

In this role, you will play a key part as a member of a \~20-person mechanical design team in Nastola. You will be responsible for specific equipment entities and perform related design work. You will work in close cooperation with automation designers and the chief mechanical designer to ensure projects progress smoothly. Additionally, you will guide external consultants and ensure the quality of the work.

Every project brings something new, giving you the opportunity to challenge yourself with new practices and possibilities.

Why Join Us?
Our mechanical engineering relies strongly on our own expert know-how and a broad network of specialists. We offer you a responsible and diverse role where you can solve interesting technical challenges. With us, you will work in a close-knit atmosphere from the drafting board straight into practice.

Work tasks
- Equipment Responsibility: You will be responsible for designated equipment packages, overseeing equipment improvements, cost tracking, supporting project planning, and equipment documentation.
- Design: You will design custom customer assignments (heavy structures) using Creo & AutoCAD.
- Quality Assurance and Partner Guidance: You will direct design work done by consultants and ensure the output meets high quality standards.
- Practical Collaboration and Inspections: You will collaborate with the workshops, automation design, and R&D, perform equipment inspections, and communicate with customers as needed.
- Fieldwork: You will participate in troubleshooting at installation sites when necessary (site visits approx. 5–15 days per year).

We are looking for

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering.
- Solid design experience (preferably over 4 years) in heavy structures (1–20 t), machinery, and machine parts manufactured by welding or machining.
- Fluent English skills.
- Ability to work full-time at the Nastola office during the trial period. Option for 2 remote workdays per week after the trial period.
- Readiness to travel abroad approx. 5–15 days per year.
- Accountability, a proactive and precise working style, and good interpersonal skills.

Considered an Advantage:
- Good proficiency in Finnish.
- Understanding the requirements and possibilities of different manufacturing methods.
- Experience in structural strength calculations and motor sizing.
- Previous hands-on experience in welding or installation work.

 

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Sygeplejerske søges til Holstebro-Alstrup Friplejehjem
jobs.description:
Sygeplejerske søges til Holstebro-Alstrup Friplejehjem

30–32 timer om ugen · Opstart 1. november 2026 · Ingen weekendarbejde

Har du lyst til at gøre en forskel for vores beboere og samtidig være med til at styrke den sygeplejefaglige kvalitet? Så har vi måske jobbet til dig.

På Holstebro-Alstrup Friplejehjem søger vi en engageret og fagligt stærk sygeplejerske til 30–32 timer om ugen med opstart 1. november 2026.

Stillingen er en opnormering af vores sygeplejefaglige indsats, og du bliver vores anden sygeplejerske. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores nuværende sygeplejerske, ledelsen og det øvrige personale.

En hverdag tæt på beboerne

Hos os er sygeplejersken en aktiv del af hverdagen. Vi tror på, at den bedste sygepleje opstår, når faglighed og nærvær går hånd i hånd. Derfor skal du have lyst til både at varetage sygeplejefaglige opgaver og tage del i den daglige pleje.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Sygepleje, kliniske vurderinger og opfølgning på beboernes helbredstilstand

  • Observation, tidlig opsporing og forebyggelse

  • Medicinhåndtering og opfølgning

  • Dokumentation og kvalitetssikring

  • Koordinering med læger, hospital og øvrige samarbejdspartnere

  • Vejledning og faglig sparring med social- og sundhedsfagligt personale

  • Medvirken til at udvikle og fastholde vores faglige standarder

Den nye Ældrelov sætter fokus på selvbestemmelse, livsglæde, helhedspleje og tillid til fagligheden. Hos os skal du være med til at omsætte værdierne til praksis ved at se hele mennesket, tage udgangspunkt i beboerens ønsker og ressourcer og arbejde forebyggende og rehabiliterende.

Vi ser Ældreloven som en mulighed for at styrke det, vi allerede tror på: faglighed, nærvær og det gode hverdagsliv.

Vi tilbyder dig

  • 30–32 timer om ugen og ingen weekendarbejde

  • Opstart 1. november 2026 eller efter aftale

  • En ny opnormeret sygeplejerskefunktion med mulighed for at sætte dit præg

  • Tæt fagligt samarbejde med vores nuværende sygeplejerske

  • Mulighed for indflydelse på arbejdsgange og faglig udvikling

  • En hverdag med tæt kontakt til beboere, pårørende, frivillige og kolleger

  • Et godt tværfagligt samarbejde og mulighed for faglig udvikling

Vi søger dig, der

  • Er uddannet sygeplejerske og har lyst til at arbejde med ældre mennesker

  • Har et godt klinisk blik og kan bevare overblikket

  • Trives med både selvstændigt ansvar og teamsamarbejde

  • Er engageret, omsorgsfuld og fagligt nysgerrig

  • Har lyst til at være en aktiv del af plejen

  • Arbejder helhedsorienteret med udgangspunkt i den enkelte beboer

  • Har lyst til at bidrage til et godt arbejdsmiljø og en positiv kultur

  • Kan se mulighederne i den nye Ældrelov og omsætte den til praksis

Har du lyst til at være en del af teamet så send en ansøgning, vi tager ind til samtale løbende.

Ansøgningsfrist: 23 september kl 8
Tiltrædelse: 1. november 2026 eller efter aftale.

Har du spørgsmål, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte plejehjemsleder Karina Laursen på 2195 4644 eller knl@holstebro-alstrup.dk.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig – måske er det netop dig, der skal være vores nye kollega.

·         Er åben og ærlig, og respekterer, at andre også er det.

·         Kendskab til svejsning i rækværk med tynde rør (1-2 mm) er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

 

Vi tilbyder:

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer in the customer organisation, you are the technical spearhead of monday.com's AI transformation motion for our most strategic customers. You will carry a portfolio of 1 to 2 strategic accounts, deeply embedded with C-level and technical teams to architect, build, and ship AI solutions in production, and you will be accountable for the business outcomes those engagements promised, not just the build.

This is part of a growing motion, and you will be joining a team that’s already working on active deployments.

Please note this is a hybrid position of 3 days/week in our Paris office.

About the Role

Enterprises don't struggle to access AI capability; they struggle to deploy it. Your job is closing that gap for a small portfolio of monday.com's highest-value customers. You will advise executives on AI-driven operational change, design and ship the systems that make it real, and feed what you learn back into the product with evidence, not anecdotes.

You will work with: monday AI agents, MCP-based integrations into customer systems, vibe apps, and production workflows. You will take these from discovery through architecture, build, rollout, and measurable adoption.

This is an autonomous, high-visibility role that shapes both customer outcomes and the future of forward-deployed engineering at monday.com.

What You'll Do

Strategic transformation. Embed with C-level stakeholders across your accounts to architect end-to-end AI solutions and scalable workflows that solve complex, mission-critical business pains. You own the narrative from pilot to full production rollout.

Outcome ownership. Your success metric is the business result the engagement committed to: adoption, workflow throughput, measurable ROI. You define the success criteria with the customer up front and you own getting there.

Build and ship. Design sophisticated platform configurations, build monday agents and vibe apps, wire MCP integrations into customer systems, and prototype custom scripts where the platform ends. Your leverage is architecture and judgment; your credibility is that you can build it yourself.

Eval-driven product feedback. Instrument your deployments, run evals against real customer workflows, and translate what you find into PRDs and roadmap input that changes what we build. You are a sensor for the product org, with data behind every claim.

Cross-functional leadership. Partner with Sales and CS as the technical authority on account strategy. Productize what you learn: patterns, agents, and assets from one account become reusable machinery for the whole motion.

What we promise

This role has been built with a direct line into the product roadmap, a mandate to productize rather than repeat, and outcome-based success criteria agreed before the build starts.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years building applications from scratch using TypeScript/Node.js/React, with full-stack depth

  • Experience leading hands-on projects end-to-end in a production environment, preferably client-facing

  • Background in Solution Architecture or Software Engineering with a strong grasp of AI/LLM systems: agent architectures, MCP or comparable tool-use protocols, evals, and prompt-to-production workflows

  • Experience navigating C-suite relationships and influencing executive decisions in ambiguous environments

  • Track record of turning one-off delivery work into reusable assets, product requirements, or repeatable playbooks

  • Entrepreneurial, fast-moving, and focused on long-term impact over immediate fixes

jobs.title: Directeur / Directrice de structure d'hébergement touristique (H/F)
jobs.description:
La Ligue de l'enseignement - Fédération des Œuvres Laïques de la Moselle (FOL57) recrute un(e) Directeur(rice) pour son centre d'hébergement permanent ouvert toute l'année « Les Jonquilles », situé à Xonrupt-Longemer, au cœur du massif des Vosges. D'une capacité de 250 lits, le centre accueille principalement des classes de découverte, des séjours de vacances pour enfants et jeunes, ainsi que des groupes d'adultes, familles et individuels.
En tant que directeur(rice), vous serez le garant du bon fonctionnement de l'établissement, de la qualité de l'accueil et de la mise en œuvre du projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
Vous partagez pleinement les valeurs de l'éducation populaire, de la laïcité, de l'engagement citoyen et de l'accès aux vacances pour tous en conjuguant vision stratégique, sens du collectif et capacité d'action.
Au sein du centre, le(la) directeur(rice) s'appuie sur une équipe permanente composée notamment de deux directrices adjointes, d'une cheffe de cuisine, d'une seconde de cuisine, d'une animatrice environnement, d'un agent technique et de personnels saisonniers et occasionnels ainsi que les services de la fédération.
Il(elle) assure la direction d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire, favorise le travail collaboratif et veille à la qualité du service rendu aux différents publics accueillis.

VOS MISSIONS
DIRECTION ET PILOTAGE DE L'ETABLISSEMENT
- Mettre en œuvre et faire vivre le projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
- Assurer le bon fonctionnement général du centre et la continuité du service.
- Veiller au respect des normes d'hygiène, de sécurité et de la réglementation applicable.
- Représenter le centre auprès des partenaires institutionnels et locaux.
- Veiller à la qualité de l'accueil et de la communication du centre.
- Promouvoir le centre et développer nos partenariats
MANAGEMENT DES EQUIPES
- Diriger, animer et accompagner les équipes permanentes et saisonnières.
- Organiser et répartir le travail des différents services.
- Favoriser la montée en compétences des personnels
- Mettre en œuvre le recrutement et veiller à l'intégration des personnels saisonniers et occasionnels.
ORGANISATION ET DEVELOPPEMENT DES SEJOURS
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le service Vacances/Classes du siège de la fédération
- Accompagner les adjointes dans la préparation et le suivi des classes de découverte, des colonies et accueils de groupes.
- Développer les relations avec les prestataires d'activités et les partenaires locaux.
- Contribuer au développement de l'activité du centre et à la qualité de séjours proposés.
GESTION TECHNIQUE ET SECURITE
- Superviser l'entretien du patrimoine immobilier et des équipements avec l'agent technique
- Organiser les commissions de sécurité et assurer la tenue des registres réglementaires.
- Veiller à la mise en œuvre des 3 labels : Familles Plus, Ecolabels, Tourisme et Handicap
- Participer à la définition et à la mise en œuvre des programmes de travaux et d'investissement en collaboration étroite avec le siège de la fédération
GESTION ADMINISTRATIVE ET FINANCIERE
- Organiser le suivi des réservations et de l'occupation du centre (rooming)
- Contrôler les caisses et le compte courant du centre, Transmettre les pièces comptables au siège de la fédération où est tenu la comptabilité.
- Superviser l'économat avec la cheffe de cuisine et établir avec les adjointes la gestion du tarifs jour

CONDITIONS DU POSTE
- CDI à temps plein.
- Prise de fonction : 1er septembre 2026.
- Classification cadre selon la Convention Collective ECLAT. Indice 400 avec reprise d'ancienneté selon les dispositions conventionnelles.
- Logement de fonction possible. - Astreintes organisées avec l'équipe du centre.
- Véhicule de service, téléphone de fonction
- Mutuelle, Avantages du CSE,

jobs.title: Technical Sales & Business Development Manager - Paper & Board
jobs.description:
At Nouryon, our global team takes positive action every day, to reach higher collectively and individually. We create innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers to answer society’s needs – today and in the future.

We are looking for team members who bring ideas forward, champion others and work together to do better. Does that sound like you?



About the job

In this exiting role as Business Development Manager Paper & Board, you will lead the technical and commercial advancement of Nouryon’s Paper, Board and tissue business in Europe. With ownership of key CMC applications, you will drive innovation, strengthen customer partnerships, and help position Nouryon as the preferred solutions provider in tissue and barrier coatings.



In your future role as Business Development Manager, you will

    Conduct technical audits and diagnostics at Nordic key accounts and selected distributors to identify opportunities for CMC, surfactants and chelates (with focus on wet end tissue and barrier coating).
    Work closely and support the Account Manager to develop and manage a strategic key account plan implementing innovation and enabling multi‑level engagement, thereby strengthening customer proximity and long‑term partnership.
    Maintain regular technical and innovation touchpoints with key account R&D and distributor technical teams to align on project pipeline and application roadmaps.
    Provide second line technical support and training for the EMEA distribution network, including joint customer visits and troubleshooting of complex cases.
    Manage sales related KPIs for assigned accounts (volume, margin, price development, project pipeline value, hit rate) and report progress versus targets.



You will work closely with internal stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and R&D to drive customer projects, technical development, and business growth. Externally, you will build strong relationships with paper mills, industrial customers, distributors, and customer R&D and application teams, acting as a trusted technical advisor and partner.

This role requires travel approximately 40-50% of the time, primarily across Europe. Occasional travel to the Middle East and North Africa, including Egypt, may also be required to support customer engagement, technical projects, and business development activities.



We believe you bring

    Great experience within the paper and board process industries, ideally in technical and application, process, or customer-facing role.
    Proven experience in technical sales, or technical service, with direct customer interaction.
    Hands-on experience with tissue, board, specialty paper, barrier coatings, or related applications.
    Experience planning and executing laboratory and mill trials and translating technical outcomes into commercial value.
    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Paper Engineering, Chemistry, Process Engineering, or a related technical field.



We believe you are...



To be successful in this position you combine strong technical expertise with commercial acumen and can turn technical insight into customer value. You thrive in an independent role with a high degree of ownership, while also collaborating effectively across functions, teams, and countries. Structured and proactive in your approach, you value knowledge sharing, transparency, and strong teamwork to drive results.



We offer you

At Nouryon, we provide a great job and friendly coworkers, plus benefits in addition to salary. Our collective agreement is with IKEM. Plus, we offer unilateral perks, such as bonus, reduced hours, health care allowance, lunch allowance, and more.



Have we got your interest?

This is a permanent position on a full-time basis, reporting to Nicolo Marelli, Regional Sales Director EMEIA, based in Gothenburg, Sweden.

Please apply via our online recruitment system. We will not accept applications via e-mail. Once it's with us we will review to see if we have a match between your skills and the role! For more information about our hiring process, visit: nouryon.com/careers/how-we-hire/

As an applicant, you will be subject to a background check before employment. You will receive more information about this later in the recruitment process.

We work actively and systematically with HSE matters to ensure a safe and sustainable working environment for our employees. As an employee, you may therefore be required to undergo drug testing on a random basis. This is part of our commitment to safeguarding the safety and well-being of our staff.



We look forward to receiving your application!



About Nouryon

Explore careers and life at Nouryon  

If you’re looking for your next career move, apply today and join Nouryon’s worldwide team in providing essential solutions that our customers use to manufacture everyday products such as personal care, cleaning, paints and coatings, agriculture and food, pharmaceuticals, and building products. Our employees are driven by the wish to make an impact and actively drive positive change. If that describes you, we will gladly make way for your ambitions. From day one we support you with your personal growth, through challenging positions and comprehensive learning and development opportunities, in a dynamic, international, diverse, and proactive working environment.

Visit our website and follow us on LinkedIn.

jobs.description:
[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/51a48aea-9cb3-42cf-8080-ca1ef36998cf/original.jpeg]


ASIAKKUUSPÄÄLLIKKÖ – HALUATKO TEHDÄ TULOSTA JA NÄHDÄ SEN MYÖS PALKASSASI?

Sytytkö tavoitteista, kaupoista ja onnistumisista? Oletko parhaimmillasi silloin, kun ympärillä tapahtuu paljon ja tilanteet vaativat nopeita päätöksiä?

Arsenaalissa pääset vauhdikkaaseen kaupalliseen rooliin, jossa yhdistyvät myynti, asiakkuudet ja ihmiset. Tässä työssä et jää odottamaan, että puhelin soi. Tartut itse mahdollisuuksiin, kontaktoit asiakkaita ja pidät huolen siitä, että oikeat työntekijät ja oikeat työtehtävät kohtaavat mahdollisimman tehokkaasti.

Arsenaali on luotettava, vakavarainen ja moderni henkilöstöpalveluyritys. Työllistämme päivittäin 250–300 rakennus-, kuljetus- ja ravintola-alan ammattilaista Uudenmaan alueella. Vuonna 2025 liikevaihtomme oli 10,9 miljoonaa euroa.

Nyt etsimme joukkoomme tavoitteellista ja energistä asiakkuuspäällikköä, joka haluaa tehdä tulosta – ja menestyä yhdessä muun joukkueen kanssa.


TÄSSÄ TYÖSSÄ TEKEMISELLÄSI ON SUORA VAIKUTUS TULOKSEEN

Asiakkuuspäällikkönä vastaat omista asiakkuuksistasi ja niiden kehittämisestä. Samalla pidät silmät auki uusille kaupallisille mahdollisuuksille.

Yksi tärkeimmistä tehtävistäsi on huolehtia henkilöstöpoolimme mahdollisimman korkeasta käyttöasteesta. Kun työntekijän toimeksianto päättyy, tavoitteena on löytää hänelle nopeasti seuraava työ. Kun asiakkaalle syntyy äkillinen tarve, meidän tehtävämme on ratkaista se.

Työpäivääsi kuuluu:

* aktiivinen myynti nykyisille ja uusille asiakkaille

* uusien asiakkaiden kontaktointi ja tapaaminen

* omien asiakkuuksien kehittäminen

* vapautuvien työntekijöiden aktiivinen tarjoaminen asiakkaille

* uusien työntekijöiden rekrytointi yhdessä rekrytointitiimimme kanssa

* työntekijöiden työvuoroihin ja toimeksiantoihin liittyvien asioiden hoitaminen

* nopeasti muuttuvien tilanteiden ratkaiseminen.

Työssä tulee vastaan päiviä, jolloin monta asiaa tapahtuu yhtä aikaa. Asiakkaan tarve muuttuu, työntekijä vapautuu ennakoitua aikaisemmin tai sovittu henkilö ei pääsekään töihin. Silloin etsimme ihmistä, joka ei jää ihmettelemään ongelmaa vaan miettii: miten tämä ratkaistaan?


TUNNISTATKO ITSESI?

Emme etsi ensisijaisesti tietyn toimialan osaajaa tai tietyn tutkinnon suorittanutta. Etsimme ennen kaikkea oikeanlaista draivia.

Saatat olla etsimämme henkilö, jos:

* haluat voittaa ja saavuttaa tavoitteesi

* saat energiaa kaupoista ja onnistumisista

* raha ja mahdollisuus vaikuttaa omaan ansaintaasi motivoivat sinua

* tartut puhelimeen mieluummin kuin jäät odottamaan

* pystyt tekemään päätöksiä nopeasti myös paineen alla

* osaat hahmottaa, missä on hyvä kauppa ja mihin ei kannata käyttää aikaansa

* olet järjestelmällinen ja tarkka, vaikka ympärillä olisi kiire

* uskallat olla jämäkkä asiakkaiden ja työntekijöiden kanssa

* epäonnistuminen tai muuttunut tilanne ei pysäytä sinua – siirryt nopeasti seuraavaan ratkaisuun

* olet energinen, ahkera ja nautit korkeasta tekemisen temposta.

Sinulla ei tarvitse olla kokemusta henkilöstöpalvelualalta. Kiinnostava taustasi voi löytyä yhtä hyvin esimerkiksi myynnistä, logistiikasta, kuljetusalalta, resursoinnista tai muusta nopeatempoisesta liiketoiminnasta.

Toivomme kuitenkin, että olet jo päässyt näyttämään kaupallista osaamistasi ja tiedät, mitä tavoitteellinen työskentely käytännössä tarkoittaa.

Emme etsi kaikkien miellyttäjää. Etsimme hyvää tyyppiä, joka tulee toimeen erilaisten ihmisten kanssa, mutta uskaltaa myös tehdä päätöksiä, pitää sovituista asioista kiinni ja viedä tilanteet loppuun.


MITÄ SAAT MEILTÄ?

Kun odotamme sinulta paljon, haluamme myös palkita onnistumisesta.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

* 2 500–4 000 euron suoritusperusteinen pohjapalkka plus bonus kuukaudessa – onnistuminen näkyy omassa palkassasi

* mahdollisuuden työsuhdeautoon

* vahvan perehdytyksen ja henkilökohtaisen mentoroinnin

* kokeneen rekrytointitiimin tuen

* osaavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön

* miellyttävät toimitilat hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella

* säännöllisen työajan arkisin klo 8–16 toimipaikassamme Helsingissä

Arsenaalissa tavoitteet ovat korkealla, mutta niitä ei saavuteta kyynärpäätaktiikalla. Tiimissäsi työskentelee muita asiakkuuspäälliköitä sekä rekrytoinnin ammattilaisia. Autamme toisiamme onnistumaan, ja kaupoista sekä hyvistä tuloksista iloitaan yhdessä.


HALUATKO NÄYTTÄÄ, MIHIN PYSTYT?

Jos haluat työn, jossa päivät kuluvat nopeasti, tulokset näkyvät konkreettisesti ja omalla aktiivisuudellasi on merkitystä sekä asiakkaalle, työntekijälle että omalle ansainnallesi, haluamme tutustua sinuun.

Emme etsi täydellistä CV:tä. Etsimme oikeaa asennetta, kaupallista vaistoa ja halua onnistua.

Ota seuraava askel ja osoita meille, miksi juuri sinä olisi hyvä vahvistus Arsenaalin joukkueeseen.

jobs.title: Central quality vie f/h (H/F)
jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Safran Nacelles conçoit, intègre et assure le support et le service après-vente des nacelles d'avions. La société est un leader mondial sur le marché des avions commerciaux de plus de 100 places, des avions d'affaires et des avions régionaux. A la pointe de la technologie, Safran Nacelles propose des nacelles toujours plus intégrées au moteur, aérodynamiques, légères avec des traitements acoustiques avancés afin de contribuer à la réduction des émissions de CO2 et sonores des aéronefs.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.


Descriptif missionSafran Nacelles is looking for a VIE Digital Quality & Audit Improvement Engineer to join its Quality team in Burnley, UK.



As part of the Quality organisation, you will contribute to the development and deployment of a new digital internal auditing tool, supporting Safran Nacelles' ambition to transform and digitalise its audit practices.



This assignment will provide the opportunity to work at the intersection of Quality, digitalisation and continuous improvement, while collaborating with different teams across the organisation.



Your missions :



Working closely with the Quality team and relevant stakeholders, you will contribute to the following activities:



Support the development of a new digital internal auditing tool for Safran Nacelles, contributing to the transition towards a more digital and efficient approach to internal audits.

Contribute to the deployment of the digital auditing tool, including supporting users during implementation, preparing training materials and contributing to training sessions.

Support the definition and development of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) associated with the auditing tool, helping to monitor its adoption, performance and effectiveness.

Develop and support the implementation of processes and templates to facilitate the consolidation and analysis of audit results.

Contribute to trend analysis of audit results and associated action plans, helping the Quality team identify recurring issues, improvement opportunities and areas requiring attention.

Support the monitoring of action plans resulting from audits and contribute to the follow-up of improvement actions with the relevant stakeholders.

Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to the internal audit process and contribute to sharing lessons learned and best practices.

Work collaboratively with Quality, Operations, Engineering and other stakeholders to support the successful deployment and continuous improvement of the digital audit approach.

jobs.title: Comercial de Software B2B | IA y Transformación Digital
jobs.description:
El Puesto

Serás responsable de impulsar el crecimiento comercial de nuestras soluciones ERP, software de gestión, movilidad, planificación, RR. HH. e Inteligencia Artificial en clientes nuevos y existentes. Trabajarás en un entorno B2B tecnológico, con ciclos de venta consultivos y clientes de tamaño medio y grande, colaborando estrechamente con los equipos de producto, consultoría, marketing y dirección.

Inteligencia Artificial: una parte importante de tu trabajo
En Freematica estamos incorporando la IA como una nueva capa de valor sobre nuestras soluciones y también como herramienta para transformar nuestra propia forma de trabajar.

Por ello, buscamos una persona que tenga interés real por la Inteligencia Artificial y sea capaz de incorporarla a su actividad comercial.

Utilizarás herramientas de IA para:

  • Mejorar la prospección y segmentación de cuentas
  • Preparar reuniones y analizar información de clientes
  • Identificar necesidades y oportunidades de negocio
  • Personalizar mensajes y propuestas comerciales
  • Analizar conversaciones, oportunidades y pipeline
  • Automatizar tareas comerciales y administrativas
  • Generar contenidos y argumentarios comerciales
  • Obtener insights a partir de datos y actividad comercial
  • Explorar nuevos casos de uso de IA aplicables a nuestros clientes y sectores
No buscamos necesariamente un perfil técnico de IA. Buscamos una persona con curiosidad, criterio y capacidad para entender cómo aplicar la tecnología y la IA para conseguir mejores resultados comerciales y aportar más valor al cliente.


Responsabilidades

  • Dominar rápidamente nuestro producto: comprender en profundidad nuestras soluciones, módulos, arquitectura básica y principales casos de uso para poder mantener conversaciones de valor tanto con perfiles de negocio como técnicos
  • Venta consultiva B2B: analizar los procesos, necesidades y retos del cliente, entender su modelo operativo y proponer la solución tecnológica que mejor responda a sus objetivos
  • Prospección y generación de negocio: identificar empresas objetivo, detectar oportunidades, realizar contactos iniciales, cualificar leads y desarrollar nuevas cuentas
  • Discovery y análisis de necesidades: preparar y dirigir reuniones de descubrimiento, identificar pain points, interlocutores, procesos, necesidades y criterios de decisión
  • Presentaciones y demos comerciales: presentar nuestras soluciones de forma orientada al negocio, adaptando el discurso a cada sector y perfil interlocutor
  • Diseño y seguimiento del proceso comercial: trabajar con un proceso estructurado y un pipeline definido: prospección → cualificación → discovery → demo → propuesta → negociación → cierre
  • Gestión rigurosa del CRM: mantener Salesforce actualizado, registrar actividad, próximos pasos, probabilidad de cierre, interlocutores y cualquier información relevante de las oportunidades
  • Forecast comercial: realizar previsiones de ventas rigurosas, identificar riesgos y mantener actualizado el estado real de cada oportunidad
  • Elaboración de propuestas a medida: coordinarte con los equipos de producto, consultoría y tecnología para transformar las necesidades detectadas en propuestas claras, viables y competitivas
  • Gestión de cuentas y crecimiento: detectar oportunidades de ampliación, nuevas soluciones, servicios y funcionalidades dentro de nuestra base instalada


Requisitos

  • Experiencia previa de 4-6 años o más en venta consultiva B2B de tecnología, preferiblemente en ERP, software de gestión empresarial, SaaS, Cloud, IT o soluciones digitales
  • Alta capacidad de aprendizaje técnico: comodidad trabajando con productos complejos y capacidad para traducir funcionalidades tecnológicas a beneficios de negocio
  • Experiencia en procesos de venta consultiva y ciclos comerciales B2B
  • Mentalidad de proceso y orientación a métricas
  • Experiencia trabajando con CRM (preferiblemente Salesforce), pipeline, forecast y metodologías comerciales estructuradas
  • Rigor en el seguimiento de oportunidades y reporting
  • Orientación a resultados y al cierre, manteniendo una visión de relación a largo plazo con el cliente
  • Capacidad para mantener conversaciones con diferentes interlocutores: dirección, operaciones, RR. HH., administración, IT, etc.
  • Autonomía y proactividad:
    • Capacidad para organizar tu agenda y priorizar cuentas
    • Iniciativa para generar oportunidades y abrir nuevas puertas
    • Capacidad para tomar decisiones y avanzar sin supervisión constante
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, presentación y negociación
  • Interés y conocimientos prácticos en Inteligencia Artificial y herramientas de productividad basadas en IA
  • Residencia en España y disponibilidad para desplazamientos puntuales a clientes y oficinas
Se valorará muy positivamente
  • Formación en áreas tecnológicas, empresariales o similares: Ingeniería, ADE, Economía, Informática, etc.
  • Experiencia previa en software empresarial, ERP o SaaS B2B
  • Experiencia en proyectos de transformación digital o implantación de soluciones de gestión
  • Conocimiento de los sectores de Limpieza, Facility, Seguridad, Servicios, Outsourcing o Instalaciones, o sectores con modelos operativos similares
  • Experiencia utilizando herramientas de IA generativa como ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude u otras herramientas similares aplicadas al trabajo diario
  • Conocimientos sobre automatización de procesos, agentes de IA, análisis de datos o aplicación de IA a procesos empresariales
  • Experiencia trabajando con equipos de Marketing y Product
  • Conocimiento de metodologías de venta consultiva y frameworks comerciales
  • Experiencia con Salesforce u otros CRM
  • Nivel de inglés suficiente para trabajar con documentación técnica y tecnológica


Tus ventajas

  • Incorporarte a una compañía sólida, con más de 28 años desarrollando software propio de gestión empresarial y una base estable de clientes en toda España
  • Trabajar con un producto tecnológico real, complejo y con un amplio recorrido de evolución
  • Participar en un momento especialmente interesante de transformación de nuestro producto, con el desarrollo de nuevas soluciones basadas en movilidad, automatización e Inteligencia Artificial
  • Formar parte de un equipo técnico y especializado donde tu opinión puede influir tanto en el producto como en la estrategia comercial
  • Oportunidad real de crecimiento profesional en el área comercial y de desarrollo de negocio
  • Entorno donde se valoran la iniciativa, la autonomía, el rigor y la capacidad de aportar
  • Acompañamiento inicial para que puedas conocer nuestro producto, nuestros sectores y nuestra metodología comercial
  • Condiciones competitivas acordes a la experiencia aportada, con fijo + variable por objetivos


Esperamos recibir su solicitud.

Más que un perfil que simplemente "venda software", buscamos a una persona que quiera convertirse en referente comercial de nuestras soluciones. Alguien capaz de sentarse con un cliente, entender cómo funciona su negocio, detectar dónde están sus problemas, explicar cómo puede ayudar la tecnología y construir una propuesta que tenga sentido tanto operativa como económicamente.Y, especialmente, alguien que entienda que la IA no es solo una tecnología más, sino una nueva forma de trabajar, vender y aportar valor a nuestros clientes.Si te motiva vender soluciones tecnológicas complejas, disfrutas entendiendo el negocio del cliente, tienes curiosidad por la tecnología y la IA y te gusta construir relaciones comerciales basadas en confianza, conocimiento y resultados, nos encantará conocerte.Envíanos tu CV y cuéntanos brevemente qué proyectos de venta consultiva tecnológica has liderado, qué tipo de soluciones has vendido y cómo estás utilizando actualmente la IA en tu trabajo.

jobs.title: Can you combine structured project delivery with a practical understanding of manufacturing and factory operations?
jobs.description:
Bergen Engines is entering an important phase of factory development and production ramp-up. To support this, we are strengthening the Special Projects team with two to three Project Managers who can lead cross-functional initiatives and help turn our operational ambitions into practical, executable projects. Reporting to the Head of Special Projects, you will work closely with Manufacturing, Assembly, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, HSE, Facilities and Finance. The project portfolio is expected to include assembly-capacity and ramp-up initiatives, factory layout and material-flow improvements, tooling and facility investments, CAPEX projects and other operational-improvement activities required to increase manufacturing capability towards 2028.     Your key responsibilities
  • Define project scope, objectives, deliverables and success criteria.
  • Develop and maintain credible project plans covering milestones, resources, costs and dependencies.
  • Coordinate cross-functional project teams and ensure clear ownership of actions.
  • Identify and manage project risks, issues, changes and key decisions.
  • Maintain accurate forecasts and escalate constraints or decisions early.
  • Support business cases, investment requests and CAPEX governance where applicable.
  • Work directly with factory teams to understand constraints and implement practical solutions.
  • Drive projects relating to capacity, throughput, assembly flow, material readiness, layout, tooling and process improvement.
  • Provide concise and transparent progress reporting to project sponsors and relevant governance forums.
  • Ensure that projects are delivered safely, on time, within approved cost and with measurable operational benefits.
  • Coordinate effective handover of completed projects into the responsible operational organisation.
Who are we looking for?  We are looking for people who combine structured project delivery with a practical understanding of manufacturing and factory operations. You may already work as a Project Manager, or you may have led substantial projects or workstreams within Manufacturing, Assembly, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Facilities or another relevant area.   Your qualifications: 
  • Education within technical fields and knowledge of manufacturing. If you have particularly long and relevant experience the education requirement may be disregarded. 
  • 8-10 years of experience from related role.
  • Experience from planning and delivering cross-functional projects or significant work packages.
  • A good understanding of complex engineering or manufacturing environments.
  • The ability to convert broad objectives into clear actions, milestones and accountabilities.
  • A practical and visible approach, including working directly with teams on the factory floor.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of project costs, benefits and priorities.
  • A strong commitment to safety, quality and sustainable operational improvement.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Fluent skills in both writing and orally in English and preferably also in Norwegian.
Knowledge of Bergen Engines’ products, manufacturing processes, assembly operations and internal systems will be an advantage. A formal project-management or relevant technical qualification is beneficial, but a demonstrated record of successful delivery is equally important.   Your personal characteristics
  • Ability to work independently towards goals. 
  • A good team player. 
  • Good cooperative and communicative skills. 
  • Structured and analytical. 
  • Curious and outgoing, not afraid to ask questions and suggest improvements. 
  • The confidence to challenge constructively, resolve obstacles and escalate decisions when necessary.
  • Strong coordination and stakeholder-management skills.
 

Why choose Bergen Engines?

For more than 80 years, Bergen Engines has delivered world-class power and propulsion systems to customers around the globe. Today, we're playing a key role in the maritime industry through innovative and efficient engine technology.

From our headquarters in Bergen, Norway, we work closely with customers worldwide, combining Norwegian engineering expertise with international reach. As part of the Langley Holdings Power Solutions Division, we're investing in growth, new markets, and the people who will help drive our future success.

These positions offer an opportunity to:
  • Contribute directly to Bergen Engines’ future manufacturing capability.
  • Lead visible projects with tangible operational impact.
  • Work across multiple functions and broaden your business experience.
  • Help shape how strategic factory projects are planned, governed and delivered.
  • Develop further within project management and operational leadership.

 

What we offer:

  • At Bergen Engines, you'll have the opportunity to work with advanced technology, international customers and colleagues who are passionate about what they do.
  • Meaningful work that contributes to a more sustainable future.
  • An international environment with exciting growth opportunities.
  • Professional and personal development in a technology-driven company.
  • Competitive salary and company-wide bonus scheme.
  • Flexible working hours and strong work-life balance.
  • Excellent pension and insurance arrangements.
  • Company cabin at Kvamskogen and employee discount programs.
  • Active sports clubs and social activities.
  • Occupational health services.
  • A highly skilled team that supports and challenges each other.

 

Are you ready to join our team?

At Bergen Engines, you'll join one of Norway's leading industrial technology companies and help deliver the power solutions that keep the world moving.

Work location is our headquarters and production facility at Hordvikneset, approximately 20 km north of Bergen city centre.

The position reports to Head of Special Projects- Nanda Kishore. 

For questions please contact: Nanda per mobile +4748286461 or e-mail nanda.kishore@bergenengines.com

Application deadline: 20.09.2026. Applications will be reviewed continuously.


Bergen Engines bygger og utvikler medium speed-motorer til landbaserte anlegg og til applikasjoner i den maritime næringen. Våre motorer er kjent for kvalitet og pålitelighet, og har en ingeniørtradisjon som strekker seg tilbake til 1855 da Bergen Mekaniske Verksted (BMV) ble etablert. Bedriften bygde sin første dieselmotor i 1946, og siden den gang har over 7500 motorer blitt levert der over halvparten fortsatt er i drift i dag. Tidligere kjent som Rolls-Royce Bergen Engines, ble bedriften en del av det britiske, privateide ingeniørselskapet Langley Holdings plc. 31. desember 2021.
