jobs.title: Business Development Manager til Danmarks nationale klynge for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed
jobs.description:
CenSec – Center for Defence, Space & Security 

Vil du arbejde med at styrke vækst, innovation og internationalisering inden for den danske forsvarssektor? Og være med til at udvikle Danmarks nationale innovations- og erhvervsklynge for aktører inden for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed?   

  

Om stillingen 

CenSecs mission er at være drivkraften bag et stærkt dansk SMV-økosystem, der former fremtidens løsninger inden for forsvar, sikkerhed og rum – og som Business Development Manager kommer du til at spille en vigtig rolle her.   

Du kommer til at arbejde primært med klyngens forsvarsdomæne og med et særligt fokus på droner, autonome enheder og internationalt samarbejde. 

En del af arbejdet udføres på tværs af projekter, hvor du vil få ansvaret for leverancerne heri, som bl.a. indbefatter dialog med industrien.  

Du får til opgave at planlægge og afvikle forskellige klyngeaktiviteter, lige fra mindre netværksmøder til større konferencer. Klyngeaktiviteterne skal hjælpe CenSecs medlemmer med at få ny viden, skabe samarbejde på tværs og øge medlemmernes kommercielle udvikling. Aktiviteterne har både nationalt og internationalt fokus. 

Udover arbejdet med klyngeaktiviteterne får du til opgave at rekruttere nye medlemmer, være kontaktperson for medlemsvirksomheder og deltage i interne udviklingsopgaver- og processer.  

Arbejdet med udvikling af klyngen omfatter også en del administration, opgaver relateret til formidling og kommunikation, samt samarbejde med andre aktører i det forsvarsindustrielle økosystem på både nationalt og europæisk niveau.  

 

Din profil 

Der kan være mange indgangsvinkler til denne stilling, og vi stiller derfor ikke krav til en særlig baggrund. Vigtigst er det at du er en “do’er”, som har vilje og evne til at omsætte input og viden til konkret værdi for vores medlemmer og samarbejdspartnere.

Vi forventer en høj grad af selvstændighed og professionalisme, og at du kan varetage det ansvar og mandat, der medfølger at være ansat i den nationale klyngeorganisation for forsvarsindustrien. 

Derudover er du ekstrovert, kommunikativt stærk, omstillingsparat, fleksibel og taler og skriver engelsk på højt niveau. 

 

Vi tilbyder 

En betydningsfuld rolle i en internationalt anerkendt klyngeorganisation, som skaber innovation, vækst og arbejdspladser. Du får opgaver og muligheder, der medfører faglig og personlig udvikling i et internationalt miljø med ansvar efter evner og ambitioner.  

Dine kollegaer er ambitiøse, humoristiske og uformelle, og trods forskellige ansvarsområder, arbejder vi sammen som et team og hjælper hinanden.  

Vi tilbyder en fleksibel arbejdsuge med to ugentlige fremmødedage på vores kontor i Viborg og hjemmearbejde de resterende ugedage.  

 

Arbejdstid og løn m.m. 

Arbejdstiden er 37 timer ugentligt på funktionærvilkår. 

I forbindelse med projekt- og klyngeaktiviteter i ind- og udland vil der være nogen rejseaktivitet, som altid aftales på forhånd og i god tid. 

Løn efter kvalifikationer og evner til at skabe værdi for CenSec. 

 

Læs mere om CenSec her: www.censec.dk  

 

Om CenSec 

CenSec er Danmarks nationale klynge for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed.  

Som national klynge er vores mandat at samle og styrke hele økosystemet, heriblandt virksomheder, videninstitutioner og myndigheder. 

Vi har en dyb forståelse af økosystemet og en dybdegående viden om vores medlemmer. Vores ambition er at være et omdrejningspunkt hvor alle aktører ser os som den primære drivkraft til at fremme samarbejde på tværs og øge innovation i industrien.  
  
Vi er en tillidsbaseret og stærk medlemsorganisation. Siden 2004 har vi arbejdet for at styrke netværk, samarbejds- og forretningsmuligheder på tværs af sektorer og grænser, gennem facilitering af nationale og internationale netværksaktiviteter.  
  
CenSec – skaber innovation, vækst og robusthed for Danmark.  

  

Ansøgning 

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kontakt venligst Anders Laustsen, på tlf. 52 13 15 42 eller skriv til anders@censec.dk  

Vi ser frem til at modtage din motiverede ansøgning og CV til samme mailadresse snarest muligt og senest den 27. september 2026. 

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes gennemført løbende med henblik på ansættelse hurtigst muligt. Vi forbeholder os ret til at ansætte før deadline, hvis vi finder den rette kandidat.

jobs.title: HVAC Design Engineer - Offshore Substations; Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, PL - Gdynia
jobs.description:
Are you a Mechanical Engineer with HVAC design experience and a passion for creating robust technical solutions? Do you want to design HVAC systems for offshore substations supporting some of the world's largest renewable energy projects? Then this could be your next opportunity.

Your Position

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Mechanical Engineer with experience in HVAC system design to strengthen our HVAC team.

In your new position as HVAC Engineer in the Renewables division, you will join our experienced Mechanical & HVAC team. You will design and engineer HVAC systems for offshore substations and work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, clients, suppliers, procurement, fabrication yards and commissioning teams.

You will contribute throughout the project lifecycle, from concept and tender work through detailed design, procurement, construction support and commissioning. Your work will help create robust, safe and efficient HVAC solutions for complex offshore installations.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be either Esbjerg, Nordhavn or Gdynia. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

In this role, you will primarily work on EPCI (Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Installation) contracts for offshore substation projects.

Typical responsibilities include developing HVAC design solutions and technical documentation for offshore substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

  • Design, Engineering & System Integration: Designing ventilation, cooling, heating and pressurization systems, including calculations and equipment sizing.
  • Developing HVAC philosophies, specifications, diagrams, technical requisitions and other project documentation.
  • Compliance, HSE & Quality Assurance: Ensure full compliance with applicable standards, codes, and regulatory requirements, while supporting and adhering to health, safety, and environmental standards in all activities throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Specifying HVAC equipment and supporting procurement, bid evaluation, vendor follow-up and document review.
  • Coordinating technical interfaces with electrical, structural, piping, fire protection and control system disciplines, and participating in client meetings and design reviews.
  • Supporting fabrication, testing and commissioning activities, including FATs, SATs and site support when required, while adhering to health, safety and environmental standards.

Your profile & qualifications

We are looking for a structured and solution-oriented Mechanical Engineer who is passionate about HVAC design and wants to make a personal contribution to offshore renewable energy projects. You collaborate effectively across disciplines, communicate clearly and take ownership of your engineering deliverables.
We are looking for an outgoing and positive professional who is passionate about renewable energy and wants to leave their personal mark on it. You have a proactive and organised approach to your work and are eager to help innovate the future of sustainable solutions

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering or another relevant engineering discipline.
  • Experience with HVAC engineering and design, preferably from industrial, marine, energy or offshore projects.
  • Knowledge of ventilation, cooling, refrigeration, heating and pressurization systems, including DX and water-based cooling solutions.
  • Experience with technical documentation, equipment specifications and coordination in multidisciplinary EPC projects; offshore substation, offshore wind, marine or industrial plant experience is considered a strong advantage.
  • Professional English communication skills and a strong commitment to teamwork, quality and safety.
  • A strong focus on quality and safety, demonstrated through attention to detail and adherence to HSE requirements.


Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
For questions, contact Rafid Kajo, Manager, Mechanical & HVAC, at +45 7916 6867 or +45 3016 6613

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Senior Contract Manager - Renewables; Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, PL - Gdynia
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced and proactive contract professional, and do you want to leave your mark on the global energy industry? If so, we want to hear from you!
 
Your position 
In your new position as Senior Contract Manager in the Renewables division, you will be a valuable member of the dedicated Contract Management Team whose mission is to ensure effective and compliant contract management and execution across large-scale EPC and service projects. You will have the chance to drive and improve our contract management framework while ensuring the commercial success of the projects. 

Your place of work will be in one of our offices in Denmark (Esbjerg or Copenhagen) or in Poland (Gdynia), depending on your preference and location. The position is full-time, and you can expect to have 10-30 days of travel per year.
“We are looking for a colleague who can support our EPC and service projects in achieving success by confidently managing complex contract environments, raising commercial awareness in project teams and contributing to the development of the Contract Management Team through exchange of experience and lessons learned, and continuous process improvement.”                                                                                                                                   – Grant Bruce Hewitt, Head of Contract Management, Renewables 
 
Your tasks & responsibilities

As a Senior Contract Manager, your responsibility will, first of all, be to conduct excellent contract life cycle management of EPC contracts and consortium agreements which includes: 

  • Contract reviews during the tender phase, ensuring flowdowns to supply chain contracts, and participation in EPC and service contract negotiations
  • Raising awareness of contract terms within the project team, and acting as the project’s advisor on project contract and commercial matters  
  • Identifying and managing commercial risks in collaboration with project teams
  • Close cooperation with the project procurement lead to ensure that flow-down contract rights and obligations are maintained
  • Ensuring contract compliance and governance
  • Management of variations and claims
  • Preparing reports to management and customers and ensuring structured communication
  • Capturing lessons learned and contributing to continuous process improvement

 
Your profile & qualifications 

We are looking for a confident and collaborative contract management professional, who is passionate to ensure commercial success, progress and the safe and high-quality execution of projects. You have a proactive and structured approach to your work and are eager to optimize and improve.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • A master’s degree in law/commercial law or a related commercial discipline
  • Preferably 5+ years of experience with large scale EPC contracts in the offshore industry or any related industry
  • Extensive experience with contract and claims management
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is expected, fluency in German (written and spoken) will be an advantage

Furthermore, it is important that you have a flexible, empathic and team-oriented mindset as you will work closely with both internal and external stakeholders. 

The Contract Management team takes pride in supporting and bringing out the best in each other. You will join a team where good interpersonal skills, humour, social activities, and the readiness to go the extra mile for your colleagues are fundamental to our team spirit.
 
Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.
While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.
So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. 

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.  
Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Johtava sosiaalityöntekijä, Soihtu, Salo
jobs.description:
Tehtäväsi

Johtavana sosiaalityöntekijänä toimit Asiakasohjaus Soihdun itäisen alueen tiimin lähiesihenkilönä. Vastaat Salon, Salon poliisiasemalla toimivan Ankkuri-toiminnan sekä Paimion toimipisteiden henkilöstön esihenkilötyöstä ja toiminnan kehittämisestä.

Asiakasohjaus Soihtu vastaanottaa ja käsittelee kaikki alle 65-vuotiaiden sosiaalihuoltolain ja lastensuojelulain mukaiset ilmoitukset ja yhteydenotot uusien asiakkaiden kohdalla sekä toteuttaa palvelutarpeen arviointia. Lisäksi Soihtu arvioi ja toteuttaa kiireellisiä lastensuojelun tukitoimia.

Tehtävässäsi toimit moniammatillisen yhteistyön asiantuntijana ja rakennat toimivia yhteistyökäytäntöjä eri viranomaisten, kuntien ja järjestötoimijoiden kanssa. Vastaat osaltasi työn sisällön ja yhteistyöverkostojen kehittämisestä sekä huolehdit sujuvasta yhteistyöstä eri toimijoiden välillä. Tehtävä voi sisältää tarvittaessa myös asiakastyötä.

Toiminta-alueeseen kuuluvat Salo, Somero, Paimio ja Sauvo. Vakituiset toimipisteet sijaitsevat Salossa ja Paimiossa, minkä lisäksi teemme jalkautuvaa työtä alueen muihin kuntiin.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Pääset osaksi sitoutunutta, kokenutta ja moniammatillista työyhteisöä, jossa työtä tehdään yhdessä asiakkaiden parhaaksi.

Salon Soihtu-tiimissä työskentelee johtavan sosiaalityöntekijän lisäksi kahdeksan sosiaalityöntekijää, kuusi sosiaaliohjaajaa sekä sairaanhoitaja. Tiimin tukena toimii myös vakituinen perheterapeutti vahvistamassa systeemistä työotetta.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vaikuttavan tehtävän, jossa pääset hyödyntämään johtamisosaamistasi, kehittämään palveluita sekä tukemaan henkilöstön työhyvinvointia ja ammatillista onnistumista. Etsimme tiimille esihenkilöä, joka johtaa työtä positiivisella sykkeellä ja innostaa myös muita onnistumaan.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Toivomme sinulta vahvaa kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä sekä laaja-alaista sosiaali- ja lastensuojelupalveluiden osaamista. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää hyviä esihenkilö- ja johtamistaitoja, vahvaa sosiaalihuollon lainsäädännön tuntemusta sekä kykyä itsenäiseen päätöksentekoon.

Arvostamme erityisesti kykyä tukea vaativaa asiakastyötä, edistää työhyvinvointia sekä ylläpitää myönteistä ja kannustavaa työilmapiiriä. Lisäksi odotamme sinulta erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja moniammatillisessa toimintaympäristössä sekä valmiutta toimia muuttuvassa ja nopeatempoisessa työssä.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (817/2015) 7 §:n mukainen kelpoisuus tehtävään. Lisäksi tehtävässä edellytetään erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa ja tyydyttävää ruotsin kielen taitoa.

jobs.title: Lärare inom småbarnspedagogik till Folkhälsans daghem i Hyvinge
jobs.description:
På Folkhälsan jobbar vi tillsammans för en god vardag för små och stora. Vi är en hälsofrämjande organisation och en familjevänlig arbetsplats, som arbetsgivare är vi flexibla och pålitliga. Vi jobbar aktivt för jämlikhet, värdesätter mångfald på vår arbetsplats och uppmuntrar personer med olika bakgrund och som tillhör olika minoriteter att söka jobb hos oss. Kom och jobba med oss!

Folkhälsan Välfärd Ab rekryterar en lärare inom småbarnspedagogik

till daghemmet i Hyvinge för en tillsvidareanställning. Arbetet är på heltid och inleds enligt överenskommelse under hösten 2026.

Hyvinge daghem är beläget centralt i Hyvinge med parker och natur på gångavstånd. Vi finns i samma byggnad som Svenska skolan i Hyvinge och har ett aktivt samarbete samt möjlighet att använda både gymnastiksal och slöjdsal i vår verksamhet. Tillsammans med Svenska skolan i Hyvinge bildar vi en helhet där barnens lärstig fortsätter naturligt från småbarnspedagogiken till grundläggande utbildningen. Välkommen att jobba för en svenskspråkig helhet på en språkö!

Vi erbjuder småbarnspedagogik och förskoleundervisning samt språkbadsinriktad verksamhet. Du tar dig smidigt till daghemmet med tåg eller buss.

Som lärare inom småbarnspedagogik ansvarar du för och planerar den pedagogiska verksamheten. Arbetet sker i en miljö med kunniga pedagoger samt andra sakkunniga. Du är teamledare för ditt arbetsteam. På daghemmet arbetar vi i enlighet med Grunderna för planen för småbarnspedagogik samt Folkhälsans handbok. Vi erbjuder dig en arbetsplats där du har möjlighet att påverka och utveckla ditt arbete. Förmågor så som kreativitet, samarbetsvilja, flexibilitet, kommunikation och hälsofrämjande arbetssätt värderas hos oss.

Behörighetsvillkor är behörighet enligt lagen om småbarnspedagogik (540/2018) eller enligt rådande övergångsbestämmelse (75 §): pedagogie kandidat (lärare inom småbarnspedagogik), lämplig yrkeshögskoleexamen eller tidigare motsvarande examen på institutnivå, t.ex. barnträdgårdslärare eller socialpedagog.

Vi erbjuder dig en inkluderande arbetsgemenskap där alla stöder varandra. Du får tillgång till olika personalförmåner (bl.a. företagshälsovård via Mehiläinen och ePassi-förmån) för att du skall må bra i ditt arbete, samt utbildningsdagar och sektorsspecifika utbildningar i Eduhouse för att få goda förutsättningar för att utvecklas professionellt. Lön enligt kollektivavtalet för den privata småbarnspedagogiken med möjlighet till personliga tillägg.
Den som väljs till arbetet bör uppvisa utdrag ur straffregistret enligt 6 § 2 mom. i straffregisterlagen samt tuberkulosutredning enligt 55 § i lagen om smittsamma sjukdomar. Folkhälsan är en rökfri arbetsplats.

Läs mer om oss här: [Hyvinge daghem - Folkhälsan](https://www.folkhalsan.fi/service/daghem/hyvinge-daghem) och följ oss gärna på Instagram för att se mer av vår verksamhet: [@hyvingedagis](https://www.instagram.com/hyvingedagis/)

För närmare information om jobbet kan du kontakta enhetschef Anna Holmgren per e-post, anna.holmgren@folkhalsan.fi , eller per telefon, +358 44 788 3670.

Använd gärna det elektroniska ansökningsformuläret när du skickar in din ansökan. Vi intervjuar under ansökningstiden och platsen fylls genast då lämplig person hittas.

Vi ser fram emot att få höra mer om dig!

Honkajoki Oy on Suomen johtava eläinperäisten sivutuotteiden käsittelijä ja jalostaja. Suomessa muodostuu vuosittain arviolta noin 260 000 tonnia eläinperäisiä sivutuotteita. Tästä lähes 80 % käsitellään Honkajoki Oy:n laitoksissa Suomen ja EU:n lakien edellyttämällä tavalla teollisuudessa hyödynnettäviksi tuotteiksi.

Valmistamme lihatuotannon yhteydessä syntyneistä sivutuotteista korkealaatuisia, puhtaita ja turvallisia tuotteita eri teollisuudenaloilla työskenteleville asiakkaillemme. Samalla annamme ravintoketjusta lähtöisin oleville aineksille uuden elämän hyödykkeinä, joita voidaan käyttää uusina raaka-aineina esimerkiksi eläinten ruoissa, lannoitteissa ja biopolttoaineissa.

jobs.title: Land Development & Field Clearing Manager
jobs.description:
**PURPOSE OF THE ROLE**

Lead the first physical execution phase of the programme: land preparation, field clearing and efficient recovery of biomass generated during clearing.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

· Prepare clearing and land-development plans.

· Tender and manage clearing and earthworks contractors.

· Plan heavy-equipment fleets and production rates.

· Organise biomass recovery, sorting and transport to biochar plants.

· Maintain biomass and timber mass balances.

· Prepare cleared land for the following cultivation phase.

· Control clearing cost per hectare and contractor productivity.

· Ensure environmental, community and HSE requirements are met.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND CAPABILITY**

· Experience in major earthworks, forestry, agriculture, land development or infrastructure projects.

· Strong knowledge of heavy equipment and field productivity.

· Demonstrated site-management experience.

· Ability to manage contractors in remote and developing-site conditions.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

· Tropical or West African project experience.

· Biomass recovery / forestry logistics experience.

· ESG-sensitive land development experience.

**KEY SUCCESS MEASURES**

· Safe hectares cleared to plan.

· Biomass recovery rate and cost per hectare.

· Land handed over on time for cultivation.

**RECRUITMENT PRINCIPLE**

We are looking first and foremost for hands-on implementers with a proven record of taking real industrial or infrastructure projects from planning through procurement, construction, commissioning and operation.

The roles are part of an international renewable-energy, circular-economy, biorefining and industrial side-stream utilisation investment programme with Côte dIvoire as the principal implementation country. The portfolio includes both fast-start production projects and later large-scale industrial investments.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

A reasonable level of working English is essential. French language skills are a major advantage.

**EXPECTED WORKING STYLE**

· Practical, decisive and delivery-oriented.

· Fact-based, using measurable results and documented data.

· Prepared to challenge supplier assumptions and verify operating references.

· Able to work in a multicultural environment and build local capability.

· Understands that pilot testing, customer qualification and phased scale-up are central risk-management tools.

**EMPLOYMENT AND LOCATION**

Employment form, work location and travel requirements will be defined role by role. Some positions may begin in Finland or elsewhere in Europe, but several key roles will require significant presence in Côte dIvoire during implementation phases.

jobs.title: VVS-Montør søges
jobs.description:
Erfaren VVS-montør søges

Vil du være en del af en veldrevet virksomhed med høj faglighed, stor frihed og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab?

Niels Mølgaard ApS søger en dygtig og engageret VVS-montør, der er klar til nye udfordringer og ønsker at blive en del af et professionelt team med fokus på kvalitet, service og godt håndværk.

Trives du i en hverdag med afvekslende opgaver, ansvar og tæt kontakt til kunder? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Om stillingen

Med reference til afdelingslederen bliver du en del af en veletableret og dynamisk VVS-installationsvirksomhed, hvor kvalitet, faglig stolthed og et godt arbejdsmiljø er centrale værdier.

Hos os er medarbejderne vores vigtigste ressource. Derfor lægger vi stor vægt på godt kollegaskab, sammenhold, humor og en positiv omgangstone i hverdagen. Du får primært arbejdsområde i Aarhus og omegn, hvor du kommer til at servicere både private- og erhvervskunder.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du vil få en alsidig hverdag med spændende opgaver inden for:

• Service- og reparationsarbejde for private kunder, erhvervskunder og boligforeninger

• Renoverings- og ombygningsprojekter

• Energioptimering og energirenoveringer

• Mindre entrepriser

• Fejlfinding, vedligeholdelse og kundeservice

Arbejdet udføres hovedsageligt i Aarhus og omegn.

Vi tilbyder

• Et spændende og fast job i en solid virksomhed med ordnede forhold

• Stor grad af frihed under ansvar i et velfungerende team af kompetente og erfarne kolleger

• En flad organisation med kort vej fra idé til handling og solid administrativ opbakning i hverdagen

• Attraktiv lønpakke efter kvalifikationer, firmabil og smartphone til rådighed

• Moderne værkstedsfaciliteter, herunder komplet blikkenslagerværksted

• Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling gennem kurser og efteruddannelse

• Sociale arrangementer og et stærkt fællesskab

Vi forventer, at du

• Er uddannet VVS-montør og gerne kompetent erfaring

• Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og ansvarsbevidst

• Har fokus på kvalitet og god service

• Er samarbejdsvillig og bidrager positivt til teamet

• Bevarer overblikket i en travl hverdag

• Har almindeligt kørekort (kategori B)

Tiltrædelse

Efter aftale, gerne hurtigst muligt.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@nmvvs.dk med emnet "VVS-montør".

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig og måske byde dig velkommen som vores nye kollega hos Niels Mølgaard ApS.

Om virksomheden

Niels Mølgaard ApS er en familieejet virksomhed, etableret i 1984, og er i dag blandt Østjyllands førende specialister inden for VVS, energi og blik. Virksomheden løser opgaver for både private kunder, erhverv og entrepriser og har stor fokus på kvalitet, faglighed og godt håndværk. Med ca. 30 medarbejdere og løbende efteruddannelse af alle ansatte tilbyder Niels Mølgaard ApS et professionelt og udviklende arbejdsmiljø. Virksomheden har adresse i Højbjerg ved Aarhus og omfatter desuden søsterselskaberne NME Ejendomsadministration og VVS-shoppen.dk

jobs.title: Rengøringstekniker søges
jobs.description:
Rengøringstekniker søges – gerne med erfaring i gulv- og murbehandling

Vi søger en dygtig og kvalitetsbevidst rengøringstekniker, som har lyst til at blive en del af vores team. Vi lægger vægt på godt håndværk, grundighed og høj service – og vi ser meget gerne, at du har erfaring med specialrengøring, gulvbehandling og behandling af murværk/facader.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver vil variere og kan blandt andet omfatte:

  • Daglig og periodisk rengøring

  • Hovedrengøring og specialrengøring

  • Gulvbehandling, herunder grundrens, skuring, polish og pleje af forskellige gulvtyper

  • Maskinel gulvrengøring

  • Mur- og facadebehandling, herunder afrensning og rengøring af forskellige overflader

  • Klargøring og efterbehandling af overflader

  • Anvendelse af professionelle rengøringsmaskiner, produkter og metoder

  • Kvalitetskontrol af eget arbejde

  • Dialog og god service over for kunder

Vi forestiller os, at du

Har erfaring som rengøringstekniker eller med professionel rengøring. Det er en stor fordel, hvis du har praktisk erfaring med gulvbehandlinger og mur-/facadebehandlinger og er vant til at arbejde med maskiner og professionelle rengøringsmidler.

Du arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret, tager ansvar for dine opgaver og går op i at levere et flot resultat. Samtidig forventer vi, at du er stabil, fleksibel og serviceminded og kan indgå positivt i et team.

Relevant uddannelse eller kurser inden for rengøring og overfladebehandling er en fordel, men praktisk erfaring og den rette indstilling vægter højt.

Kørekort B er en fordel

Vi tilbyder

Et alsidigt job med forskellige typer opgaver og mulighed for at bruge dine faglige kompetencer inden for både almindelig rengøring og specialopgaver.

Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi lægger vægt på kvalitet, ordentlighed og godt samarbejde. Vi tilbyder gode kolleger, grundig introduktion til opgaverne og mulighed for faglig udvikling.

Ansøgning

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig?

Send en kort ansøgning og gerne dit CV. Fortæl gerne om din erfaring med professionel rengøring og særligt, hvis du har arbejdet med gulvbehandling, specialrengøring eller mur-/facadebehandling.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Ingénieur procédés analytiques H/F (H/F)
jobs.description:
English version below

À la suite d'une mobilité interne, nous recherchons un Ingénieur procédés analytiques (h/f) pour notre laboratoire.

Rejoindre l'équipe du laboratoire pour jouer un rôle central dans l'excellence analytique de notre activité Électronique, un secteur en forte expansion. Vos responsabilités clés vous placeront au cœur de l'innovation et de l'expertise.

Description du poste :

- Piloter l'innovation analytique : Mener les développements analytiques stratégiques et la qualification de nouvelles molécules pour garantir la fiabilité de nos produits.

- Expertise de pointe : Diriger les développements en ICP-MS et Chromatographie Ionique, spécifiquement pour les molécules organosilicitées et organométalliques.

- Partage de connaissances : Former nos équipes aux techniques analytiques les plus avancées et apporter une expertise spécialisée en ICP-MS et Chromatographie Ionique.

- Assurance qualité : Gérer la qualification des nouveaux fournisseurs de molécules et définir les protocoles de qualification en étroite collaboration avec le service Qualité.

- Interface internationale : Servir de point de contact analytique et technique auprès des laboratoires internationaux d'Air Liquide (notamment Fremont et Dallas) pour des études de corrélation stratégiques.

- Leadership et amélioration continue : Contribuer activement à l'amélioration continue en faisant preuve d'une force de proposition affirmée, notamment en matière de sécurité, et en assurant un management transversal efficace.

english version :
- Following an internal mobility within the company, we are seeking a Process Engineer Analytics (m/f) for our laboratory.
- Join the laboratory team to play a central role in the analytical excellence of our Electronics business, a rapidly expanding sector. Your key responsibilities will allow you to be at the forefront of innovation and expertise.
- Drive Analytical Innovation: Lead strategic analytical developments and the qualification of new molecules, thereby ensuring the reliability of our products.
- Cutting-Edge Expertise: Lead developments in ICP-MS and Ion Chromatography, specifically for organosilicate and organometallic molecules.
- Knowledge Sharing: Train our teams on the most advanced analytical techniques and provide specialized expertise in ICP-MS and Ion Chromatography.
- Quality Assurance: Manage the qualification of new molecule suppliers and define qualification protocols in close collaboration with the Quality department.
- International Interface: Act as the analytical and technical point of contact with Air Liquide's international laboratories (notably Fremont and Dallas) for crucial correlation studies.
- Leadership and Continuous Improvement: Actively contribute to continuous improvement, demonstrating a strong proposal-making capacity, particularly regarding safety, and ensuring effective cross-functional management.

jobs.title: AI Response Analyst
jobs.description:
The work

iMerit, an EXL company, is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing.

Much of the job comes down to this: look at the image, look at what the model said about it, and decide whether the two actually match.

What you will do

  • Review images alongside the prompts and responses attached to them

  • Interpret both visual and conversational context before scoring anything

  • Compare multiple responses and rank them against defined criteria

  • Confirm that descriptions and claims about an image reflect what is actually there

  • Verify factual claims using approved research sources

  • Flag tasks that cannot be reliably evaluated

  • Write clear justification for every ranking you submit

What you bring

  • A sharp eye for visual detail and the patience to look twice

  • Strong critical thinking, research skills, and reading comprehension

  • Sound judgment and well supported decision making

  • Professional written English, including the ability to describe what you see precisely

  • The consistency to apply detailed guidelines the same way, task after task

  • Experience in image annotation, content review, editing, research, design, or localization is welcome but not essential.

Good to know

  • Independent contractor engagement for the length of the project.Â 

  • Fully remote with flexible scheduling around agreed deadlines.

  • Tasks include visual content, so a device and connection that display images comfortably are required.

  • Volume varies with project demand.

  • The rate of pay will be specified in the job offer

Do naší party hledáme šikovného kolegu, který se nebojí vzít do ruky nářadí, přemýšlí technicky a má rád poctivě odvedenou práci. Pokud vás láká podílet se na vzniku strojů, které nejsou sériovou výrobou, ale originálním řešením pro konkrétní zákazníky, rádi vás poznáme.

Jsme rodinná firma zaměřená na vývoj a výrobu automatizovaných linek a jednoúčelových strojů. Pracujeme na projektech, které dávají smysl, a hledáme kolegu, který chce růst společně s námi.

Co bude vaším výsledkem práce?
Sestavené a funkční části strojů připravené pro oživení a předání zákazníkovi.
Kvalitně provedené montáže podle technické dokumentace.
Spolehlivě odvedené servisní a montážní práce u zákazníků.
Precizně opracované díly a komponenty připravené pro další výrobu (broušení, jehlení, řezání závitů apod.).

Koho hledáme?
Hledáme člověka, který:
má technické myšlení,
orientuje se ve výkresové dokumentaci,
rozumí mechanice a ideálně zná pneumatické prvky,
je manuálně zručný a pečlivý,
dokáže pracovat samostatně a dotahuje práci do konce,
vlastní řidičský průkaz skupiny B.

Co nabízíme?
Jednosměnný provoz.
Příspěvek na stravování a možnost stravování v závodní jídelně.
Práci na zajímavých zakázkách a unikátních strojích.
Přátelský kolektiv a zázemí stabilní rodinné firmy.
Možnost rychlého profesního růstu a dalšího rozvoje.

Pro koho je tato práce ideální?
Pro člověka, který nechce dělat stále totéž dokola, baví ho technika, rád hledá řešení a chce vidět konkrétní výsledek své práce.

Pokud jste se v tom našli, pošlete nám svůj životopis  a získejte možnost pracovat pro špičkovou firmu v oboru.

jobs.title: Ingénieur en Intelligence Artificielle et Machine Learning (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description du poste :

En postulant à cette offre, vous aurez l'opportunité de rejoindre une entreprise innovante, née de l'alliance entre l'agilité d'une startup et l'envergure d'un leader mondial du supply chain retail. Spécialisée dans les solutions technologiques de pointe pour le retail moderne, cette entité construit les moteurs de décision basés sur l'IA qui optimisent en temps réel les opérations en magasin sur des dizaines de millions de séries temporelles (forecasting probabiliste de la demande, planification de production, pricing dynamique Ils sont à la recherche d'un(e) AI Engineer pour posséder des features IA de bout en bout et assumer la responsabilité directe de leur impact business : moins de gaspillage, moins de ruptures et plus de marge visibles sur le terrain dès le lendemain.

Vos missions si vous les acceptez Posséder des features IA de bout en bout, du cadrage du besoin à la conception, au build, à l'intégration produit et au déploiement en production.***Assurer la responsabilité du cycle de vie complet des modèles : feature engineering, entraînement, évaluation et monitoring.***Faire progresser le cœur technologique de forecasting et d'optimisation (gestion de la demande censurée par les ruptures, estimation du gaspillage, détection d'anomalies d'inventaire Concevoir des systèmes auto-améliorants grâce à des boucles de feedback mesurant la qualité des décisions en production pour accorder automatiquement les modèles.***Contribuer à l'infrastructure agentique à grande échelle orchestrant les pipelines et servant les produits.***Diagnostiquer et résoudre les défaillances en production, du patch d'urgence à la mise en place de solutions durables.***Faire le pont entre la technique et le business en expliquant les sous-performances et en proposant des solutions viables commercialement et techniquement.

Description du profil :

Et vous Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bac+5 obligatoire issu d'une grande école d'ingénieurs ou d'un Master spécialisé en IA avec un profil quantitatif fort.***Vous disposez d'au moins 1 an d'expérience minimum (hors stages et alternances) en tant que AI Engineer ou ML Engineer.***Vous avez un track record prouvé de mise en production de modèles ML (pas uniquement de la R&D) dans des environnements où le taux de service est critique.***Vous possédez une excellente culture ML générale (Transformers, modèles de fondation, mécanismes d'attention) et maîtrisez parfaitement Python.***Vous maîtrisez au moins un cloud provider (GCP, AWS ou autre).Vous parlez un anglais courant et un français courant.***Vous êtes doté d'une culture de 'builder' : créatif, autonome, axé sur l'ownership total et prêt à faire tout ce qu'il faut pour délivrer.

jobs.title: Sales Jedi
jobs.description:
Great salary | Profit share | 100% remote |
Work from anywhere in Europe | SaaS

 

Awesome opportunity for a self-motivated and energetic people person to join our remote team and help sell our world-leading SaaS products, from anywhere in Europe.

We pay a great salary, based on experience and location. We don’t pay commissions, because good sales are a team effort—from engineering, to operations, marketing, and support, our high-performing team all contribute to a great product and service that our clients love. Everybody in the company is rewarded with a share of profit each December—we succeed together.

Our much-loved products are in demand and are proven to make a difference to our clients’ lives. You’ll be selling world-leading software through a well-considered process that leaves room for personal flair.

 

SaaS experience is extremely beneficial but strong communication skills, patience, curiosity, keenness to learn and friendliness are key to success in this role.

Join our Rebel Alliance

Creative Force is experiencing strong growth and as we scale our efforts in 2026 and beyond, we’re looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our diverse team of Jedis to help recruit new clients as they navigate the decision process, and transform them into long-term supporters.

You’ll be a respected member of our remote global sales team and will be well supported with the tools, knowledge and answers you need to provide exceptional levels of service, and to make the most from solid sales traction with our two in-demand products.

As you master the Force and the multitude of skills needed in this role, attracting clients to join our mission, you will be recognised and rewarded with strong career and salary progression.

Responsibilities

 

  • Help prospects find the specific value they seek (this is the product you are looking for)
  • Collaborate with our diverse international team to push us on the leading edge of our fields
  • Learn to be a product expert and confidently answer product questions from prospects
  • Discover how to be an expert in SaaS for recognition programs
  • Master our sales technology stack
  • Support the complete sales cycle, from qualified lead to close
  • Skillfully navigate consultative sales discussions and live demos

Essentials

 

  • Applications are open to all experience levels, with a minimum of 1 year proven success in SaaS sales or a similar role
  • Must live in Europe
  • Digital native, with enthusiasm for technology
  • Discipline and self-motivation (key to success in remote work)
  • Loads of energy, humour, passion, and empathy
  • Genuine interest to help provide amazing value for people
  • Superior communication skills
  • Commitment to continuous improvement
  • You have access to fast, reliable internet and a dedicated space to work without distractions
  • Meet and exceed measurable performance goals to succeed and progress in this role

What we offer

Work-life balance

  • 38 hour work week, Monday to Friday (your weekends are yours)
  • 20 days paid annual leave
  • 20 days paid parental leave (available after one year)
  • 12 days paid public holidays (your local country/region public holidays)
  • Your birthday is a holiday every year

Personal development and wellbeing

  • Commitment to continued learning and development
  • A culture of promoting work life balance
  • Access to mental health support

Location and compensation

  • Full-time role, based remotely, work anywhere within Europe
  • No commission structure. Competitive salary, indexed to your experience and location
  • Budget for computer and office equipment (pending 6 month probationary period)

 

Respect, growth and stability

  • Friendly, sociable, responsible, collaborative team (a great place to be)
  • Respect for each other’s time, value and contribution
  • Regular communication with global team via chat and video calls
  • Dynamic, young, growing tech company leveraging all the latest tech tools and leading industry trends
  • Stable, bootstrapped, independent business (no VCs calling the shots)

jobs.title: SaaS Product Support Jedi
jobs.description:
We’re on the hunt for a sharp, self-driven SaaS pro who’s as comfortable troubleshooting API and integrations as they are navigating human conversations.

Our European client base is growing fast and we need someone who can keep up. Our software isn’t your average plug-and-play; it has a steep learning curve so you’ll need to be technically savvy while also being the kind of person clients genuinely enjoy talking to. If you’ve got SaaS in your DNA, thrive in async/remote environments, and can juggle multiple threads without breaking a sweat — keep reading.

The role

You’ll join a lean, high-performing global support team working across two SaaS products, Award Force and Good Grants. Day to day you’ll be communicating with colleagues and clients across countries, cultures, and time zones.

Support happens across email tickets, phone, and 1-1 Zoom calls. Once you’ve leveled up on product knowledge, you’ll run onboarding sessions and client meetings covering issue resolution, best practices, and product adoption.

You’ll also be hands-on with bug testing and reporting, feeding considered feedback to our product teams— always pushing to make our products better.

We have a startup mindset. We experiment with new tools, iterate on processes, and move fast. Got a great idea? Pitch it. We’re not big on bureaucracy, only results. We don’t expect you to be a slave to your chair but flexibility is a must.

You’ll need to tick these boxes
  • You’re based in the UTC +1 or +2 timezone range. This is non-negotiable. Our European team and clients operate in this window and we don’t allow shift work. If you live outside this range, this one’s not for you
  • 2+ years of professional experience, ideally in a SaaS support or client-facing role
  • Native-level English fluency (bilingual? Even better!)
  • Terms like HTML, CSS, JS, API, integrations, dev console, staging & production environments, GitHub repos, and database queries don’t make you flinch. You don’t need to write code, but you need to get it
  • You’ve got exceptional interpersonal and communication skills—written and verbal
  • Client calls energise you. Four to five Zoom meetings a day? Bring it on
  • You’re a natural problem solver who loves helping others untangle theirs
  • Your writing is clean, well-structured, and detail-oriented
  • You’re curious by nature and love learning new things
  • You’re not allergic to upselling or fielding “sales-y” questions
  • You’re organised and process-driven. Multiple tools for different workflows? No problem — you thrive in that setup
  • You’re self-motivated and independent, but you also value being part of a tight-knit team
  • Remote work isn’t just something you dabble in—it’s where you do your best work. You’ve got fast, reliable internet and a distraction-free workspace ready to go

 

Responsibilities

Product support

  • Go deep on product knowledge through self-driven learning—become the expert

  • Be the first point of contact on all inbound support via email/tickets, phone, and eventually live chat

  • Run 1-1 Zoom sessions with clients for technical consultation and query resolution

  • Maintain our consistently impressive first-reply-time metric (yeah, we’re proud of it)

  • Provide technically accurate responses backed by hands-on testing of scenarios

  • Collaborate with engineering to squash bugs and keep clients in the loop with timely updates

  • Spot patterns in user issues and flag them for product improvement

 

Be seriously good with clients

  • Speed matters. Respond quickly and decisively
  • Listen deeply—get to the root of the issue and own it until it’s resolved
  • Treat every client interaction with genuine respect and appreciation
  • Build trusting, long-term relationships rooted in honesty and transparency

jobs.title: Full Time Baker
jobs.description:
Location: Copenhagen Denmark

Position: Full-Time

We are in need of a committed and talented baker to come onboard and join our dymanic team. The position is a 40hrs work week, regular shift patterns and a great environment.

More about the role:

As an experience baker you will be a vital part of our incredible baking team. You will be working closely with your senior baker and production manager to ensure that we are baking some incredible bread and pastry, the production is smooth running, admin tasks are taken care of and most important - the quality of our produce is top notch!

Ideally you would have had at least 1 years experience as a baker in a professional environment.

About us:

BUKA Bakery in Copenhagen, Denmark is known for their extraordinary croissants and sourdough bread. Our production is located in the center of Copenhagen, catering to five BUKA outlets. 

Why apply for the role?

We work hard to ensure that the bakery at BUKA are a place of learning, creating and enjoyment.

What we are looking for:

• Be methodical and diligent and have good attention to detail.

• Be passionate about eating, baking, tasting, and teaching others how to be the same.

• Have an unwavering determination to make delicious bread and pastry!

• Have at least one year's experience of cooking in a professional environment.

• Be patient, calm; a natural teacher.

• Be keen to learn from your employers.

jobs.title: Quality engineer / senior engineer m/f (h/f) (H/F)
jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Leader mondial des systèmes électriques aéronautiques, Safran Electrical & Power est un acteur dans l'électrification des équipements et de la propulsion électrique et hybride. Maîtrisant la chaîne énergétique embarquée, l'entreprise conçoit et fournit des architectures et des solutions modulaires, innovantes et optimisées.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.


Descriptif missionControl the product realization process

* Assure shipment of product which meets the customer requirements - ship a product free of defects

* Assure the product-process control according to the customer and company specifications

* Define, monitor and evaluate the effectivity of quality plans and practices and maintain, follow up and control QRQC process

Manage the corrective and preventive action process

*Document and follow-up internal and external corrective actions and verify its effectiveness

*Maintain the CA/PA system for internal, external quality issues

*Communicate with the external customer

*Communicate with customer regarding product quality issues, validate and send answers to customer complaints

*Ensure all CAPA analysis and actions are adequate to address the reported conditions

Manage the transition/introduction of new products

*Maintain FAI and PFMEA to ensure failure-free transference and new product lines or processes introduction/improvement

*Perform Validation of new components and tools as required

Manage the documentation and records control process

*Generate, review, implement and maintain IMS documentation of quality department, work instructions, formats, etc.

*Review and approve technical and performance specifications, quality documents and instructions

Manage the training process

* Provide on the job training as needed on quality criteria, customer complaints, etc.

o

Co-lead with process engineering team, as required to develop/update/improve training modules and support for trainers

Support material acquisition/receiving inspection process

* Provide effective feedback to receiving inspection process about the quality of supplied parts

*Support on components FAI process to receiving inspection as required

Manage the continous improvement process

* Actively support the company continuous improvement initiatives and ensure Continuous Improvement objectives

jobs.title: Responsable management systeme f/h (H/F)
jobs.description:
Location: Meudon, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance
Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d'activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l'environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d'euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l'innovation tels que l'IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays.






Nos engagements, vos avantages- Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée

- Un package de rémunération attractif

- Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes

- Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l'équilibre des collaborateurs

- Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu





Votre quotidienEn nous rejoignant à Meudon, vous rejoignez le siège social du Groupe Thales situé en bord de Seine et organisé en un véritable campus, regroupant notamment nos activités d'identité et de sécurité numériques.

La fonction Qualité & Satisfaction Client accompagne l'ensemble du Groupe Thales dans sa transformation, le suivi et l'amélioration de sa performance.
Au sein de la Direction Qualité & Satisfaction Client Groupe, vous rejoindrez l'équipe en charge de la gestion du Système de Management. Dans le cadre de vos missions, vous apporterez un support au du Système de Management pour le maintien et l'amélioration du référentiel Qualité de Thales. Vous vous verrez confiez le Poste de responsable Système de Management et certification.

Missions :

-Piloter le Système de Management Qualité en cohérence avec les exigences des standards ISO 9001, ISO/EN et autres certifications applicables.
-Maintenir la certification globale ISO 9001.
-Assurer la gestion des projets liés au SMQ en mode PMO.
-Mettre en place des indicateurs qualité et suivre les tableaux de bord pour optimiser la performance du système.
-Mesurer l'efficacité et la qualité des changements ainsi que la pertinence du contenu du Système de Management.
-Préparer, coordonner, contribuer et assurer le suivi des audits internes et externes (certification, surveillance, clients,).
-Assurer la conformité réglementaire et documentaire du SMQ.
- S'assurer que le système soit un socle pour les certificats groupe ( Safety, Anticorruption, ...).
-Participer à l'élaboration, l'amélioration continue et la revue des processus qualité (MSPR et MSSC) conformément aux normes ISO/EN.
-Assurer la communication transversale entre les différentes parties prenantes internes et externes (Direction, opérationnels, clients, organismes certificateurs, GPO/GPOd).
-Participer activement aux projets de transformation de la qualité et aux sujets transverses du système de management (Capitalisation, Cleaning des documents Chorus, ...).

Profil :
Vous disposez d'une expérience d'au moins 4 ans dans la fonction Qualité ayant exercé vos talents sur différentes dimensions de ce Métier.
-capacité à l'animation de communauté
-Sens de l'organisation, proactivité et orientation résultats
-Vous savez gérer des projets avec rigueur et réactivité
-Vous êtes familier(ère) avec les principaux processus de Thales, avec les standards et les mécanismes de certification
Vous avez un très bon niveau d'anglais, aisance orale et écrite
Vous avez une excellente capacité relationnelle


At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!

jobs.description: Description de l'entrepriseRejoignez un cabinet de conseil international qui accompagne les grandes transformations stratégiques.Nous sommes Wavestone : des expert-es passionné-es et orienté-es solutions, qui placent l'humain au cœur de la performance et de la croissance. Ambitieux-ses et en pleine expansion, nous développons sans cesse notre portefeuille de clients et de projets, avec une portée internationale et une réelle volonté de générer un impact positif.Êtes-vous un vrai team player, porté par des valeurs fortes ? Êtes-vous curieux-se et déterminé-e, avec l'envie d'apprendre chaque jour ? Êtes-vous du genre à relever les défis sans hésiter ? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit. Rejoignez Wavestone et exprimez votre potentiel dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif, où l'on transforme les défis d'aujourd'hui en opportunités de demain.Description du posteLa business unit CTO Advisory est composée d'un collectif multi-compétences, de plus de 600 consultant-es, qui combinent compréhension des enjeux business des clients et expertise technologique de premier plan. L'objectif de ces équipes est de contribuer à positionner Wavestone comme le partenaire conseil de confiance des Chiefs Technology Officer (CTO) dans leurs transformations technologiques et organisationnelles les plus ambitieuses. Une mission qui adresse des clients grands comptes français et internationaux de tous secteurs d'activité : banque, énergie, transport, luxe, services, secteur public.en collaboration avec les autres business units du cabinet.Au sein de CTO Advisory, notre équipe NextGen IT réunit les savoir faires Cloud, infrastructure, Smart Network et DevOps. Son objectif : Adresser les enjeux de transformation des Applications et Socles IT en répondant à différentes problématiques : Infrastructure : comment porter les infrastructures traditionnelles vers un modèle Cloud ? #Platforms #IaC #VM #Container #SmartNetworks Applications : comment refondre les applications pour tirer parti de ces infrastructures Cloud ? #DevOps #Micro-services #Replatforming Sourcing : Comment organiser les achats de la filière IT pour permettre la transformation, et assurer le service management autour de ces nouvelles technologies ? #infrastructure broker #network provider #MultiCloud #RFP-Cloud #SLA #CSMP  Organisation : comment assurer une continuité dans l'agilité entre l'agilité les infrastructures, les applications et à les équipes ? #TOMCloud #Agile@Scale #SAFe Sécurité : comment se prémunir des nouvelles menaces apportées par le cloud ? #DevSecOps #CloudSec Optimisation financière et d'emprunte environnementale : comment optimiser ma consommation de services pour rester en maîtrise des coûts tout en limitant l'emprunte carbone de mes infrastructures ? #FinOps #GreenIT La singularité de notre business unit CTO Advisory est de permettre la combinaison de ces différentes expertises au travers de missions stratégiques comme très opérationnelles. Nous créons de la valeur de façon durable, grâce à notre Positive Way, en privilégiant toujours la simplicité et le pragmatisme. Nous sommes indépendants, tout en entretenant de forts liens opérationnels avec les principaux leaders du marché pour rester en permanence à l'état de l'art. Vous aurez également l'opportunité de développer votre expertise en suivant des formations, dispensées par nos consultants ou des partenaires, mais aussi en auto-formation via l'accès à de nombreuses plateformes de e-learning & Moocs. Nous vous donnons par ailleurs la possibilité de participer activement à la vie interne du cabinet à travers :  Des contributions au sein du cercle d'expertise NextGen IT : La publication d'articles sur nos blogs et réseaux sociaux L'appuis à la capitalisation des savoirs La veille sur les sujets Cloud et DevOps La rédaction de convictions et la création d'accélérateurs missions La participation commerciale à la réponse aux appels d'offre L'animation du réseau Wavestone international NextGen IT Mais aussi des contributions plus large à envergure practice ou Cabinet : Le développement de nos Assets : Shake 'up, CréaDesk, Machine Learning & Data Lab, Research & Knowledge Center  La contribution au recrutement, relations écoles, formations internes, événements internes  La participation à la stratégie RSE de Wavestone Et plus encore. QualificationsMotivé-e pour apprendre et diplômé-e d'une grande école d'ingénieurs, de management ou d'une grande université, vous êtes attiré-e par le conseil et vous possédez une forte appétence pour les technologies du numérique. Vous souhaitez développer des compétences liées au métier du conseil et aux problématiques de transformation digitale des organisations. Vos atouts :    Curiosité, esprit d'analyse aiguisé et capacité à vous approprier de nouveaux sujets, qu'ils soient métiers ou technologiques Orientation client, excellent relationnel et sens du service Goût du challenge et des résultats  Attrait pour l'entreprenariat et l'innovation Par a...

jobs.title: Cohort 0
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the Role

Join Replit's key teams across the company, such as AI Research, Strategic Finance, or the Office of the CEO, for a unique paid internship built for sharp quantitative and creative minds. You will work alongside our top executives, in addition to world-class engineers, designers, and finance team on some of the hardest problems in AI-native software creation and accelerating key areas of our business.



We are creating a dedicated track for students with strong mathematical backgrounds because the problems we are solving sit at the intersection of deep math and applied AI, including agent reasoning, systems optimization, and improving how our models learn and perform at scale. Your work will directly shape how millions of users build software.




You Will:

 - Contribute to real engineering problems that push the boundaries of AI-powered software creation

 - Collaborate with engineers, designers, and product managers on infrastructure that powers Replit's platform

 - Prototype novel approaches to problems in AI, systems, or tooling where mathematical rigor is the differentiator

 - Ship work that impacts millions of developers globally, in an environment where your ideas are heard and often implemented



Required Skills and Experience:

 - Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Physics, or a related quantitative field

 - At least one semester of schooling remaining after the internship

 - Demonstrated excellence in competitive mathematics such as IMO and IOI, quantitative research, or advanced coursework

 - Genuine curiosity about AI, agent systems, company building, or developer tooling

 - Extremely bullish on Replit and the future of AI-native software creation. We would love to see what you have built on the platform
   



What We Value:

 - First-principles thinking: Ability to break down complex problems from the ground up and reason about them rigorously

 - Mathematical intuition: Strong grasp of the underlying math behind machine learning, optimization, or systems

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating well with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication: Ability to explain complex quantitative concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Curiosity and speed: Genuine excitement for hard problems and the drive to iterate quickly



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Administrateur/Ingénieur système/Réseau/DevOps (H/F)
jobs.description:
RESPONSABILITÉS :

Nous vous invitons à relever de nouveaux challenges et à évoluer sur des projets d'expertise et d'innovation en prenant part à l'aventure Econocom.  A travers sa marque Workplace Infra Innovation, le groupe Econocom s'affirme comme la première entreprise du digital en Europe, la 7ème ESN de France et le leader de l'infogérance Workplace depuis 4 années.  Au sein de l'activité Services en région Occitanie, nous accompagnons plus de 40 clients grands comptes et institutions publiques dans tout secteur d'activité dans la transformation de leur système d'information, à travers la mise à disposition de moyens humains et techniques.  
Ce qui vous attend :  
Au sein d'un grand groupe industriel, vous intégrez une équipe déjà en place de Techniciens/ Administrateurs/ Ingénieurs.
Vos responsabilités :  
- Participer au suivi de la partie système sous environnement Linux
- Assurer le MCO et MCS
- Mettre en place et maintenir les outils et processus DevOps, la chaîne d'intégration et de déploiement continus
- Automatiser les déploiements, améliorer l'automatisation des tests
- Assurer la surveillance des failles de sécurité, participer à leur correction.
L'environnement technique :  Linux majoritairement, cloud souverain à base des technologies basée sur Suze Rancher   (+ Midpoint, KeyCloaock, Ansible, Puppet,..), réseau, sauvegarde, stockage, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Ansible, etc...
Ce que nous vous proposons :  
Valeurs :  en plus de nos 3 fondamentaux que sont l'audace, la bonne foi et la réactivité, nous garantissons un management à l'écoute et de proximité, ainsi qu'une ambiance familiale.  
Contrat :  CDI  
Localisation : Gramat 46500
Package rémunération & avantages :  
- Le salaire : rémunération annuelle brute selon profil et compétences  
- Les basiques : mutuelle familiale et prévoyance, titres restaurant, remboursement transport en commun à 50%, avantages du CSE (culture, voyage, chèque vacances, et cadeaux), RTT (jusqu'à 12 par an), plan d'épargne, prime de participation  
- Nos plus : forfait mobilité douce & Green (vélo/trottinette et covoiturage), prime de cooptation de 1000 € brut, e-shop de matériel informatique à des prix préférentiels (smartphone, tablette, etc.)  
- Votre carrière : plan de carrière, dispositifs de formation techniques & fonctionnels, passage de certifications, accès illimité à Microsoft Learn  
- La qualité de vie au travail : télétravail avec indemnité, évènements festifs et collaboratifs, accompagnement handicap et santé au travail, engagements RSE

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ :

- Qualification : un diplôme d'une formation supérieure en informatique est requis (Bac+2 minimum à bac +5)  
- Expérience : plusieurs postes sont à pourvoir. Que vous sortiez de master ou que vous justifiez d'expériences réussies en tant qu'Ingénieur Système/Réseau ou Ingénieur DevOps, nous sommes ouverts à différents types de profils.
- Technical skills : gestion de la sécurité de l'information, mise en exploitation et en production, connaissance des modèles de facturation Cloud Provider, supervision et administration de système, conception et refonte de l'architecture, déploiement des solutions et production de la documentation technique.
- Soft skills : vous êtes doté d'une excellente agilité, d'un très bon relationnel et faites preuve de réactivité. Vous avez un esprit critique d'analyse et êtes force de proposition.

jobs.title: Kierownik (K/M) w Dziale Administracjii - nabór
jobs.description:
Zakres obowiązków: Zakres realizowanych zadań na stanowisku:
1. Kierowanie pracami Działu Administracji; dokonywanie podziału zadań
podległym pracownikom i ich nadzór.
2. Prawidłowe i sprawne wykonywanie zadań, przestrzeganie przepisów prawa oraz
porządku i dyscypliny w ramach kierowania działem.
3. Terminowość i rzetelność załatwianych spraw wynikających z realizacji powierzonych
zadań.
4. Racjonalne wykorzystywanie środków w ramach zatwierdzonych budżetów.
5. Kontrola prawidłowości zakupów, transportu i dostaw.
6. Przygotowanie okresowych ocen, analiz, informacji, i sprawozdań.
7. Kontrola rachunków pod względem merytorycznym za zrealizowane zlecenia,
zamówienia i umowy.
8. Coroczne określanie podstawy do naliczenia podatku od nieruchomości, oraz z tytułu
trwałego zarządu.
9. Nadzór nad brygadą remontową.
10. Monitorowanie wykorzystania kart drogowych przez pracowników Działu, oraz
prawidłowości rozliczenia kosztów eksploatacji pojazdów służbowych.
11. Wydawanie i podpisywania zaświadczeń w sprawach wynikających z działalności
Działu.
12. Wykonywanie innych zadań nie objętych zakresem czynności, a zleconych przez
Dyrektora MOPS.
Praca w systemie jednozmianowym w godz. 7.30-15.30 od PN do PT.
Umowa o pracę na czas określony 6 miesięcy.
Wymagania:
- wykształcenie: wyższe (w tym licencjat) - konieczne
- pozostałe: Wymagania niezbędne związane ze stanowiskiem:
1. Posiadanie obywatelstwa polskiego z zastrzeżeniem art. 11 ust. 2 i 3 ustawy o pracownikach samorządowych.
2. Posiadanie pełnej zdolności do czynności prawnych oraz korzystania w pełni z praw publicznych.
3. Brak skazania prawomocnym wyrokiem sądu za umyślne przestępstwo ścigane z oskarżenia publicznego lub umyślne przestępstwo skarbowe.
4. Posiadanie wykształcenia wyższego.
5. Posiadanie minimum 4 lata stażu pracy w ramach umowy o pracę.
6. Koncepcja organizacji pracy Działu Administracji.
Wymagania dodatkowe związane ze stanowiskiem:
1. Preferowane doświadczenie w pracy w obszarze administracji na stanowisku urzędniczym

jobs.title: Field Marketing
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion has a very successful "land and expand" business model; our customers start using Notion for free, upgrade over time as they expand their teams, and embrace increasingly sophisticated use cases. Often, these users and champions are different than the person who has enterprise purchasing authority.

The Demand Generation team serves as a dot-connecter across sales, marketing, and operation teams to identify, engage, and convert decision makers at our target mid market and enterprise companies.

In this role, you will partner with demand generation teammates and sales stakeholders to ideate and execute in-person events, designed to help open, accelerate, and close business.

As a Field Marketing Manager, you will own and execute field events that are Notion-hosted, third party, co-partnered, and ancillary to third party events. This strategic position focuses on driving pipeline that meaningfully contribute to Notion's bottom line.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Delight Notion customers and prospects, with a guest-first approach to creating field events and experiences that bring the Notion brand and product to life.

 - Own end-to-end planning, execution, and measurement of field programs to support our AMER Sales team - encompassing executive experiences, large-format educational events, trade shows, and co-sponsored activations with partners.

 - Manage all event logistics, production, venue sourcing, budget tracking, marketing campaigns, sales enablement, content development, and audience acquisition.

 - Leverage quantitative and qualitative insights to make recommendations on how we invest in field events to drive incremental business impact.

 - Partner closely with Sales and broader Marketing team to align events and audiences to objectives for top accounts and craft tailored programs that nurture those accounts

 - Partner with our Operation and BizTech teams to manage and better utilize our go-to-market systems




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 4-5+ years of related marketing experience.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - You're a creative problem-solver who doesn't wait for a perfect playbook. You've built field events from scratch, and you're energized by figuring out what works in new territory.

 - You have a bias for action and experimentation. You'd rather test and learn than wait for consensus, and you know how to balance scrappiness with strategic thinking.

 - You're a strong cross-functional collaborator. You know how to work with sales, ops, and creative teams — and you can align people around a shared goal without needing authority to do it.

 - You're pipeline-obsessed. You understand how your programs connect to revenue and can speak credibly about pipeline contribution, not just top-of-funnel metrics.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience in a fast-paced, B2B tech environment

 - You're a Notion user and understand our value to businesses

 - Salesforce, Marketo experience



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $135,000-$160,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.
