jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Growth
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager to help manage relationships with Linear’s top customers. As a part of the early team, you’ll play a pivotal role in laying the foundation and setting up best practices. You will champion our customers’ needs and ensure they realize the full value of Linear across their organization. Your role will involve onboarding new customers, delivering ongoing support + enablement, and fostering strong relationships to drive customer satisfaction and retention.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders at Linear’s mid-market customers - act as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries, concerns, and feedback

 - Become a product expert and help customers use Linear to drive business outcomes

 - Drive customer onboarding and training on Linear’s features and best practices; continually strive to expand the usage and adoption of Linear within accounts

 - Be the voice of the customer; advocate for customer needs internally, collaborating with product, sales, and support teams to address challenges and drive enhancements in the product

What we're looking for

 - 3+ years relevant work experience in a technical customer-facing role

 - SaaS and start up experience a must; comfortable working and adapting in a fast paced and flexible environment

 - Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize effectively

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and effectively

 - Previous experience working with product + engineering teams and/or developer tools is preferred

What we offer

 - Interesting and challenging work

 - Work-life balance

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms (early exercise, extended exercise)

 - Stipend to set up your home office

 - Paid lunch and coffee during workdays

 - Work remotely, no commuting to the office

 - Paid co-working space/desk at an office

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance (US)

 - Regular team events and offsites

 - 5 weeks of paid vacation

 - 4 months of paid parental leave

jobs.description:
Vos missions :

En tant que courtier-ère spécialisé-e dans l'immobilier résidentiel, vous jouez un rôle clé dans le développement et la réussite des transactions immobilières sur le marché genevois.

À ce titre, vous serez amené-e à :
- Développer un portefeuille de biens résidentiels (appartements, villas et autres biens) grâce à une prospection active.
- Réaliser des estimations de biens et accompagner les propriétaires en leur apportant des conseils personnalisés adaptés à leur projet.
- Mettre en œuvre la commercialisation des biens : rédaction et diffusion des annonces, organisation des visites et valorisation des propriétés.
- Accompagner vendeurs et acquéreurs tout au long du processus de vente, de la première prise de contact jusqu'à la signature, en assurant un suivi rigoureux.
- Conduire les négociations avec professionnalisme afin de garantir la satisfaction des différentes parties.
- Assurer une veille permanente du marché immobilier genevois afin d'identifier les opportunités et les évolutions du secteur.

Profil recherché :
Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience confirmée d'au moins 10 ans dans le courtage immobilier, idéalement dans le secteur résidentiel. Vous possédez une excellente connaissance du marché immobilier genevois ainsi qu'un réseau professionnel développé.

Autonome, dynamique et orienté-e résultats, vous êtes reconnu-e pour votre sens commercial, votre capacité à instaurer une relation de confiance et votre qualité de service. Vous maîtrisez les techniques de négociation et savez accompagner vos clients avec professionnalisme tout au long de leur projet.

Compétences et prérequis :
- Expérience de 10 ans minimum en courtage immobilier résidentiel
- Excellente connaissance du marché immobilier genevois
- Réseau professionnel solide dans la région
- Français langue maternelle
- Anglais courant
- Maîtrise des outils informatiques usuels
- Permis de conduire indispensable.

Déplacements :
Des déplacements réguliers sont à prévoir dans le cadre de cette fonction.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst International Accountability Platform for Belarus
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced international justice analyst motivated by the opportunity to turn complex information and evidence of violations of international law in Belarus into meaningful action for accountability?

Then DIGNITY can offer you an exciting opportunity as Senior Analyst of the International Accountability Platform for Belarus (IAPB). Join a highly committed international team and play a meaningful role in advancing international justice and accountability. You will enjoy genuine responsibility, be able to shape impactful work, and be part of a supportive, collaborative culture—whether working remotely or from the office.

The IAPB was created in March 2021 as a consortium of Belarusian and international human rights organisations who joined forces to collect, verify, preserve and analyse evidence of violations of international criminal law and international human rights law allegedly committed by Belarusian authorities since 2020. To this end, the platform directly supports national criminal justice authorities and international accountability mechanisms by providing information and evidence. The IAPB’s objective is to achieve accountability of perpetrators and enable redress for the victims. Its operations were recently extended until end of September 2029.

DIGNITY, as the lead organisation of the consortium, hosts the IAPB’s Secretariat within which the position is located.

Since 1982, DIGNITY has worked for a world free of torture and violence. We are a human rights and development organisation that also runs a rehabilitation clinic in Denmark. We prevent torture and violence, treat traumatized victims, and document serious human rights violations so that those responsible can be held accountable.


About the position

As Senior Analyst your focus will be to ensure that evidence is gathered in line with international standards; that timely and high-quality responses to requests by national and international accountability mechanisms are drafted, involving structuring, drafting and reviewing of submissions and analytical briefs; and that the work of the IAPB’s analysts and open-source researchers is well coordinated.

Your primary tasks are:

  • Overseeing the consolidation and analysis of information and evidence gathered by IAPB’s partners and the secretariat team;
  • Strategic planning as well as overseeing the IAPB’s analytical work to support criminal justice authorities and other accountability bodies, in close coordination with the Senior Legal Consultant;
  • Drafting, reviewing and editing of analytical briefs and legal memos for submission to criminal justice authorities and other accountability bodies;
  • Supervising and coordinating the work conducted by analysts and consultants, including setting priorities/tasks and ensuring high standards of work, in close coordination with the Legal Advisor.
  • Cooperating with prosecution authorities and international mechanisms.
  • Other reasonable duties corresponding to ability and training.

The position is expected to include up to 25 days of travel abroad per year.

We offer you:

  • The opportunity to work as part of a highly committed international team of skilled and experienced colleagues, united by a strong sense of purpose and a collaborative team spirit that has been successfully fostered across a remote working environment.
  • The chance to make a tangible contribution to international justice, supporting work that can have concrete, real-world impact for accountability.
  • A high degree of responsibility and meaningful involvement, with the opportunity to shape the work of the platform.
  • A stimulating and purpose-driven working environment, offering opportunities to engage with complex and international criminal law and accountability issues.
  • A supportive and collegial culture, where knowledge-sharing, mutual respect and constructive collaboration are valued.
  • The flexibility of an office environment or remote working environment, combined with an established culture of communication, collaboration and connection across the team.


Skills

We expect you to hold a university degree in law (at undergraduate or postgraduate level), preferably with a specialisation in international criminal law.

We also expect that you have:

  • A minimum of 10 years of demonstrated practical professional experience in the documentation of violations of international law, preferably in the context of international criminal law. This experience should include substantial hands-on investigative or documentation work and not be primarily academic in nature.
  • A minimum of 5 years analytical and investigative experience in relation to violations of international criminal law, in particular crimes against humanity, including the assessment and analysis of relevant facts, evidence, and applicable legal frameworks.
  • Demonstrated legal drafting skills, including experience in conceptualising, structuring and drafting of submissions to national and international human rights and accountability bodies.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating and overseeing the work of a team of analysts, including allocating and reviewing work and providing substantive guidance to members of the IAPB team in a remote working environment.
  • Experience with universal and extra-territorial jurisdiction cases.
  • Demonstrated experience liaising with criminal justice stakeholders, including national and/or international accountability bodies.
  • Experience representing an organisation at external events, including conferences or other forums, with the confidence to speak to a range of audiences.
  • Excellent command of written and spoken English.
  • Fluency in Russian and/or Belarusian will be given particular weight in the selection process.
  • Direct experience interviewing survivors and witnesses is desirable.

It is also important that you have:

  • Excellent communication skills, and the ability to communicate effectively with different target audiences.
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Strong organisational and inter-personal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in an inter-disciplinary environment and across different cultures.
  • Ability to work across a broad portfolio, manage complex workload and be responsive to evolving demands.
  • Cultural and context sensitivity, high ethical standards, and diplomatic skills.
  • and that you are resourceful, creative, collegial, empathic, and respectful.


Terms of employment

The position is placed in the Secretariat of the International Accountability Platform for Belarus (IAPB), of which DIGNITY is the lead organisation. The IAPB is managed by the Head of the Platform and Dignity’s Director of the Prevention & Accountability Department.

The position is placed in Dignity’s head office in Copenhagen (Bryggervangen 55, 2100 Kbh. Ø), but we alternatively offer an employer of record (EoR) solution if you are based in another EU member state. Please note that the position will not be filled on a consultancy basis.

The employment is based on the Danish collective agreement for academics in the Danish State, and the salary level is based on skills and relevant experience and within a range of DKK 50-52.500 (gross, monthly) + pension (18,07%). If you are offered an EoR solution, the salary will depend on comparable positions and terms of employment in the host country.

Expected entry is 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter; the position is currently envisaged until 30 September 2029.


More info

Further information about the position can be obtained by contacting the IAPB Secretariat at iapb@dignity.dk.

The application consisting of CV, letter of motivation, diploma and other documents if relevant are submitted via the link no later than 27 September 2026.

We expect to hold interviews on 15-16 October 2026 digitally, and possibly also a second round of interviews on 20-21 October 2026, which will also take place digitally.

You can read about DIGNITY's processing of your personal data in our privacy policy, which you can find here: https://www.dignity.dk/privatlivspolitik/

The IAPB is composed of two Belarusian co-lead organisations, Human Rights Center Viasna and International Committee for the Investigation of Torture in Belarus, and its lead organisation DIGNITY – Danish Institute against Torture.

Since its establishment, it has continued to expand its evidence base and analytical outputs, collecting testimonies of some 2,900 victims and witnesses, over 38,000 victim-related documents and over 2.1 million open-source items, including extensive audiovisual and textual materials.

Cooperation with accountability mechanisms contributed to the decision of the Office of the Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court to open an investigation into crimes against humanity related to the Lithuania/Belarus situation. Overall, by June 2026, the Platform had responded to 14 requests from national jurisdictions and prepared 13 submissions to multiple international mechanisms.

As part of its survivor-centred approach, so far it has provided mental health and psychosocial support to 850 beneficiaries.

Beyond documentation and support activities, the IAPB promotes accountability pathways for Belarus, outlined in its report “Paths to Accountability for Belarus”.

jobs.title: Chauffører søges til faste distributionsruter hos Danmarks Fragtgruppe
jobs.description:
Danmarks Fragtgruppe ApS søger flere stabile og ansvarsbevidste chauffører til vores team i Glostrup.

Vi søger chauffører til faste distributionsopgaver med udgangspunkt fra Naverland 13, 2600 Glostrup.

Stillingerne er på fuld tid og passer godt til dig, der trives med en aktiv arbejdsdag med ansvar, kundekontakt og frihed til i høj grad at tilrettelægge din arbejdsdag efter aftale.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Kørsel og distribution af gods på faste ruter

  • Levering af varer til erhvervskunder

  • Lastning og aflæsning

  • Indbæring af varer hos kunder

  • Sikring og korrekt håndtering af gods

  • Kontrol af varer og leverancer

  • Registrering og dokumentation af leverancer

  • Daglig kontakt med kunder og samarbejdspartnere

  • Ansvar for, at bilen holdes ordentlig og præsentabel

Kørslen foregår primært med 18-pallers forvogne.

Fleksibel arbejdstid

Vi ønsker at give vores chauffører mulighed for en arbejdsdag, der så vidt muligt passer til den enkelte.

Arbejdstiden kan derfor aftales individuelt inden for tidsrummet ca. kl. 06.00–18.00, afhængigt af ruterne og virksomhedens drift.

En normal arbejdsdag kan eksempelvis være 8 timer, men der kan også efter aftale være mulighed for flere timer på de dage, hvor chaufføren ønsker det, og hvor driften giver mulighed for det.

Det betyder eksempelvis, at nogle chauffører kan foretrække:

  • Tidlig opstart og tidligere fri

  • Senere opstart og senere fri

  • En almindelig arbejdsdag på omkring 8 timer

  • Længere arbejdsdage efter aftale

Den konkrete arbejdstid planlægges i samarbejde med kørselsledelsen og under hensyntagen til gældende regler om arbejdstid, pauser samt køre- og hviletid.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har gyldigt kørekort kategori C

  • Har gyldigt chaufføruddannelsesbevis/EU-kvalifikationsbevis, hvor dette er påkrævet

  • Er mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret

  • Er serviceminded og ordentlig i kontakten med kunder

  • Er indstillet på fysisk arbejde og indbæring

  • Behandler virksomhedens materiel og kundernes varer med respekt

  • Kan samarbejde godt med kolleger og kørselsledelsen

  • Har en professionel og positiv tilgang til arbejdet

Erfaring med distribution og lastbilkørsel er en fordel, men den rette indstilling, stabilitet og ansvarlighed vægter højt hos os.

ADR

ADR-bevis er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Har du ikke ADR-bevis, kan der efter nærmere aftale være mulighed for at tage den nødvendige ADR-uddannelse gennem virksomheden.

Løn

Vi tilbyder en timeløn på:

175–250 kr. pr. time

Den konkrete timeløn fastsættes efter kvalifikationer og afhænger blandt andet af:

  • Erfaring

  • Relevante kvalifikationer

  • Certifikater og uddannelser

  • Erfaring med distributionskørsel

  • Arbejdsopgaver og ansvar i stillingen

Vi tilbyder

  • Fastansættelse

  • Mulighed for fleksibel tilrettelæggelse af arbejdstiden

  • Arbejdstid inden for ca. kl. 06.00–18.00

  • Mulighed for ansvar og udvikling

  • Mulighed for ADR-uddannelse efter aftale

  • En arbejdsplads i udvikling

Om Danmarks Fragtgruppe ApS

Danmarks Fragtgruppe ApS er en transport- og distributionsvirksomhed med fokus på driftssikker transport, god kundeservice og professionel håndtering af vores kunders varer.

Vi lægger vægt på stabile medarbejdere, godt samarbejde og en professionel tilgang til den enkelte transportopgave.

Vi ønsker samtidig at skabe en arbejdsplads, hvor der så vidt muligt er plads til, at den enkelte chauffør kan få arbejdsliv og privatliv til at hænge sammen.

jobs.title: Postdoc in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows
jobs.description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows

We seek a bioinformatician to develop computational workflows to analyze large-scale microbiome multi-omics data in multiple projects studying human and animal health, including the consortium project PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net) and EU Horizon 2020 project MICROB-PREDICT (https://microb-predict.eu/). We strive to implement efficient and scalable workflows to analyze and integrate these data derived from metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, and metaproteomics in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. We have developed the MIntO package (https://github.com/arumugamlab/MIntO) that integrates microbiome metagenomic and metatranscriptomic data. Our ambition is to develop new workflows that expand MIntO’s features (e.g., novel analysis types) as well as datatypes (e.g., metabolomic data).

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding workflows in our current MIntO pipeline, while also having a chance to create your own novel workflows.

  • Expected to participate in and lead existing projects within these consortia and other projects in the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

  • Expected to interact and collaborate with other clinical researchers, veterinarians, biologists, and bioinformaticians in these consortia, to enhance and ensure proper interpretation of experimental results.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree and documented research experience in one or more of the areas/fields mentioned below:

  • Bioinformatics

  • Biology

The Postdoc fellowship is aimed at early-career researchers with a background in basic science. We are particularly interested in candidates with solid experience in analyzing large volumes of next-generation sequencing data, who are aware of challenges in scalability and efficiency

Required qualifications:

  • PhD in bioinformatics or biology with strong experience in software development.

  • Academic preparation as well as experience in biological statistics.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or R.

  • Experience with bioinformatics workflow environments such as snakemake, NextFlow or CWL.

  • Experience in analyzing next-generation sequencing datasets.

  • Experience in a high-performance computing environment using any flavor of UNIX.

  • Demonstrated capacity for effective teamwork.

  • Proven track record showing scientific productivity in peer-reviewed journals.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.

The following qualifications are highly preferred, but not required. Candidates who possess any of these qualifications are encouraged to highlight them in the application:

  • Basic understanding of disease biology and/or microbiology.

  • Experience in analyzing metagenomic datasets from host-associated microbiota.

  • Experience in handling multi-omics data, including metabolomics and proteomics.

  • Experience in distributed and cloud computing technologies.

  • Experience in supervising other researchers at different levels.

  • International mobility

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision – We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information, please contact Group Leader Mani Arumugam, Department of Clinical Research, e-mail: arumugam@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 23649552 or Head of Department at the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477 

Application deadline

September 23, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a detailed description of research experience

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science.

We seek a data scientist to derive insights from host-microbiome multi-omics data in multiple consortium projects studying human and animal health, including GALAXY/MicrobLiver studying liver fibrosis (https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/galaxy), MICROB-PREDICT studying late-stage liver cirrhosis (https://microb-predict.eu/), and PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net). We strive to integrate and interpret these data derived from microbiome (e.g., metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, metaproteomics) and host (e.g., genetics, proteomics, circulating metabolomics) in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. The current state-of-the-art for multi-omics integration and interpretation leaves much to be desired. Fortunately, our ongoing work leveraging a deep learning approach (autoencoders) integrates multi-omics data and generates biologically relevant insights using a biologically informed machine learning framework. Our ambition is to strengthen and expand this research direction into graph-based approaches such as graph neural networks.

jobs.title: Skal du være socialfaglig medarbejder på Holbrogaard?
jobs.description:
Vi får plads til flere unge derfor søger vi socialfaglige medarbejdere med opstart 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest muligt.

Holbrogaard ligger i naturskønne omgivelser tæt ved det sydfynske øhav i Faaborg. Vi tilbyder miljøterapeutisk og neoaffektiv døgnbehandling til unge i alderen 12-18 (22) år, med begyndende personlighedsforstyrrelser og psykiatrinære lidelser.

Det er en arbejdsplads for omkring 20 medarbejdere med såvel sundhedsfaglige og pædagogiske uddannelser, hvor det faglige niveau er højt. Behandlingen af hver enkelt ung, er nøje tilrettelagt efter den unges individuelle behov og foregår i et omsorgsfuldt bo-miljø.

Skoletilbuddet aftales med den anbringende kommune for hver enkelt ung og foregår i nærmiljøet. Det er med til at skabe den bedste udvikling i den unges liv.

Behandlingen tager udgangspunkt i evidensbaseret miljøterapi og neuroaffektive og systemiske principper. Det betyder, at vores behandlingsmetoder er veldokumenterede og tager hensyn til og inddrager alle aspekter af den unges liv.
For at udvikle fagligheden, er der løbende efteruddannelse og supervision.

Med andre ord: Holbrogaard lykkes, når unge udvikles og styrkes mod et bæredygtigt liv.

Med udgangspunkt i en stærk faglighed og blikket hævet mod ovenstående kerneopgave, arbejder vi bevidst insisterende mod at lykkes sammen med de unge.

Dette stiller store krav til os som behandlingssted og vores pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige handlinger.

Kan du se dig selv ind i ovenstående og har du følgende kvalifikationer hører vi meget gerne fra dig.
  • Har en social eller sundhedsfaglig uddannelse – som pædagog, psykolog, socialrådgiver, ergoterapeut eller social og sundhedsassistent alternativt en anden relevant uddannelse på min. bachelorer niveau.
  • Har erfaring med faglig dokumentation.
  • Psykisk robust og rummelig.
  • Ser arbejdet omkring den unge som en helhedsorienteret opgave der indeholder tæt samarbejde med forældre og anbringende kommuner.
  • Evne til at arbejde selvstændigt, evaluere og prioritere opgaver i samarbejde med kollegaer.
  • Kan bevare overblikket og samtidig fokusere på den enkelte unges behov.
  • Gerne kompetencer til at arbejde motorisk, musisk og kreativt med de unge.
  • Gerne kendskab til psykiatrien.
  • Lyst til at dele og udvikle viden i tæt samspil med kollegaerne.
  • Anerkendende tilgang til kollegaer, de unge og deres familier.
  • At du trives i et tværfagligt samarbejdsmiljø.
  • At du trives med at løse kerneopgaven.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du har erfaring fra psykiatri og døgninstitutioner med lignende målgruppe.

Vi tilbyder:
  • God introduktion.
  • Forplejning når du er på arbejde, attraktiv sundhedsordning.
  • Supervision og efteruddannelse.
  • En engageret og ambitiøs tværfaglig personalegruppe, bestående af både medarbejdere med mange års erfaring på stedet, og nogle medarbejdere ansat inden for det sidste år.
  • Vi lægger vægt på et sundt og udviklende arbejdsmiljø, og høj kvalitet i opgaveløsningen – og ser disse to som hinandens forudsætning.

For alle medarbejdere er der obligatorisk deltagelse i behandlingskonference, personalemøder og supervision.

Vi aflønner efter gældende overenskomst med SL/FOA.

Ren straffeattest, børneattest og gyldigt førerbevis er en forudsætning for ansættelse.

Stillingerne er alle på 32 timer pr. uge og arbejdstiderne er dag, aften og fast hver 2. weekend

Ansøgningsfristen er nu!

Sagt med andre ord vi tager løbende kandidater ind til samtale og opslaget vil blive taget ned, når vi er nået i mål med de rette kandidater.

Evt. spørgsmål til stillingerne?
Så er du velkommen til at kontakte leder af Holbrogaard, Jens Simmelsgaard på mobil 2260 0561 eller souschef, Kristoffer Aarup på mobil 2519 4466.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Shaw Commercials Group in Castlebar is currently recruiting for Business Analyst position. Reporting to the Managing Director / Operations Manager, the successful candidate will play an important role in the business with have multiple responsibilities and duties that will span across various departments. This is a busy work environment working to weekly and monthly deadlines. Collaborate with business leaders, department heads, and operational teams to understand business needs, challenges, and opportunities and translate them into clear and actionable requirements. Analyse existing business processes, workflows, systems, and reporting structures to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement across business and operational functions. Document, structure, and prioritise business requirements to support the development and implementation of practical, technology-driven solutions. Support and drive continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation, with a focus on improving efficiency, accuracy, cost effectiveness, and overall business performance. Identify opportunities for automation and AI integration across daily, weekly, and monthly reporting and operational processes. Develop and support automated reporting solutions using Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and other reporting or data visualisation tools. Explore and support the introduction of AI-based tools and automation technologies to reduce manual workload in areas including reporting, data entry, scheduling, forecasting, and operational analysis. Work with internal teams and external IT providers to support the design, development, and implementation of business systems and digital solutions. Support system integration activities to ensure new tools and platforms operate effectively with existing business systems, processes, and workflows. Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure business requirements are clearly communicated, understood, and appropriately delivered. Assist with solution design, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support for new systems and business process changes. Develop and enhance management reporting frameworks, dashboards, and performance tracking tools to support effective, data-driven decision-making. Support the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of data across reporting and operational systems. Promote appropriate data governance practices, including compliance with GDPR and internal data security requirements. Translate technical concepts into clear business language and communicate business requirements effectively to technical stakeholders. Support training, onboarding, documentation, and change management activities to assist with the successful adoption of new systems, processes, and technologies. Promote continuous improvement and digital innovation across the organisation by identifying and supporting smarter and more efficient ways of working.

Bonde Glas is looking for a qualified carpenter with knowledge or experience of the glazing trade to join our team on Lolland in southern Denmark.

Your role

You will work with a wide range of carpentry tasks and work closely with the glazing side of the company. We are therefore looking for a carpenter who is comfortable with varied practical work and interested in working across the two trades.

Who you are

  • You are a qualified carpenter

  • You have a valid driving licence

  • You can communicate in English

  • Is willing to relocate to Lolland and make the area your place of residence

  • A valid asbestos training certificate is a strong advantage

What we offer

  • Gross hourly wage: DKK 150-200, depending on qualifications and experience

  • Permanent employment, 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday

  • Occasional overtime may occur, but weekend work is generally not required

  • Pension scheme

  • Assistance with finding suitable accommodation

About Bonde Glas

Bonde Glas is a local glazing company on Lolland. In addition to glazing work, the company also employs carpenters and carries out a wide range of practical assignments.

Recruitment Process

The first interview can be conducted online if required. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the workplace before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Martin Hansen
Business Consultant and EURES adviser, Lolland Municipality
Phone: +45 21 47 73 43
Email: maha@lolland.dk

Lolland is located in the southern part of Denmark, offering a peaceful lifestyle with easy access to nature, beaches, and open countryside. The region combines affordable housing, short commuting distances, and a strong sense of community.

The region is currently experiencing significant development, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link, one of Europe’s largest infrastructure projects, which will create a direct road and rail connection between Denmark and Germany.

As an international employee, you will have access to Lolland Municipality’s Newcomers Service, which offers free support with relocation, registration, housing guidance, partner job support, and settling into life in Denmark.

For more information about Lolland and contact details, visit newcomers.lolland.dk

More information about living and working in Denmark can be found at www.workindenmark.dk

We are seeking an experienced and proactive Facilities Manager to oversee the delivery of hard and soft facilities services on site for a major account. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for managing day-to-day operations, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, and maintaining high standards of service delivery across multiple stakeholders. You will lead on-site teams, manage contractors, oversee maintenance programmes, and act as the key operational contact for the client. The successful candidate will be a customer-focused facilities professional with strong leadership skills, commercial awareness, and a proven ability to manage operational performance in a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities Operational Management Manage the day-to-day delivery of hard and soft facilities services across the contract. Lead, motivate, and develop the on-site service delivery team. Oversee planned preventative maintenance (PPM) schedules and lifecycle replacement programmes. Manage reactive maintenance requests and ensure contractual service levels are achieved. Scope, manage, and verify minor works projects. Coordinate contractors and ensure works are completed safely, efficiently, and to specification. Manage permit-to-work and safe systems of work processes. Client & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary operational point of contact for the client and key stakeholders. Build and maintain strong working relationships through effective communication and service delivery. Attend client meetings and provide operational updates and performance reporting. Resolve issues promptly and professionally while maintaining a customer-focused approach. Administration & Reporting Maintain accurate contract documentation, records, and compliance files. Produce operational, maintenance, and performance reports as required. Coordinate site inductions and onboarding activities. Manage payroll and timekeeping processes for site-based teams. Maintain lifecycle plans, budgets, and performance data. CPH Skadecenter er en privat ejet virksomhed fra 2013 med gode værdier. Vi søger en pladesmed som forstår at samarbejde er absolut vigtigt for at både trivsel, humør og effektivitet.

 CPH Skadecenter er startet af en pladesmed og idag drevet af en pladesmed, dvs. at der er fuld forståelse for de udfordringer der kan opstå i forbindelse med at udbedre skader på alle bilmærker. Jeg håber dette opslag finder vej til den rette person :) 

Mvh. Mads Milan Petersen / CPH Skadecenter ApS

jobs.title: KS Elektro A/S søger arbejdsleder til elektronikafdeling
jobs.description:
KS Elektro A/S søger arbejdsleder til elektronikafdeling

Vil du stå i spidsen for et stærkt elektronikteam og være med til at sikre høj kvalitet, effektiv drift og motiverede medarbejdere? Så er du måske vores nye arbejdsleder til Elektronikafdelingen. Vi arbejder hovedsageligt på nybygninger og er med fra de første spæde installationer til de sidste, færdige installation ombord på topmoderne fartøjer.

Som arbejdsleder får du ansvaret for den daglige ledelse af elektronikafdelingen i tæt samarbejde med ledelsen. Du bliver en central del af produktionen, hvor du sikrer effektiv planlægning, høj kvalitet i arbejdet og synlig ledelse af afdelingens medarbejdere.

Du vil få en alsidig hverdag med ansvar for både medarbejdere, produktion, kvalitet og opfølgning på opgaver og ressourcer.

 

Om opgaverne:

Som arbejdsleder for vores elektronik-team, vil nogle af opgaverne indebære:

  • Daglig ledelse af elektronikafdelingen – samt motivation og udvikling af afdelingens timelønnede medarbejdere gennem synlig og nærværende ledelse.

  • Sammensætning af det rette team til de enkelte opgaver.

  • Planlægning og koordinering af arbejdsopgaver med fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet og leveringstid.

  • Samarbejde med øvrige arbejdsledere for at sikre optimal koordinering på tværs af afdelinger.

  • Opfølgning på timeforbrug og materialeforbrug på ordrer.

  • Opfølgning på ekstraarbejde og sikring af overensstemmelse mellem tilbud og udførelse.

 

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er udlært inden for elektronik (Elektronikmekaniker, elektronikfagtekniker, el-ingeniør, installatør el.lign.). Du kan også være udlært elektriker med interesse/erfaring og flair for elektronik.

  • Har erfaring med at lede og koordinere arbejdet i en medarbejdergruppe

  • Er pligtopfyldende, fleksibel og imødekommende.

  • Erfaring fra den maritime branche er en fordel.

Vi kan tilbyde dig:

  • En fast stilling på fuldtid.

  • Attraktiv løn efter kvalifikationer.

  • Pensionsordning og sundhedssikring.

  • En anderledes og spændende arbejdsplads, hvor sikkerhed og et godt arbejdsmiljø er topprioriteter.

  • Et stærkt socialt fællesskab og sjove sociale arrangementer.

 

Vil du med ombord?

Hvis du har lyst til at blive en del af et internationalt team, hvor vi sætter kvalitet i højsædet, så skal du sende din ansøgning afsted nu. Vi behandler ansøgninger og indkalder til samtaler løbende.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte vores produktionschef, René Hansen, på tlf. (+45) 26 87 44 33.

 

Ansøgning sendes til:          job@kselektro.dk

Tiltrædelse:                            Snarest muligt – eller efter aftale.

 

KS Elektro A/S er et ungt firma, der har stor erfaring og stærke kompetencer indenfor levering af el- og elektronik løsninger til den maritime industri. Vi beskæftiger ca. 150 medarbejdere i Skagen.

Med vores søsterselskab Karstensens Skibsværft, som er førende indenfor nybygning af pelagiske fartøjer og reparationer af forskellige skibstyper, beskæftiger vi tilsammen over 650 medarbejdere. Dertil har vi en ordrebog på 5-7 nybygninger og mellem 100-150 reparations – og større ombygningsopgaver om året.

jobs.title: Brand Designer, Creative Studio
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This role is based in New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.



This role sits on Notion’s Creative Studio, a small team of designers, illustrators, and filmmakers. Our work tells the story of our offering in a way that reflects the products themselves: smart, refined, and with a dash of wit on the side.



As a Brand Designer, you’ll work on high-impact brand initiatives and campaigns: setting direction from early strategy through final execution, partnering closely with stakeholders and executives, and raising the bar for craft and systems. You’ll be asked to define approaches, resolve ambiguity, and influence both project outcomes and how the team works.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Concept, art direct and design high-visibility moments from brand campaigns, product launches, and events, developing approaches that can scale across a broad range of surfaces, moments, and channels.

 - Contribute to our brand systems and develop standards and tooling that improve velocity and consistency for teammates near and far.

 - Mentor and raise the bar for other designers and creative partners through feedback, critique, and patterns that make great work repeatable.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 10+ years in an agency or in-house environment, with demonstrated leadership on ambiguous, complex, high-impact work.

 - A strong portfolio of work that’s culturally resonant and visually diverse, and that showcases your ability to tell stories across many channels.

 - A deep commitment to systems thinking, typographic excellence, and sensitivity to small details.

 - Experience working with a broad range of makers. You’ve teamed up with illustrators, animators, copywriters, filmmakers, photographers, and beyond to bring your ideas to life.

 - Excellent partnership skills. You can work hand-in-hand with cross-functional stakeholders, drive alignment, and make pragmatic tradeoffs.

 - A tinkerer’s mindset. You're curious about how your tools are evolving and have a strong perspective on how AI can expand creative expression and drive production. You’ll actively experiment with new AI workflows to concept, prototype, and push our design systems further.






Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $250,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer – Aerospace & Optical Communications
jobs.description:
Full-time, primarily onsite position in Tallinn. We welcome applications from both strong junior and mid-level Systems Engineers. Starting date as soon as possible or by agreement.

Work tasks: The Systems Engineer will support the definition, coordination, integration, verification and delivery of Golbriak Space’s optical communication systems.
Main responsibilities: * Capture, analyse, define and maintain system and subsystem requirements * Translate product and mission objectives into clear technical requirements, actions and deliverables * Allocate requirements across subsystems and maintain traceability throughout the product-development lifecycle * Coordinate interfaces between mechanical, optical, electronic, software, thermal, manufacturing and testing activities * Identify technical dependencies, assumptions, constraints, conflicts and risks * Develop system-level verification and validation plans and define appropriate acceptance criteria * Support system integration, testing, troubleshooting and qualification activities * Review test results and verification evidence against defined requirements * Coordinate the resolution of technical issues involving multiple engineering disciplines * Track technical activities, dependencies, risks, decisions and milestones * Prepare and support technical and design reviews * Maintain requirements specifications, interface documentation, verification plans, technical reports and engineering decision records * Support configuration management and the controlled implementation of engineering changes * Collaborate closely with founders, engineering leads, technical teams, suppliers, partners and customers * Contribute to the improvement of systems-engineering processes, documentation and development workflows

We offer: * A central engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication systems
* Meaningful technical ownership across requirements management, system integration, verification and engineering coordination * The opportunity to work across mechanical, optical, electronic, software, manufacturing and testing disciplines * Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team * The opportunity to develop your expertise in systems engineering, optical communications, telecommunications and aerospace * The ability to contribute to technical decisions, engineering processes and ways of working as the company grows * A gross monthly salary of €2100–€3000, depending on experience, skills and expected level of responsibility * Relocation support to Estonia if required * Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, technical curiosity and the ability to understand complex systems as a whole. The person should be able to identify dependencies, constraints and potential conflicts between different engineering disciplines.
The successful candidate will be organised, reliable and willing to take ownership. They should be able to coordinate multiple technical activities and priorities simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills are required, together with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly. The company’s working language is English, so professional working proficiency in English is required. The candidate must be willing to work primarily onsite in Tallinn and be comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities and technical requirements may evolve.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Urban walker
jobs.employer: walkr - turn your Google Meet walk-friendly
jobs.description:
Urban Walker

Walkr â London (or another city with strong walkability) Full-time / Part-time considered Â· On-site (outdoors)



About Walkr

Walkr helps people turn everyday calls and meetings into walks. We started as a small Chrome extension that flags walk-friendly meetings in Google Calendar, and we're building toward a bigger mission: make walking the default way people connect, think and work.

We believe most of what happens in a meeting room could happen just as well, if not better, on a pavement. We're now looking for someone to prove it, on the ground, every day.




The role

We're hiring a full-time Urban Walker: someone whose job is to walk. You'll take Walkr's calls, meetings and thinking sessions outdoors, on foot, in a city with enough walkable area to actually make that work. You'll be our internal proof of concept and our most honest source of product feedback.

Practically, this means:

  • Taking scheduled calls and 1:1s while walking, using Walkr to flag and organise them
  • Logging what works and what doesn't: audio quality, routes, weather, pacing, how conversations change when nobody's looking at a screen
  • Feeding that back into the product directly, you'll be in the room (or rather, on the street) with the team building the features you use
  • Scouting and mapping walkable routes near our hubs that others on the team can reuse
  • Occasionally representing Walkr in walking meetings with partners, press or early users



What we're looking for

  • You live in, or are willing to be based in, a city with genuinely walkable areas (parks, canals, low-traffic streets, decent pavements)
  • You're comfortable holding a normal, focused conversation while moving, this is a real skill, not everyone has it
  • You're organised enough to manage a calendar full of outdoor commitments and reroute around weather, meetings and life
  • You're naturally curious about behaviour change, habits and how environment shapes how we think
  • Bonus: you already walk a lot and have opinions about it



Why this role exists

Most companies talk about wellbeing and then put everyone back in a chair in a room with no windows. We'd rather have one person whose entire job disproves the excuse that walking meetings "don't really work in practice." If it's your job, it has to work.


What you'll get

  • A role that pays you to do the thing our product is trying to get everyone else to do
  • Direct input into what we build next
  • Flexible hours built around daylight and your city's best routes
  • The rare chance to put "Professional Walker" on your CV and mean it

jobs.title: Medhjælper i bageriet - Priorparken
jobs.description:
Hos Lagkagehuset er vi lige så stolte af vores hverdagsglæde som af vores bagværk. Derfor leder vi efter en Medhjælper til bageriet, der kan hjælpe os med at holde produktionen godt kørende og skabe friskbagt brød, kager og bagværk til vores gæster hver dag. Her bruger du din lyst til at lære, dit gode drive og din glæde ved at arbejde sammen med andre, så vi sammen kan være et bedre bageri for alle.

Din hverdag bliver fyldt med…
Kort sagt handler rollen om at understøtte produktionen og lære arbejdet i bageriet godt at kende.

Den lidt længere version er, at du bliver en del af et team, hvor du får oplæring i de forskellige opgaver i produktionen. Det kan være alt fra dejhåndtering, bagning og pakning til brug af maskiner og opsætning af frost. Hverdagen byder på mange forskellige opgaver, og vi roterer, så vi kan hjælpe hinanden. Du bliver en del af vores centralbageri, hvor bageri, pakkeri og logistik arbejder tæt sammen, og hvor vi hver dag skaber friskbagt kvalitet til vores gæster.

Vi tror derfor på, at du vil trives hos os, hvis du…

  • har lyst til at arbejde med bageri og trives med fysisk arbejde

  • har lyst til at lære nyt og udvikle dig i rollen

  • er en holdspiller og bidrager til den gode stemning

  • gerne har erfaring fra fødevareproduktion, men det er ikke et krav

  • kan tale, læse og forstå dansk eller engelsk

Hvad vi tilbyder dig
Vi tilbyder en arbejdsplads med fokus på udvikling, samarbejde og fællesskab. Derudover får du rabat i alle vores butikker og adgang til Visma Logbuy, som tilsammen giver lidt ekstra forkælelse i hverdagen.

Din rolle hos os
Din arbejdsuge er på 37 timer, hvor du arbejder med fast natarbejdstid mellem kl. 18.00 og 04.00 (arbejdstiden kan skifte) og fri hver anden weekend.

Vil du være en del af Lagkagefamilien? Søg jobbet her.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og kan lukke opslaget, når det rette match er fundet, så send gerne din ansøgning snart. Efter ansøgningsfristen hører du fra os senest inden for 14 dage. Ansøgninger modtages kun via vores ansøgningsportal.

jobs.title: Afdelingsleder til vuggestuen i Spindegården
jobs.description:
Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Har du lyst til at være tæt på både børn, forældre og medarbejdere – og samtidig få mulighed for at sætte retning for den pædagogiske udvikling?

Så er det måske dig, vi søger som vores nye afdelingsleder i vuggestuen.

Om Spindegården
Spindegården er en integreret, selvejende daginstitution med 36 vuggestuebørn, 66 børnehavebørn og 24 dedikerede medarbejdere.

Vi ligger på Traps Allé i Valby, i et ældre charmerende hus midt i et skønt gammelt villakvarter. Vi har inden for det seneste år fået en helt ny legeplads, som vi er rigtig glade for. Den giver masser af muligheder for leg, bevægelse, fordybelse og spændende aktiviteter med børnene.

Vi søger en afdelingsleder til vuggestuen med tiltrædelse 1. november 2026 eller snarest derefter. Vi venter gerne på det rette match.

Om jobbet
Som afdelingsleder bliver du en vigtig del af den daglige ledelse i Spindegården. Stillingen er en kombination af at være tæt på børnene og medarbejderne på stuerne og samtidig varetage administrative, faglige og ledelsesmæssige opgaver.

Vi forestiller os som udgangspunkt, at du har omkring to dage på kontoret og tre dage på stuerne, men vi er åbne for at tilrettelægge det anderledes, hvis det giver mening.

Vi lægger vægt på, at ledelse hos os foregår tæt på praksis og i et tæt samarbejde med medarbejderne.

Vi søger en afdelingsleder, som
  • kan praktisere nærværende ledelse tæt på medarbejderne.
  • får det faglige ansvar for vuggestuen og understøtter medarbejderne i deres pædagogiske arbejde.
  • kan være med til at sikre kvalitet og udvikling i arbejdet med blandt andet SprogTrappen, TOPI, forældresamtaler og udvikling af læringsmiljøer.
  • kan facilitere team- og stuemøder og være med til at skabe en tydelig faglig retning.
  • i samarbejde med den daglige leder kan have ansvar for og overblik over pladsanvisningen.
  • får medansvar for personaleledelse i vuggestuen, men altid med den daglige leder tæt på som sparringspartner.
  • vil være en aktiv del af MED-udvalget og bidrage til husets fælles personalemøder.

Stillingen er på 30-37 timer ugentligt.

Din kommende afdeling
Vuggestuen har gennem de seneste år været igennem et generationsskifte, og vi har derfor i dag en forholdsvis ung personalegruppe.

Vi er et team bestående af 5 pædagoger, 1 pædagogisk assistent og 3 pædagogmedhjælpere.

De seneste år har vi haft et stort fokus på at skabe en tydelig struktur omkring organiseringen af hverdagen. Vi prioriterer at arbejde i mindre grupper, skabe nærvær og være loyale over for vores pædagogiske grundlag.

Vi fungerer som ét samlet team og hjælper hinanden på tværs af stuerne, når opgaven kalder på det. Derfor lægger vi også vægt på, at alle medarbejdere kender børnene og forældrene i hele vuggestuen.

Hvem er du?
Du er uddannet pædagog og derudover håber vi, at du er en leder, der møder ind med et smil og har lyst til at være en synlig og nærværende del af hverdagen.

Du får energi af relationsarbejdet med både store og små, og du kan skabe tryghed og følgeskab omkring dig. Samtidig formår du at holde fast i den faglige kurs – også når hverdagen bliver travl.

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra første dag. Det vigtigste for os er, at du har engagement, pædagogisk faglighed og lyst til ledelse, og at du har lyst til at udvikle både dig selv, medarbejderne og vuggestuen sammen med os. På sigt vil du have mulighed for at starte en lederuddannelse på diplomniveau. Har du lyst til at møde os?

Hvis du er nysgerrig på jobbet og gerne vil mærke stemningen i Spindegården, er du meget velkommen til at komme forbi til en rundvisning.

Kontakt Thomas Andersen, daglig leder, på 40 30 97 02.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Praktiske oplysninger
Tiltrædelse: 1. november 2026 eller snarest derefter. Vi venter gerne på den rette. Vi holder løbende samtaler, så send din ansøgning allerede i dag
Arbejdstid: 30-37 timer ugentligt
Løn: Efter gældende overenskomst
Ansættelse: Der indhentes referencer i forbindelse med ansættelsen.

Spindegården Traps Allé 15 2500 Valby

Thomas Andersen Daglig leder Telefon: 40 30 97 02

jobs.title: Junior rejsekonsulent til NGO og humanitære rejser
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for dem, der gør en forskel?

Ved du, hvor Entebbe, Ouagadougou og Cox's Bazar ligger? Og hvis ikke, har du så lyst til at lære det?

Vil du arbejde med rejser, der gør en forskel, og samtidig udvikle dig i en branche, hvor to dage aldrig er ens?

Hos Unitas Rejser hjælper vi danske, norske og internationale NGO'er og kirkelige organisationer med at komme ud i verden. Vores kunder rejser for indsamlede midler, og derfor betyder det noget, at vi leverer løsninger med høj kvalitet, skaber tryghed og får selv de mest komplekse rejser til at fungere.

Vi søger en ny kollega, som har lyst til at lære rejsebranchen at kende og udvikle sig sammen med os. Har du den rette nysgerrighed og lyst til at lære, sørger vi for en grundig oplæring.

Hvem er vi?

Hos Unitas Rejser tror vi på, at de bedste løsninger bliver skabt sammen.

Vi deler vores viden. Vi hjælper hinanden. Vi tager ansvar. Og vi tror på, at vi bliver dygtigere, når vi udvikler os sammen. Derfor leder vi ikke kun efter en medarbejder. Vi leder efter en kollega.

En person, der har lyst til at være en aktiv del af vores fællesskab og bidrage til den kultur, vi hver dag arbejder på at udvikle.

Om jobbet

Du bliver en del af vores NGO afdeling, hvor du får en grundig oplæring og gradvist får ansvar for dine egne kunder.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Salg af flybilletter samt relaterede produkter og services

  • Daglig kontakt med danske, norske og internationale kunder

  • Rådgivning og planlægning af rejser over hele verden

  • Flyreservationer og interne systemer

  • Opbygning af langvarige kunderelationer

  • At finde de bedste løsninger med fokus på både service og værdi for pengene

  • At sikre, at rejsen fungerer før, under og efter afrejse

Hos os slipper du ikke opgaven, når billetten er udstedt.

Du følger kunden hele vejen og er med til at finde løsninger, når planer ændrer sig.

Vi forventer heller ikke kun, at du løser dagens opgaver.

Vi håber også, du får øje på muligheder. Mange af vores bedste idéer opstår i dialog med kunder og kolleger, og vi vil gerne have en kollega, der har lyst til at bidrage til den udvikling.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Er nysgerrig på mennesker, verden og forskellige kulturer

  • Har lyst til at skabe relationer og opbygge tillid

  • Kan bevare overblikket, også når tempoet er højt

  • Arbejder struktureret og har sans for detaljen

  • Er serviceminded og trives med kundekontakt

  • Tager ansvar og følger dine opgaver til dørs

  • Bidrager positivt til fællesskabet

  • Taler og skriver dansk og engelsk

  • Taler og forstår du norsk, vil det være en fordel, men det er ikke et krav

  • Flair for IT

Det er ikke afgørende, om du allerede har erfaring fra rejsebranchen.

Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, udvikle dig og blive en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden med at lykkes.

Vi tilbyder

  • Grundig oplæring og løbende sparring

  • Et job med ansvar og udviklingsmuligheder

  • En international hverdag, hvor ingen dage er ens

  • Et stærkt fællesskab med engagerede kolleger

  • Mulighed for hjemmearbejde, når du er godt inde i jobbet

  • Pension, sundhedsforsikring og attraktive personalegoder

  • En arbejdsplads med højt til loftet, korte beslutningsveje og plads til familieliv

Arbejdsstedet er Silkeborg, og stillingen er på fuld tid.

Om Unitas Rejser

Unitas Rejser har siden 1948 hjulpet mennesker ud i verden.

I dag er vi specialister i rejser for NGO'er, kirkelige organisationer, skoler og grupper.

Vi møder mennesker og kulturer med tillid og professionalisme. Vi gør komplekse rejser enkle og tror på, at gode relationer skaber de bedste løsninger.

Vi er ejet af KFUM og KFUK i Danmark, og vores overskud går til arbejdet med børn og unge. Det minder os om, at det, vi laver hver dag, skal skabe værdi for flere end os selv.

jobs.title: Restaurationsmanager
jobs.description:
Restaurationsmanager

Dit Smørrebrød i Skagen er en travl virksomhed i rivende udvikling. 
Vores kendetegn er traditionelt dansk smørrebrød til Skawboer og turister – uden dikkedarer.
Godt gammeldags smørrebrød, klassiske frokost retter samt “Mormor mad” på aftenmenuen, hvor det er lavet fra bunden med friske råvarer – og ”salt, peber og kærlighed”, råvarer af bedste kvalitet samt vores kvalitet og service er ALTID i top.

Vores restaurant emmer af afslappet stemning og maden indtages i hyggelig gammel dansk atmosfære med rød og hvidternede duge. Skagens hyggeligste frokost og aftens restaurant. 

Vi har stor ansvarsfølelse for vores ansatte - vi værdsætter gensidig tillid. Vi løser vores opgaver i fællesskab ved at serverer godt gedigent mad i en afslappet atmosfære, som er fyldt med grin og glæde for så vel ansatte som for vores gæster.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver
Som restaurantansvarlig får du en central rolle i den daglige drift, hvor du blandt andet skal:

•    Lede og koordinere restaurantteamet under vagterne
•    Fordele arbejdsopgaver og administrere personalets pauser
•    Sikre en effektiv og velfungerende service
•    Tage godt imod gæsterne og hjælpe til, hvor der er behov
•    Overvåge servicekvaliteten og sikre høj kundetilfredshed
•    Håndtere gæstespørgsmål og eventuelle reklamationer professionelt
•    Koordinere samarbejdet mellem køkken og serveringspersonale
•    Åbne og/eller lukke restauranten samt foretage kasseafstemning
•    Sikre, at restauranten altid fremstår ren, organiseret og klar til service
•    Medvirke til oplæring af nye medarbejdere
•    Løse udfordringer løbende under vagten
•    Stå for varebestilling og lagerstyring

Vi forestiller os, at du

•    Har erfaring fra restaurant- eller servicebranchen
•    Trives med ansvar og kan bevare overblikket i travle perioder
•    Er serviceminded, imødekommende og løsningsorienteret
•    Kan motivere og skabe et godt samarbejde blandt kollegaerne
•    Har fokus på kvalitet og gæsteoplevelser

Vi tilbyder

•    Helårsansættelse
•    Mulighed for bolig
•    Et uhøjtideligt arbejdsmiljø med plads til humor
•    Afslappet omgangstone og godt humør i hverdagen
•    Nogle af de gladeste gæster, fordi vi laver god mad
•    Gode kollegaer, hvor vi løfter i fællesskab
•    En hektisk, spændende og sjov højsæson
•    Attraktiv løn efter kvalifikationer

Arbejdstid i tidsrummet mellem kl. 10.00 og 21.00, på alle ugens dage

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning og CV til smag@smag-toscana.dk

Ansøgning mærkes i emnefeltet: Restaurationsmanager

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig

---------------------------------------------------------------

Restaurant Manager

Dit Smørrebrød in Skagen is a busy restaurant experiencing strong growth.
We are known for serving traditional Danish open sandwiches (smørrebrød) to both local residents and tourists. We pride ourselves on good old-fashioned ‘smørrebrød’, classic lunch dishes, and traditional home-style cooking on our evening menu. Everything is prepared from scratch using fresh ingredients, seasoned with "salt, pepper and love". We use only the finest quality produce, and our standards of food quality and customer service are always second to none.

Our restaurant offers a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere, where guests enjoy their meals surrounded by cosy Danish charm, complete with red-and-white checked tablecloths. We are proud to be one of Skagen's most inviting lunch and dinner restaurants.

We take great responsibility for the wellbeing of our employees and place a high value on mutual trust. We work together as a team to serve honest, wholesome food in a relaxed environment for both our staff and our guests.

Your Key Responsibilities

As Restaurant Manager, you will play a central role in the daily operation of the restaurant.
 Your responsibilities will include:
•    Leading and coordinating the restaurant team during service
•    Allocating tasks and managing staff breaks
•    Ensuring efficient and smooth-running service
•    Welcoming guests and assisting wherever needed
•    Monitoring service quality and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction
•    Handling guest enquiries and any complaints professionally
•    Coordinating communication and cooperation between the kitchen and front-of-house teams
•    Opening and/or closing the restaurant, including cash reconciliation
•    Ensuring the restaurant is always clean, organized, and ready for service
•    Assisting with the training and onboarding of new employees
•    Resolving operational challenges as they arise during service
•    Managing stock orders and inventory control

About You

We are looking for someone who:
•    Has experience within the restaurant, hospitality, or service industry
•    Thrives on responsibility and remains calm under pressure during busy periods
•    Is service-minded, approachable, and solution-oriented
•    Can motivate colleagues and foster a positive team environment
•    Has a strong focus on quality and guest experience

We Offer

•    Permanent, year-round employment
•    Accommodation available
•    An informal working environment with plenty of room for good spirits
•    A relaxed workplace culture with a positive atmosphere
•    Some of the happiest guests around, because we serve great food
•    Supportive colleagues who work together as a team
•    A busy, exciting, and enjoyable high season
•    Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience

Working Hours
Working hours will be scheduled between 10:00 am and 9:00 pm, seven days a week.

Interested?
If this sounds like the opportunity for you, please send your application and CV to smag@smag-toscana.dk

Subject line: Restaurant Manager

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will appoint the right candidate as soon as they are found.

We look forward to hearing from you

tidspunkter:

Mandag kl. 16:00-19:00
Bemanding af receptionen, hvor du står for en del af de daglige opgaver og – vigtigst af alt – tager
imod vores medlemmer med et smil og godt humør.
Derudover forventer vi, at du har lyst til at træde til i receptionen ved sygdom og ferie, hvor der
både kan være tale om dag- og aftenvagter. Det er derfor en fordel, at du er fleksibel og har
mulighed for at hjælpe til, når der er behov.

Tirsdag kl. 9:00-12:00
3 faste seniorhold, hvor du står for alle tre timer.

Onsdag kl. 15:00-17:00
• Kl. 15:00-16:00: Fast seniorhold
• Kl. 16:00-17:00: Et hold efter dine kompetencer og interesser – det kunne fx være
BodyCombat, Stram Op, Jumping Fitness, Zumba eller noget helt andet.

Fredag
Mulighed for faste holdtimer kl. 15:00-16:00 og 16:00-17:00 – og eventuelt også kl. 17:00-18:00.

Weekend
Der er også mulighed for holdtimer lørdag og/eller søndag. Det kan fx være hver anden weekend,
hvis det passer bedre.


Mulighed for personlig træning
Har du en baggrund som personlig træner, og har du lyst til at arbejde med personlig træning, er
der også mulighed for at kombinere stillingen med faste PT-timer. Det kan være en oplagt
mulighed for dig, der gerne vil have nogle faste timer i kalenderen og samtidig arbejde med
personlig træning.


Har du endnu ikke en personlig træner-uddannelse, men drømmer om at blive personlig træner,
hjælper vi dig gerne på vej. Der er mulighed for at tage en personlig træner-uddannelse gennem
os. Uddannelsen er egenbetalt, men betalingen kan ske via din løn, så du ikke nødvendigvis skal
lægge hele beløbet ud på én gang.


Hvad kan vi tilbyde?
Hos os bliver du en del af et engageret og imødekommende team, hvor der er plads til både
faglighed, humor og en uhøjtidelig stemning.

jobs.title: Service Manager – Cleaning & Property Services
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and proactive Service Manager to take responsibility for the daily operation and coordination of our cleaning and property service activities.

As Service Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring high service standards across our customer sites. You will be responsible for coordinating employees, planning daily operations, maintaining quality standards and ensuring professional communication with our customers.

The position combines leadership, operational planning and customer service, and we are therefore looking for someone who is comfortable taking responsibility and making decisions in a busy and dynamic working environment.

Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Daily management and coordination of service employees

  • Planning and allocation of cleaning and property maintenance tasks

  • Ensuring that agreed service levels and quality standards are maintained

  • Conducting regular quality inspections at customer sites

  • Managing daily operational changes, including sickness, absence and replacement staff

  • Recruitment, onboarding and introduction of new employees

  • Preparing and maintaining work schedules

  • Maintaining regular communication with customers and following up on their requirements

  • Handling operational issues and ensuring that challenges are resolved quickly and professionally

  • Coordinating cleaning supplies, equipment and machinery

  • Planning and coordinating property maintenance services

  • Coordinating seasonal outdoor maintenance, including lawn mowing, hedge trimming and general upkeep of outdoor areas

  • Supporting employees and ensuring clear instructions and expectations

  • Reporting and following up on daily operations with management

Your Profile

We are looking for a responsible and service-minded person who enjoys working with both people and operations.

Ideally, you:

  • Have previous experience within cleaning, facility services, property services or a similar service industry

  • Have experience managing or coordinating employees

  • Have strong organisational and planning skills

  • Are able to work independently and take ownership of your responsibilities

  • Have a professional and customer-focused approach

  • Are solution-oriented and able to respond quickly when operational challenges arise

  • Are comfortable working in an environment where priorities may change during the day

  • Have basic IT skills and are comfortable using digital planning and communication tools

  • Hold a valid Category B driving licence

Previous experience with both commercial cleaning and property/outdoor maintenance is an advantage.

What We Offer

We offer an independent and responsible position in a growing service company where you will have a direct influence on daily operations and customer satisfaction.

You will be joining a company with short decision-making processes and a practical approach to solving challenges.

We offer:

  • A position with a high degree of responsibility and independence

  • A varied working day with both office and on-site responsibilities

  • Close cooperation with management, customers and employees

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development

  • Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience

  • A dynamic working environment where no two days are exactly the same

jobs.title: CE-Licensed Drivers Wanted for Night and Evening Shifts
jobs.description:
CE-Licensed Drivers Wanted for Night and Evening Shifts

FragtDK ApS is experiencing increased demand and is therefore looking for 2–4 new, experienced, and reliable drivers holding a Category CE driving licence.

Shifts typically run from 5:00 PM to 3:00 AM. You will become part of a small, close-knit team of drivers with an informal working environment, while maintaining a strong focus on safety and proper planning.

We are based at Hovedgaden 429 in Hedehusene. As a driver with us, you will operate heavy vehicles on routes primarily in and around Greater Copenhagen, as well as on longer-distance routes.

The work will be varied, but you must be prepared for the majority of the driving to take place at night. You must also be willing to stay overnight in the vehicle when necessary.

The positions are full-time.

We expect that you:

  • Hold a valid Category CE driving licence

  • Have solid experience as a truck driver – preferably 10 years or more – within distribution or transport of a similar nature

  • Have experience driving 25.25-metre modular vehicle combinations (link combinations)

  • Are flexible and able to work evening and night shifts

  • Are prepared for the majority of the driving to take place at night and to stay overnight in the vehicle when necessary

  • Speak and understand English at a level that allows you to communicate confidently with colleagues and customers

  • Can provide a clean criminal record certificate and hold a driving licence with no current sanctions or restrictions

  • Holding licences for other types of heavy vehicles is an advantage, but not a requirement

In return, we offer:

  • Fixed shifts with predictable working hours

  • Salary based on qualifications

  • A good and friendly working environment at FragtDK ApS

If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact us at info@fragtdk.com.

Please send your application and CV to the same email address no later than two weeks after the publication of this job advertisement.

Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and the positions will be filled as soon as we find the right candidates.
